campaigns.title: 晶圓城夜班：來料、廠務與搬運
campaigns.titleEn: Wafer City night shift: incoming material, utilities and logistics
campaigns.brief: 接手一批塞車的晶圓，追查潔淨度、片形、磊晶與事件時間，完成可追溯交班。
campaigns.briefEn: Take over a congested wafer lot, investigate cleanliness, geometry, epitaxy and event timing, then create a traceable handoff.
campaigns.role: 製造與廠務協調工程師

photo.title: CNE 晶圓廠無塵室
photo.titleEn: CNE wafer foundry cleanroom
photo.author: Abkorshak

stations.title: 派工中控
stations.description: 批次路徑與時間戳
stations.descriptionEn: Lot routing and timestamps

stations.title: 來料量測
stations.description: 幾何與磊晶證據
stations.descriptionEn: Geometry and epitaxy evidence

stations.title: 超純水回路
stations.description: 流量、採樣與名義停留
stations.descriptionEn: Flow, sampling and nominal residence

stations.title: 潔淨監測
stations.description: 粒徑通道與空白
stations.descriptionEn: Size bins and blanks

missions.title: 夜班投片：別把等待當產能
missions.titleEn: Night-shift starts: distinguish waiting from capacity
missions.brief: 看板顯示在製品堆積。先把投片速率與平均停留時間放在同一邊界，再決定是否新增批次。
missions.briefEn: WIP is rising. Put throughput and residence time inside the same system boundary before admitting another lot.

evidence.title: 批次事件表
evidence.detail: 假想穩態平均產出 4 批／小時；停留時間含排隊和加工，不能只填機台加工時間。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic steady-state output is 4 lots/h. Residence includes queueing and processing, not only tool time.

evidence.title: 容許在製品
evidence.detail: 教學看板容量為 12 批；這是本局規劃值，不是晶圓廠標準。
evidence.detailEn: This game plans for 12 lots of WIP; it is not an industry limit.

decisions.text: 限制投片並改善瓶頸排隊
decisions.textEn: Gate starts and address the bottleneck queue
decisions.feedback: 維持同一統計邊界後，減少等待才能降低在製品。
decisions.feedbackEn: Using the same boundary, shorter waits reduce WIP.

decisions.text: 再加投兩倍批次
decisions.textEn: Double incoming lots
decisions.feedback: 投入增加不會自動增加瓶頸產出，可能延長等待。
decisions.feedbackEn: More input does not automatically increase bottleneck output.

decisions.text: 刪除排隊記錄
decisions.textEn: Delete queue records
decisions.feedback: 資料變漂亮不等於等待消失。
decisions.feedbackEn: Cleaner-looking records do not remove queues.

missions.debrief: 交班保存平均期間、邊界、產出與等待定義；非穩態不可直接把此式當瞬時預測。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff records the averaging window, boundary, output and wait definition. Do not use the steady-state identity as an instantaneous forecast.

missions.title: 回流水槽：確認換水時間
missions.brief: 水槽樣本需與循環狀態一起解讀，調整示意流量使一次名義換水時間不超過 10 分鐘。
missions.briefEn: Interpret the sample with circulation state; adjust the model flow for a nominal turnover of at most ten minutes.

evidence.title: 槽體標籤
evidence.detail: 假想有效體積 500 L。V/Q 是理想名義換水時間，並不保證死角也已洗淨。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic effective volume is 500 L. V/Q is an ideal nominal turnover and does not guarantee dead-zone cleaning.

evidence.title: 兩個採樣點
evidence.detail: 入口與回流各保留樣本、時間戳與取樣容器空白。
evidence.detailEn: Retain inlet and return samples, timestamps and container blanks.

decisions.text: 比較進出水與容器空白再交班
decisions.textEn: Compare inlet, return and container blank
decisions.feedback: 可區分回路污染與取樣造成的假訊號。
decisions.feedbackEn: This separates loop contamination from sampling artifacts.

decisions.text: 只看入口樣本就放行
decisions.textEn: Release using only the inlet sample
decisions.feedback: 入口合格不能證明回流端沒有污染。
decisions.feedbackEn: A good inlet cannot establish a clean return.

decisions.text: 延長循環但不記錄流量
decisions.textEn: Run longer without recording flow
decisions.feedback: 缺少流量資料便無法重建換水條件。
decisions.feedbackEn: Without flow data the turnover cannot be reconstructed.

missions.debrief: 模型只處理名義停留時間；電阻率、顆粒與有機物須分別驗證。
missions.debriefEn: This model covers nominal residence only; resistivity, particles and organics require separate checks.

missions.title: 微污染警報：分清去除率與殘留量
missions.titleEn: Contamination alarm: separate removal from residue
missions.brief: 上游示意顆粒濃度為 200，調整去除比例以滿足下游教學目標。
missions.briefEn: The upstream synthetic particle concentration is 200; adjust removal fraction to meet the downstream learning target.

evidence.title: 粒徑通道
evidence.detail: 前後樣本必須使用同一粒徑通道、同一體積與相同儀器設定。
evidence.detailEn: Before/after samples require the same size bin, volume and instrument settings.

evidence.title: 容器空白
evidence.detail: 空白 1、下游樣本 11 不可直接解讀成製程新增 11；此簡化式尚未扣背景。
evidence.detailEn: A blank of 1 and downstream 11 do not establish 11 process-added particles; this simple model has no background correction.

decisions.text: 重做配對採樣並保留空白
decisions.textEn: Repeat paired samples and retain blanks
decisions.feedback: 同一量測條件才允許比較前後差異。
decisions.feedbackEn: A matched measurement method permits a defensible comparison.

decisions.text: 換較大粒徑通道掩蓋警報
decisions.textEn: Use a larger size bin to hide the alarm
decisions.feedback: 改變定義會破壞趨勢比較。
decisions.feedbackEn: Changing the definition breaks trend comparison.

decisions.text: 停用全部量測器
decisions.textEn: Disable every monitor
decisions.feedback: 失去資訊不能修復污染問題。
decisions.feedbackEn: Loss of information cannot repair contamination.

missions.debrief: 署名照片只顯示潔淨室外觀；看不到不代表沒有微污染。
missions.debriefEn: A credited cleanroom photograph shows appearance; invisibility does not prove absence of contamination.

missions.title: 來料幾何：辨識厚度範圍
missions.brief: 供應批次有五點厚度摘要。用最大與最小值計算抽樣厚度極差；五點不足以保證整片 TTV，不把平均值當平坦度。
missions.briefEn: A supplier lot has a five-point thickness summary. Use extrema for sampled thickness range; five points cannot certify whole-wafer TTV, and the mean is not flatness.

evidence.title: 厚度摘要
evidence.detail: 示意量測下界 774 μm；上界可由重測更正。量測點位置需保留。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic lower thickness is 774 μm; a repeat measurement may revise the upper value. Retain sample positions.

evidence.title: 幾何指標
evidence.detail: TTV、bow、warp 不同；本關只計算厚度極差，不推論應力或整片平坦度。
evidence.detailEn: TTV, bow and warp differ. This mission computes thickness range only, not stress or wafer flatness.

decisions.text: 隔離批次並核對量測基準
decisions.textEn: Hold the lot and verify measurement reference
decisions.feedback: 可先排除支撐方式與溫度造成的量測差異。
decisions.feedbackEn: First separate measurement-reference differences from material variation.

decisions.text: 用平均厚度取代 TTV
decisions.textEn: Replace TTV with mean thickness
decisions.feedback: 平均值會隱藏局部厚度差。
decisions.feedbackEn: A mean hides local thickness spread.

decisions.text: 直接重磨全部晶圓
decisions.textEn: Regrind every wafer immediately
decisions.feedback: 未釐清量測問題便加工會造成不必要材料損失。
decisions.feedbackEn: Processing before checking metrology can waste material.

missions.debrief: 來料資料必須對應晶圓編號、方向與支撐條件。
missions.debriefEn: Incoming measurements must identify wafer, orientation and support conditions.

missions.title: 磊晶交接：比較中心與邊緣
missions.titleEn: Epitaxy handoff: compare center and edge
missions.brief: 假想磊晶層的中心與邊緣厚度不同。計算相對極差，再選擇可驗證的追查方向。
missions.briefEn: Synthetic epitaxial thickness differs at center and edge. Compute relative range and select a testable investigation.

evidence.title: 中心與邊緣
evidence.detail: 中心厚度 5 μm；邊緣可調。這是兩點教學指標，不等同全片均勻度規格。
evidence.detailEn: Center thickness is 5 μm; edge value is adjustable. This two-point teaching metric is not a full-wafer uniformity specification.

evidence.title: 批次歷程
evidence.detail: 同批的基板與量測方法相同；下一步應取得徑向厚度圖與反應器批次資料。
evidence.detailEn: Substrate and metrology are matched within the batch; next obtain a radial map and reactor history.

decisions.text: 補徑向圖並比較批次條件
decisions.textEn: Add a radial map and compare batch conditions
decisions.feedback: 兩點不足以區分流場、溫度與量測誤差。
decisions.feedbackEn: Two points cannot distinguish flow, temperature and metrology effects.

decisions.text: 宣稱整片已均勻
decisions.textEn: Declare the entire wafer uniform
decisions.feedback: 局部樣本不能支持全片結論。
decisions.feedbackEn: Local samples cannot support a whole-wafer claim.

decisions.text: 把兩個厚度平均後刪掉原值
decisions.textEn: Average both values and discard the originals
decisions.feedback: 原始空間資訊不可被平均抹去。
decisions.feedbackEn: Averaging must not erase spatial evidence.

missions.debrief: 比較指標要附定義；不同公司的均勻度百分比可能不是同一計算方式。
missions.debriefEn: Attach the metric definition: different reported uniformity percentages may use different formulas.

missions.title: 放行前交班：比對時間戳
missions.brief: AMHS 到站與量測完成時間分別由兩個系統回傳；先處理時差再判斷從到站到量測完成的經過時間。
missions.briefEn: Arrival and measurement completion come from separate systems. Correct their clock difference before interpreting elapsed time from arrival through measurement completion.

evidence.title: 原始時間
evidence.detail: 同一時區的到站時間為 08:00、紀錄完成為 08:25。量測系統已知快 5 分鐘。
evidence.detailEn: Same-zone arrival is 08:00 and recorded completion 08:25. The metrology clock is known to be five minutes fast.

evidence.title: 交班必要欄位
evidence.detail: 批號、設備號、路徑版本、例外與待處置責任人都需保留。
evidence.detailEn: Retain lot, tool, route version, exceptions and the owner of unresolved work.

decisions.text: 保留原始與校正時間後交班
decisions.textEn: Handoff both original and corrected times
decisions.feedback: 保留校正依據可讓下一班重建事件。
decisions.feedbackEn: The correction record lets the next shift reconstruct events.

decisions.text: 直接改寫原始時間
decisions.textEn: Overwrite raw timestamps
decisions.feedback: 破壞追溯性，無法驗證修正。
decisions.feedbackEn: Traceability is lost and the correction cannot be verified.

decisions.text: 只傳口頭說明
decisions.textEn: Give only a verbal handoff
decisions.feedback: 無法追蹤未結案項目與版本。
decisions.feedbackEn: Open items and versions become untraceable.

missions.debrief: 安全放行是資訊完整、量測有效且責任清楚的結果，不是得分高就能操作真機。
missions.debriefEn: Release in this story requires valid measurements and clear ownership; a game score never authorizes real equipment operation.

campaigns.scope: 原創教學值班情境；數值、門檻與事件為明示假設，不能用作量產配方、設備操作授權或工廠驗收。照片是附署名的代表實拍；遊戲站點為示意配置，非照片中儀器的自動辨識。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original educational shift scenario. Values, thresholds and events are explicit assumptions, not production recipes, equipment authorization or factory acceptance. Credited photographs are representative; game stations are schematic placements, not automatic recognition of photographed instruments.
campaigns.sourceScope: 來源提供原理與方法背景，不代表本局假想數值或門檻取自來源，也不代表來源機構認證本遊戲。
campaigns.sourceScopeEn: Sources provide principles and methods; synthetic game values and thresholds are not attributed to them, and no source institution endorses this game.

campaigns.title: 奈米元件整合：閘極到背面供電
campaigns.titleEn: Device integration: gate stack to backside power
campaigns.brief: 扮演製程整合工程師，用六個可計算的驗證關卡，連接薄膜、熱歷程、三維幾何、接觸與供電。
campaigns.briefEn: Act as process integrator through six calculable checkpoints spanning films, thermal history, 3D geometry, contacts and power.

photo.title: Los Alamos 原子層沉積設備
photo.titleEn: Atomic layer deposition system at Los Alamos
photo.author: Center for Integrated Nanotechnologies - Los Alamos National Laboratory

stations.title: 元件整合桌
stations.description: 模型、截面與電性互相核對
stations.descriptionEn: Cross-check models, sections and electrical evidence

missions.title: ALD 循環：先確認成長率
missions.titleEn: ALD cycles: verify growth per cycle
missions.brief: 以已驗證的假想成長率規劃 5 nm 薄膜；不要把增加循環當成修復不飽和反應。
missions.briefEn: Plan a 5 nm film from a verified synthetic growth rate; extra cycles cannot repair an unsaturated reaction.

evidence.title: 設計假設
evidence.detail: 假想飽和區間內每循環 0.10 nm，初始成核延遲忽略。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic saturated growth is 0.10 nm/cycle; nucleation delay is neglected.

evidence.title: 量測與侷限
evidence.detail: 需用循環數對厚度的線性圖與劑量飽和實驗確認適用範圍。
evidence.detailEn: Use thickness versus cycle count and dose saturation studies to establish validity.

decisions.text: 檢查飽和曲線後設定循環數
decisions.textEn: Check saturation then set cycle count
decisions.feedback: 線性模型須建立在自限制反應已成立的條件。
decisions.feedbackEn: The linear model requires established self-limiting growth.

decisions.text: 把脈衝加長當作無限增厚
decisions.textEn: Extend pulses for unlimited growth
decisions.feedback: 飽和後增加劑量不應被當成線性增厚。
decisions.feedbackEn: Beyond saturation, dose is not a linear thickness control.

decisions.text: 完全不量測直接複製別台參數
decisions.textEn: Copy another tool without metrology
decisions.feedback: 不同腔體與成核條件不可假定相同。
decisions.feedbackEn: Different chambers and nucleation conditions need not match.

missions.debrief: 交班記錄飽和證據、成核條件與厚度模型。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff records saturation evidence, nucleation conditions and the thickness model.

missions.title: 閘極堆疊：物理厚度與 EOT
missions.titleEn: Gate stack: physical thickness and EOT
missions.brief: 在單一理想介電層近似下，比較高介電常數薄膜與等效氧化層厚度。
missions.briefEn: Compare high-k thickness and EOT using a single ideal dielectric approximation.

evidence.title: 設計假設
evidence.detail: 假想均勻介電層 k=20；界面氧化層與量子效應未納入。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic uniform dielectric k=20; interface oxide and quantum effects are excluded.

evidence.title: 量測與侷限
evidence.detail: 電容量相同不代表漏電、可靠度與介面品質相同。
evidence.detailEn: Equal capacitance does not establish equal leakage, reliability or interface quality.

decisions.text: 補介面層與漏電資料再整合
decisions.textEn: Add interface and leakage evidence before integration
decisions.feedback: EOT 只描述電容等效，不能代表完整可靠度。
decisions.feedbackEn: EOT describes capacitance equivalence, not full reliability.

decisions.text: 以 EOT 等於實體膜厚交班
decisions.textEn: Report EOT as physical thickness
decisions.feedback: 混淆幾何厚度與電容等效厚度。
decisions.feedbackEn: This confuses geometry with capacitance equivalence.

decisions.text: 只把 k 設成最大值
decisions.textEn: Maximize k alone
decisions.feedback: 材料與介面變化不能靠單一參數保證改善。
decisions.feedbackEn: A single parameter cannot guarantee better material interfaces.

missions.debrief: 明示串聯界面層被忽略；進階閱讀原課程再討論完整堆疊。
missions.debriefEn: State the omitted series interface layer, then use the original course for full-stack discussion.

missions.title: 熱歷程：辨識擴散尺度
missions.brief: 比較相同假想擴散係數下的時間效果；用長度尺度判斷是否需要縮短熱暴露。
missions.briefEn: Compare time effects at a fixed synthetic diffusivity and decide whether thermal exposure needs reduction.

evidence.title: 設計假設
evidence.detail: D 固定為 0.5 nm²/s；真實 D 對溫度、濃度與缺陷相依，本關不求廠商退火配方。
evidence.detailEn: D is fixed at 0.5 nm²/s. Real D depends on temperature, concentration and defects; this is not a vendor anneal recipe.

evidence.title: 量測與侷限
evidence.detail: 此為一維常 D 的均方根尺度；不等於接面深度或活化比例。
evidence.detailEn: This is a one-dimensional constant-D RMS scale, not junction depth or activation fraction.

decisions.text: 保留活化與擴散兩套驗證
decisions.textEn: Keep separate activation and diffusion checks
decisions.feedback: 縮短時間可能減少擴散，但不能保證活化足夠。
decisions.feedbackEn: Less time may reduce diffusion without assuring activation.

decisions.text: 把尺度直接宣稱為接面深度
decisions.textEn: Call this scale the junction depth
decisions.feedback: 模型邊界條件與濃度輪廓尚未建立。
decisions.feedbackEn: Boundary conditions and concentration profile are not established.

decisions.text: 把 D 隨意調小使數字過關
decisions.textEn: Reduce D arbitrarily to pass
decisions.feedback: 材料參數需量測或來源支持。
decisions.feedbackEn: Material parameters need measurement or a source.

missions.debrief: 下一班需取得熱歷程、片電阻與深度輪廓，不能只看一個尺度。
missions.debriefEn: The next shift needs thermal history, sheet resistance and depth profiles, not one length scale.

missions.title: 三維元件：有效寬度預算
missions.brief: 以三面閘的示意鰭式結構計算有效通道寬度；比較幾何時保留鰭數。
missions.briefEn: Compute an ideal three-sided fin effective width and retain fin count when comparing geometries.

evidence.title: 設計假設
evidence.detail: 矩形鰭、三面閘且忽略角部效應；此式只算幾何寬度。
evidence.detailEn: Rectangular fins with three-sided gates and no corner effects; only geometry is computed.

evidence.title: 量測與侷限
evidence.detail: 等效寬度增加不等於電流同比增加，還有接觸、遷移率與短通道效應。
evidence.detailEn: Effective width does not guarantee proportional current; contacts, mobility and short-channel effects matter.

decisions.text: 同時比較接觸與電性資料
decisions.textEn: Compare contact and electrical data too
decisions.feedback: 幾何與電性須建立連結，不能互相取代。
decisions.feedbackEn: Geometry and electrical behavior must be linked, not substituted.

decisions.text: 宣稱電流必定加倍
decisions.textEn: Promise exactly twice the current
decisions.feedback: 幾何公式沒有涵蓋電性退化。
decisions.feedbackEn: The geometry formula omits electrical degradation.

decisions.text: 只改圖示尺寸不保存鰭數
decisions.textEn: Resize the icon without recording fin count
decisions.feedback: 無法重建計算的設計假設。
decisions.feedbackEn: The design assumptions become unrecoverable.

missions.debrief: 尺寸以教學假設標示，不把圖示當電子顯微鏡校準截面。
missions.debriefEn: Label dimensions as learning assumptions; the icon is not a calibrated microscopy section.

missions.title: 接觸瓶頸：分離電阻來源
missions.brief: 量測路徑包含通道與兩端接觸。估算接觸造成的額外壓降。
missions.briefEn: The measurement path includes a channel and two contacts. Estimate the extra contact voltage drop.

evidence.title: 設計假設
evidence.detail: 示意單端接觸電阻 Rc；mA×Ω 直接得到 mV。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic one-contact resistance Rc; mA × Ω gives mV.

evidence.title: 量測與侷限
evidence.detail: 單一兩端電阻不能唯一分出接觸與通道，需 TLM 或 Kelvin 結構。
evidence.detailEn: A two-terminal resistance cannot uniquely separate channel and contacts; TLM or Kelvin structures are needed.

decisions.text: 安排 Kelvin 或 TLM 比較
decisions.textEn: Schedule Kelvin or TLM comparison
decisions.feedback: 結構化量測才有機會分離接觸貢獻。
decisions.feedbackEn: Structured metrology can separate contact contribution.

decisions.text: 全部電阻都歸咎於接觸
decisions.textEn: Attribute all resistance to contacts
decisions.feedback: 通道與走線也會貢獻電阻。
decisions.feedbackEn: Channel and interconnect also contribute.

decisions.text: 降低量測電流後宣稱接觸改善
decisions.textEn: Lower test current and claim better contacts
decisions.feedback: 壓降變小不表示電阻已減少。
decisions.feedbackEn: Lower drop does not prove lower resistance.

missions.debrief: 交班同時提供偏壓、結構與溫度，避免跨條件比較。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff bias, structure and temperature to avoid incompatible comparisons.

missions.title: 背面供電：壓降與路徑取捨
missions.titleEn: Backside power: voltage drop and routing tradeoffs
missions.brief: 用等效路徑電阻比較供電方案，保留系統整合限制。
missions.briefEn: Compare power paths using equivalent resistance while retaining integration constraints.

evidence.title: 設計假設
evidence.detail: 假想負載 50 mA、路徑 0.6 Ω；只算直流壓降，忽略瞬態、電感與供電網格分佈。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic 50 mA load and 0.6 Ω path; only DC drop is modeled, omitting transients, inductance and grid distribution.

evidence.title: 量測與侷限
evidence.detail: 路徑縮短仍需鍵合、薄化、套刻、熱與可靠度證據。
evidence.detailEn: A shorter path still needs bonding, thinning, overlay, thermal and reliability evidence.

decisions.text: 以跨模組證據決定試驗載具
decisions.textEn: Choose a test vehicle using cross-module evidence
decisions.feedback: 降低 IR drop 是必要比較，不是整合成功的充分條件。
decisions.feedbackEn: Lower IR drop is useful but insufficient for integration success.

decisions.text: 只憑壓降就宣布量產成功
decisions.textEn: Declare production success from drop alone
decisions.feedback: 電性單點無法證明良率與可靠度。
decisions.feedbackEn: One electrical metric cannot prove yield or reliability.

decisions.text: 移除所有接點以減少電阻
decisions.textEn: Remove every contact to reduce resistance
decisions.feedback: 系統功能與可製造性不再成立。
decisions.feedbackEn: System function and manufacturability would fail.

missions.debrief: 提交供電路徑、假設、未驗證項目與下一個實驗。
missions.debriefEn: Submit the path, assumptions, unresolved checks and next experiment.

campaigns.scope: 原創教學值班情境；數值、門檻與事件為明示假設，不能用作量產配方、設備操作授權或工廠驗收。照片是附署名的代表實拍；遊戲站點為示意配置，非照片中儀器的自動辨識。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original educational shift scenario. Values, thresholds and events are explicit assumptions, not production recipes, equipment authorization or factory acceptance. Credited photographs are representative; game stations are schematic placements, not automatic recognition of photographed instruments.
campaigns.sourceScope: 來源提供原理與方法背景，不代表本局假想數值或門檻取自來源，也不代表來源機構認證本遊戲。
campaigns.sourceScopeEn: Sources provide principles and methods; synthetic game values and thresholds are not attributed to them, and no source institution endorses this game.

campaigns.title: 黃光任務：解析度、套刻與缺陷
campaigns.titleEn: Yellow-light mission: resolution, overlay and defects
campaigns.brief: 接手一批跨站不一致的圖案，分別檢查成像、焦深、套刻、光阻統計與模型驗證。
campaigns.briefEn: Investigate inconsistent patterning through imaging, focus depth, overlay, resist statistics and model validation.

photo.title: 倫敦奈米科技中心微影實驗室
photo.titleEn: Photolithography laboratory at the London Centre for Nanotechnology
photo.author: O. Usher / UCL Mathematical & Physical Sciences

stations.title: 成像站
stations.description: 解析度與焦深預算
stations.descriptionEn: Resolution and focus budgets

stations.title: 對準與計算
stations.description: 套刻、標靶與模型驗證
stations.descriptionEn: Overlay, targets and validation

stations.title: 光阻工作站
stations.description: 膜厚與隨機事件
stations.descriptionEn: Thickness and stochastic events

missions.title: 成像任務：解析度不是節點名稱
missions.titleEn: Imaging task: resolution is not the node name
missions.brief: 調整 NA 比較單次曝光的理想特徵尺度。
missions.briefEn: Adjust NA to compare ideal single-exposure feature scale.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: λ=13.5 nm、k1=0.33 為本關假設。
evidence.detailEn: This mission assumes λ=13.5 nm and k1=0.33.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: Rayleigh 尺度不是產品節點名稱，也不等於所有電晶體尺寸。
evidence.detailEn: A Rayleigh scale is neither a product node label nor every transistor dimension.

decisions.text: 保存 NA 與 k1 並繼續檢查焦深
decisions.textEn: Record NA and k1, then check focus depth
decisions.feedback: 提升解析度仍需檢查製程窗口。
decisions.feedbackEn: Higher resolution still needs a process-window check.

decisions.text: 把結果改名成同數字製程節點
decisions.textEn: Name a process node after this result
decisions.feedback: 混淆行銷節點與光學尺度。
decisions.feedbackEn: This confuses node naming and optical scale.

decisions.text: 只縮小圖片當作解析度改善
decisions.textEn: Shrink the displayed image
decisions.feedback: 顯示縮放沒有改變成像物理。
decisions.feedbackEn: Display scaling does not change imaging physics.

missions.debrief: 比較同一公式與相同假設，才能解釋 NA 的作用。
missions.debriefEn: Compare the same formula and assumptions to isolate NA effects.

missions.title: 焦深預算：高 NA 的代價
missions.titleEn: Focus budget: the cost of higher NA
missions.brief: 在簡化焦深式下計算可用焦深，並判斷對平坦度的要求。
missions.briefEn: Compute simplified depth of focus and consider flatness demands.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 本關 k2=0.5；實際可用窗口需焦點劑量矩陣量測。
evidence.detailEn: This mission uses k2=0.5; a real process window needs a focus-exposure matrix.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 焦深減少時，薄膜厚度、晶圓形貌與調焦誤差要共同配置。
evidence.detailEn: Less focus depth couples film thickness, wafer shape and focus errors.

decisions.text: 量測焦點劑量矩陣再分配誤差
decisions.textEn: Measure a focus-exposure matrix before budgeting
decisions.feedback: 理想式只能提供趨勢與初步尺度。
decisions.feedbackEn: The ideal equation supplies trend and scale only.

decisions.text: 把理想 DOF 當整機保證值
decisions.textEn: Treat ideal DOF as a tool guarantee
decisions.feedback: 未包含光阻、像差與實測窗口。
decisions.feedbackEn: Resist, aberrations and measured windows are omitted.

decisions.text: 重複曝光以抵銷離焦
decisions.textEn: Repeat exposure to cancel defocus
decisions.feedback: 增加劑量不會自動修正離焦影像。
decisions.feedbackEn: More dose does not automatically correct defocus.

missions.debrief: 記錄窗口定義及量測條件，不只交付單一數字。
missions.debriefEn: Record the window definition and measurement conditions, not one number.

missions.title: 套刻異常：隨機項與偏差分開
missions.titleEn: Overlay excursion: separate scatter and bias
missions.brief: 先估算兩個不相關隨機來源的合成標準差。
missions.briefEn: Estimate combined standard deviation from two uncorrelated random sources.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 平台與標記誤差假設不相關；另有固定偏差應單獨估計。
evidence.detailEn: Stage and mark errors are assumed uncorrelated; fixed bias needs a separate estimate.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: RSS 不是最大誤差上限；相關來源需要協方差項。
evidence.detailEn: RSS is not a worst-case bound; correlated sources require covariance.

decisions.text: 分開回報偏差、散布與相關性
decisions.textEn: Report bias, scatter and correlation separately
decisions.feedback: 避免用標準差遮蔽固定偏移。
decisions.feedbackEn: This prevents scatter from hiding systematic offset.

decisions.text: 把 RSS 當保證不會超出的範圍
decisions.textEn: Call RSS a guaranteed error bound
decisions.feedback: 標準差不是絕對界限。
decisions.feedbackEn: Standard deviation is not an absolute bound.

decisions.text: 刪除最大偏差標記
decisions.textEn: Delete the largest-offset mark
decisions.feedback: 必須有有效的排除理由，不能為過關刪值。
decisions.feedbackEn: Exclusion needs evidence, not a passing score.

missions.debrief: 交班保存標記位置、向量殘差與校正版本。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff marker positions, vector residuals and correction version.

missions.title: 光阻事件：光子計數與波動
missions.titleEn: Resist events: photon counts and fluctuations
missions.brief: 使用理想 Poisson 光子數估計相對波動，解釋提高劑量的代價。
missions.briefEn: Use ideal Poisson photon counts to estimate relative fluctuation and discuss dose cost.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假想獨立事件數 N=400；本關沒有把外部曝光劑量直接換成吸收事件。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic independent-event count N=400; incident dose is not directly converted to absorbed events.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 光阻反應、酸擴散與缺陷相關性可使實際結果偏離 Poisson。
evidence.detailEn: Resist chemistry, diffusion and correlated defects can deviate from Poisson behavior.

decisions.text: 比較缺陷率與產能後選劑量範圍
decisions.textEn: Compare defect rate and throughput before choosing a dose range
decisions.feedback: 波動減少要與產能、材料反應共同驗證。
decisions.feedbackEn: Lower fluctuation must be checked against throughput and chemistry.

decisions.text: 宣稱 N 翻倍雜訊減半
decisions.textEn: Claim doubled N halves noise
decisions.feedback: 平方根關係只讓雜訊降為原來的 1/√2。
decisions.feedbackEn: The square-root law gives a factor of 1/√2.

decisions.text: 只展示成功圖案
decisions.textEn: Show only successful patterns
decisions.feedback: 缺陷統計需要包含失敗與抽樣規則。
decisions.feedbackEn: Defect statistics require failures and sampling rules.

missions.debrief: 此式是機率入門模型，不是 EUV 缺陷率預測器。
missions.debriefEn: This is an introductory probability model, not an EUV defect predictor.

missions.title: 圖形修正：校準資料不能洩漏
missions.brief: 以保留圖形的印出偏差驗證一次線性修正。
missions.briefEn: Use held-out pattern bias to evaluate a single linear correction.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 教學偏差 6 nm；修正模型的斜率暫設 1，並非真實 OPC 模型。
evidence.detailEn: Teaching bias is 6 nm; correction slope is set to one, not a real OPC model.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 訓練標靶與保留驗證圖形不可混為同一組。
evidence.detailEn: Training targets and held-out validation patterns must remain distinct.

decisions.text: 用保留圖形檢驗修正後殘差
decisions.textEn: Validate corrected residuals on held-out patterns
decisions.feedback: 獨立樣本才能檢查模型泛化。
decisions.feedbackEn: Independent patterns test generalization.

decisions.text: 拿訓練殘差當驗證成績
decisions.textEn: Report training residual as validation
decisions.feedback: 可能只是過度配適。
decisions.feedbackEn: This may only measure overfitting.

decisions.text: 把所有圖形套同一偏移
decisions.textEn: Apply one offset to every pattern
decisions.feedback: 幾何相依與鄰近效應會被忽略。
decisions.feedbackEn: Geometry dependence and proximity effects are ignored.

missions.debrief: 保留模型版本、標靶分割與未通過圖形清單。
missions.debriefEn: Keep model version, data split and failing-pattern list.

missions.title: 光阻塗佈：中心到邊緣復核
missions.brief: 塗佈站報告厚度極差偏大，先用統一定義計算相對極差。
missions.briefEn: The coat station reports excessive thickness spread; compute relative range with a consistent definition.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 本局允許極差比例不大於 6.1%，只是教學目標；分母是兩個端點的平均，不假裝是整片厚度平均。
evidence.detailEn: The game accepts a range fraction at most 6.1%, a learning target only; the denominator is the two-endpoint mean, not a whole-wafer mean.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 無法從潔淨室照片判斷奈米級厚度，必須依賴量測。
evidence.detailEn: Nanometer thickness cannot be read from a cleanroom photograph; metrology is required.

decisions.text: 重測厚度圖並保留曝光窗口連結
decisions.textEn: Repeat the map and link it to the exposure window
decisions.feedback: 塗佈與曝光品質需要跨站比較。
decisions.feedbackEn: Coating and exposure quality require cross-station evidence.

decisions.text: 用最漂亮的中心點代表整片
decisions.textEn: Use the best center point for the whole wafer
decisions.feedback: 忽略邊緣會隱藏不均勻。
decisions.feedbackEn: Ignoring the edge hides nonuniformity.

decisions.text: 把百分比四捨五入成零
decisions.textEn: Round the percentage to zero
decisions.feedback: 改格式不是改善製程。
decisions.feedbackEn: Formatting is not process improvement.

missions.debrief: 交班保留厚度圖、量測模型與後續曝光影響。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff the thickness map, measurement model and exposure implications.

campaigns.scope: 原創教學值班情境；數值、門檻與事件為明示假設，不能用作量產配方、設備操作授權或工廠驗收。照片是附署名的代表實拍；遊戲站點為示意配置，非照片中儀器的自動辨識。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original educational shift scenario. Values, thresholds and events are explicit assumptions, not production recipes, equipment authorization or factory acceptance. Credited photographs are representative; game stations are schematic placements, not automatic recognition of photographed instruments.
campaigns.sourceScope: 來源提供原理與方法背景，不代表本局假想數值或門檻取自來源，也不代表來源機構認證本遊戲。
campaigns.sourceScopeEn: Sources provide principles and methods; synthetic game values and thresholds are not attributed to them, and no source institution endorses this game.

campaigns.title: 電漿與薄膜：深度、覆蓋與端點
campaigns.titleEn: Plasma and films: depth, coverage and endpoint
campaigns.brief: 在蝕刻與沉積站之間移交試片，以深度、遮罩、覆蓋與訊號證據追查異常。
campaigns.briefEn: Move coupons between etch and deposition, investigating anomalies through depth, mask, coverage and signal evidence.

photo.title: Alabama Huntsville 反應式離子蝕刻設備
photo.titleEn: Reactive-ion etcher at Alabama Huntsville
photo.author: AlabamaUSA

stations.title: 蝕刻站
stations.description: 深度、選擇性與自限制
stations.descriptionEn: Depth, selectivity and self-limiting cycles

stations.title: 薄膜站
stations.description: 覆蓋、連續性與完整週期
stations.descriptionEn: Coverage, continuity and full cycles

stations.title: 端點分析
stations.description: 背景、雜訊與延遲
stations.descriptionEn: Baseline, noise and latency

missions.title: 蝕刻深度：先校準速率
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 等速假設下目標深度 200 nm；速率由獨立試片估計。
evidence.detailEn: A constant-rate approximation targets 200 nm; rate comes from an independent coupon.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 開口深寬比、局部負載與鈍化會使真實速率改變。
evidence.detailEn: Aspect ratio, local loading and passivation can change real rate.

decisions.text: 以截面或深度量測驗證
decisions.textEn: Verify with section or depth metrology
decisions.feedback: 時間估計要回到實際深度證據。
decisions.feedbackEn: A time estimate must return to depth evidence.

decisions.text: 只憑計時器宣稱深度正確
decisions.textEn: Declare correct depth from the timer
decisions.feedback: 未檢查速率漂移與微負載。
decisions.feedbackEn: Rate drift and microloading are unchecked.

decisions.text: 全片加倍時間後再看
decisions.textEn: Double time across every wafer
decisions.feedback: 可能過蝕刻且消耗遮罩。
decisions.feedbackEn: This can overetch and consume the mask.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 遮罩壽命：選擇性預算
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 移除量 300 nm、目標／遮罩速率比 20，理想遮罩損失 15 nm。
evidence.detailEn: Removing 300 nm at target-to-mask rate ratio 20 gives ideal mask loss 15 nm.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 選擇性方向必須寫清楚；起始遮罩厚度與不均勻尚需另外預留。
evidence.detailEn: State the ratio direction; initial mask thickness and nonuniformity need separate margins.

decisions.text: 保留剩餘遮罩並檢查輪廓
decisions.textEn: Retain mask reserve and inspect profiles
decisions.feedback: 平均選擇性不會保證每個位置都有足夠遮罩。
decisions.feedbackEn: Mean selectivity cannot guarantee reserve everywhere.

decisions.text: 把選擇性倒數代入但保留原標籤
decisions.textEn: Invert the ratio without relabeling
decisions.feedback: 將完全改變損失估計。
decisions.feedbackEn: This fundamentally changes the loss estimate.

decisions.text: 只增加遮罩厚度而不查輪廓
decisions.textEn: Thicken the mask without checking profiles
decisions.feedback: 厚遮罩也可能影響圖形轉移。
decisions.feedbackEn: A thicker mask can affect pattern transfer.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 原子層蝕刻：循環與飽和
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 示意每循環移除 0.2 nm；假設已在自限制視窗內。
evidence.detailEn: Illustrative removal is 0.2 nm/cycle within a verified self-limiting window.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 需檢查改質、移除兩半循環及寄生連續蝕刻，不能只看線性總量。
evidence.detailEn: Check modification, removal half-cycles and parasitic continuous etching, not only linear total removal.

decisions.text: 驗證半循環飽和與對照試片
decisions.textEn: Verify half-cycle saturation and controls
decisions.feedback: 才能支持循環式自限制的假設。
decisions.feedbackEn: This supports the self-limiting-cycle assumption.

decisions.text: 將任何脈衝蝕刻都叫 ALE
decisions.textEn: Call any pulsed etch ALE
decisions.feedback: 脈衝形式不等於自限制反應。
decisions.feedbackEn: Pulses do not establish self-limiting chemistry.

decisions.text: 只增加循環數掩蓋漂移
decisions.textEn: Add cycles to hide drift
decisions.feedback: 總量可能正確但表面損傷仍未釐清。
decisions.feedbackEn: Total removal may pass while damage remains unresolved.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 薄膜覆蓋：底部不等於頂部
missions.titleEn: Film coverage: bottom is not top
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 同一截面頂部 100 nm，底部需接近頂部；比例僅為本關覆蓋指標。
evidence.detailEn: The same section has a 100 nm top film; bottom thickness should approach it. The ratio is this mission’s coverage metric.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 兩點厚度不能證明整個孔側壁連續，也不能排除中段夾縫。
evidence.detailEn: Two thicknesses cannot prove continuous sidewalls or exclude a seam midway.

decisions.text: 取得多深度截面與連續性證據
decisions.textEn: Obtain multi-depth sections and continuity evidence
decisions.feedback: 將局部厚度與完整形貌分開驗證。
decisions.feedbackEn: Validate local thickness separately from full morphology.

decisions.text: 頂部合格就放行高深寬比孔
decisions.textEn: Release high-aspect-ratio features from top thickness
decisions.feedback: 底部與中段仍可能不合格。
decisions.feedbackEn: Bottom and middle sections may still fail.

decisions.text: 反覆量同一頂部點
decisions.textEn: Remeasure the same top spot
decisions.feedback: 無法補足深度方向資訊。
decisions.feedbackEn: This adds no depth information.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 端點訊號：確認背景與延遲
missions.titleEn: Endpoint signal: verify baseline and latency
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假想原始訊號 100 a.u.、匹配背景 40 a.u.，校正後應為 60。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic raw signal is 100 a.u. and matched baseline 40, leaving 60.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 背景不是可任意調整的過關旋鈕；需由遮光／空白與相同設定獨立取得。
evidence.detailEn: Baseline is not an arbitrary passing knob; obtain it independently from a matched blank or dark measurement.

decisions.text: 將空白、濾波延遲與截面比對
decisions.textEn: Compare blank, filter latency and sections
decisions.feedback: 訊號變化需連結材料界面與停止延遲。
decisions.feedbackEn: Signal change must be linked to interface and stop latency.

decisions.text: 把一次尖峰當成可靠端點
decisions.textEn: Treat one spike as a reliable endpoint
decisions.feedback: 瞬態干擾未被排除。
decisions.feedbackEn: Transient interference has not been excluded.

decisions.text: 加強平滑但不記錄延遲
decisions.textEn: Smooth heavily without recording delay
decisions.feedback: 可能使停止過晚。
decisions.feedbackEn: This can delay stopping.

missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 示意批次 100 片、完整週期 3 h、可用率 0.9；不代表某型 LPCVD 機台。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic batch 100 wafers, full cycle 3 h and availability 0.9; no LPCVD tool specification is implied.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 週期需含裝卸與必要等待；不可以刪掉保養時間使可用率變漂亮。
evidence.detailEn: Cycle includes handling and required waits; do not erase maintenance to improve availability on paper.

model.formula: Effective wafers/h = batch × availability / cycle hours
model.formulaEn: Effective wafers/h = batch × availability / cycle hours

decisions.text: 同時交付品質與完整週期統計
decisions.textEn: Handoff quality and full-cycle statistics
decisions.feedback: 產能不可脫離厚度、缺陷與維護情境。
decisions.feedbackEn: Capacity cannot be separated from film quality and maintenance.

decisions.text: 為衝產出跳過必要保養
decisions.textEn: Skip required maintenance for output
decisions.feedback: 可能引發污染與失控，遊戲扣安全分。
decisions.feedbackEn: This risks contamination and loss of control.

decisions.text: 只比較單片反應時間
decisions.textEn: Compare only per-wafer reaction time
decisions.feedback: 忽略批次裝卸與等待。
decisions.feedbackEn: Handling and waiting disappear from the comparison.

missions.title: 互連線：幾何與電阻
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假想均勻矩形線，ρ=0.02 Ω·μm；不包含尺寸效應與接點。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic uniform rectangular line, ρ=0.02 Ω·μm; size effects and contacts are excluded.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 縮小截面會提高電阻；材料比較也需納入襯層占去的有效截面。
evidence.detailEn: Smaller cross-section raises resistance; material comparisons must include area lost to liners.

decisions.text: 比對有效截面與四線量測
decisions.textEn: Compare effective area and four-wire measurements
decisions.feedback: 可避免把接點或襯層效應誤歸給材料。
decisions.feedbackEn: This avoids assigning contact or liner effects to bulk material.

decisions.text: 直接套用塊材電阻率宣稱奈米線精準值
decisions.textEn: Claim nanoscale accuracy from bulk resistivity
decisions.feedback: 尺寸、界面與溫度效應被忽略。
decisions.feedbackEn: Size, interface and temperature effects are omitted.

decisions.text: 刪去所有襯層以增加截面
decisions.textEn: Remove every liner to gain area
decisions.feedback: 擴散阻障與附著功能不能忽略。
decisions.feedbackEn: Diffusion-barrier and adhesion functions matter.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 低 k 介電：電容與機械取捨
missions.titleEn: Low-k dielectric: capacitance and mechanical tradeoffs
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 理想平行板近似，忽略邊緣場；μm 單位換算後輸出 fF。
evidence.detailEn: Ideal parallel plates omit fringing; μm units convert to fF.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 較低 k 可降低此模型電容，但孔隙、強度與蝕刻損傷也需檢查。
evidence.detailEn: Lower k reduces this model capacitance; porosity, strength and etch damage still need checks.

decisions.text: 同時驗證 k、強度與損傷
decisions.textEn: Check k, strength and damage together
decisions.feedback: 單一電容指標不足以選介電材料。
decisions.feedbackEn: Capacitance alone cannot select a dielectric.

decisions.text: 只取最低 k 當唯一目標
decisions.textEn: Choose solely the lowest k
decisions.feedback: 機械與整合風險未被考慮。
decisions.feedbackEn: Mechanical and integration risks are omitted.

decisions.text: 以晶圓顏色判定介電常數
decisions.textEn: Infer permittivity from wafer color
decisions.feedback: 顏色受膜厚與光學干涉影響，無法唯一反推 k。
decisions.feedbackEn: Color depends on thickness and optical interference, not uniquely on k.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 電鍍填孔：先核對電荷
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假想恆流 0.4 A、50 s 得 20 C；本關只核對電荷，不換算實際銅厚。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic constant current 0.4 A for 50 s gives 20 C; this checks charge only, not actual copper thickness.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 電流效率、有效面積、添加劑與傳質影響沉積分佈。相同總電荷不保證無空洞。
evidence.detailEn: Current efficiency, active area, additives and transport affect deposition; equal charge does not prove void-free fill.

decisions.text: 將電荷與截面填孔證據配對
decisions.textEn: Pair charge with fill-section evidence
decisions.feedback: 電荷收支與形貌必須分開驗證。
decisions.feedbackEn: Charge balance and morphology need separate validation.

decisions.text: 總電荷正確就宣稱填孔完整
decisions.textEn: Declare complete fill from charge alone
decisions.feedback: 可能表面過鍍而孔內有空洞。
decisions.feedbackEn: Surface overplating can coexist with internal voids.

decisions.text: 提高電流以跳過截面檢查
decisions.textEn: Raise current to skip sections
decisions.feedback: 較快不代表較均勻或無缺陷。
decisions.feedbackEn: Faster does not mean more uniform or defect-free.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: CMP：剩餘厚度與過磨
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 起始厚度 500 nm、線性局部速率 100 nm/min；目標剩餘 200 nm。
evidence.detailEn: Initial thickness 500 nm and local linear rate 100 nm/min; target remaining thickness 200 nm.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 此式不含圖形密度、dishing、erosion、墊老化與停止層選擇性。
evidence.detailEn: Pattern density, dishing, erosion, pad aging and stop-layer selectivity are absent.

decisions.text: 比較厚度圖與圖形區凹陷
decisions.textEn: Compare thickness map and patterned-area recess
decisions.feedback: 平均剩餘厚度不能代替圖形平坦度。
decisions.feedbackEn: Mean remaining thickness cannot replace pattern flatness.

decisions.text: 只測空白區就放行圖形晶圓
decisions.textEn: Release patterned wafers using blanket data only
decisions.feedback: 圖形密度與局部移除可能不同。
decisions.feedbackEn: Pattern density and local removal can differ.

decisions.text: 過磨後把負厚度截成零交班
decisions.textEn: Clamp a negative thickness to zero in the report
decisions.feedback: 這掩蓋模型超出適用範圍與過磨事件。
decisions.feedbackEn: This hides overpolish and a model-domain violation.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 可靠度：電流密度與熱點
missions.titleEn: Reliability: current density and hot spots
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 1 mA／μm² = 0.1 MA/cm²；本關只算平均截面電流密度。
evidence.detailEn: 1 mA/μm² equals 0.1 MA/cm²; this mission computes average cross-sectional current density.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 通孔附近電流擁擠與局部溫升不由平均 J 描述；不能以此直接推壽命。
evidence.detailEn: Via current crowding and local heating are not captured by mean J; no lifetime follows directly.

decisions.text: 加入溫度與失效位置分析
decisions.textEn: Add temperature and failure-location analysis
decisions.feedback: 電遷移判讀需幾何、溫度與時間證據。
decisions.feedbackEn: Electromigration needs geometry, temperature and time evidence.

decisions.text: 把低平均 J 當終身不會失效
decisions.textEn: Treat low mean J as lifetime immunity
decisions.feedback: 局部熱點與缺陷仍可能控制失效。
decisions.feedbackEn: Local hot spots and defects may dominate failure.

decisions.text: 只刪除早期失效樣本
decisions.textEn: Delete early failures
decisions.feedback: 會扭曲可靠度估計與失效機制。
decisions.feedbackEn: This biases reliability estimates and mechanisms.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 介電壽命：場與厚度單位
missions.titleEn: Dielectric lifetime: field and thickness units
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 1 V/nm = 10 MV/cm；假想均勻場，不含邊緣增強。
evidence.detailEn: 1 V/nm = 10 MV/cm; the field is uniform with no edge enhancement.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: TDDB 外推需加速模型、溫度、面積與截尾樣本處理；場值不是壽命。
evidence.detailEn: TDDB extrapolation needs an acceleration model, temperature, area and censoring treatment; field is not lifetime.

decisions.text: 保存場值與完整時間失效資料
decisions.textEn: Retain field and complete time-to-failure data
decisions.feedback: 有了模型假設才能討論外推。
decisions.feedbackEn: Extrapolation needs explicit model assumptions.

decisions.text: 把一顆未崩潰當所有晶粒合格
decisions.textEn: Use one survivor to clear every die
decisions.feedback: 抽樣與觀測時間不足以支持此結論。
decisions.feedbackEn: Sampling and observation duration do not support the claim.

decisions.text: 忽略未失效的截尾樣本
decisions.textEn: Ignore censored survivors
decisions.feedback: 會偏移時間失效分布。
decisions.feedbackEn: This biases the time-to-failure distribution.

missions.title: DRAM：電荷與讀取訊號
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: fC/fF 得到 V；理想單一電容，未包含位線電荷分享。
evidence.detailEn: fC/fF yields V; one ideal capacitor, without bitline charge sharing.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 儲存節點電壓不等於感測放大器實際輸入訊號。
evidence.detailEn: Storage-node voltage is not the actual sense-amplifier input signal.

decisions.text: 補位線電容與漏電保持測試
decisions.textEn: Add bitline capacitance and retention tests
decisions.feedback: 需將儲存、讀取與保持三個問題分開。
decisions.feedbackEn: Storage, reading and retention are distinct.

decisions.text: 直接把儲存節點電壓當讀取裕量
decisions.textEn: Call node voltage the read margin
decisions.feedback: 忽略位線分享與雜訊。
decisions.feedbackEn: Bitline sharing and noise are omitted.

decisions.text: 只增加電容不檢查幾何
decisions.textEn: Increase capacitance without checking geometry
decisions.feedback: 面積、深寬比與機械穩定仍有限制。
decisions.feedbackEn: Area, aspect ratio and mechanical stability impose limits.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。

missions.title: 非揮發記憶體：窗口與分佈
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假想兩個狀態平均值差 2 V；不同記憶體的實際讀出物理量可為電阻或其他量，不能套同一配方。
evidence.detailEn: A synthetic two-state voltage window is 2 V. Actual memory readouts may use resistance or other quantities; recipes are not shared.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 平均值差不能證明分佈不重疊；還需要變異、循環與保持時間。
evidence.detailEn: Separated means do not prove nonoverlapping distributions; variation, cycling and retention matter.

decisions.text: 檢查分佈尾端與時間漂移
decisions.textEn: Inspect distribution tails and time drift
decisions.feedback: 應以讀取錯誤與狀態穩定性驗證窗口。
decisions.feedbackEn: Validate the window through read errors and state stability.

decisions.text: 只列兩個平均值就保證零錯誤
decisions.textEn: Guarantee zero errors from two means
decisions.feedback: 分佈尾端仍可能重疊。
decisions.feedbackEn: Distribution tails can still overlap.

decisions.text: 把不同記憶體數據混合求平均
decisions.textEn: Average data across different memory types
decisions.feedback: 不同機制與單位不可混為一群。
decisions.feedbackEn: Different mechanisms and units cannot form one population.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 保持時間：漏電與可用電荷
missions.titleEn: Retention time: leakage and usable charge
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 1 fC / 1 pA = 1 ms；定漏電模型，未包含隨溫度與偏壓變化。
evidence.detailEn: 1 fC / 1 pA = 1 ms; leakage is constant with no temperature or bias dependence.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 此時間是指定電荷損失尺度，不等同產品保證資料保存年限。
evidence.detailEn: This is a specified charge-loss timescale, not guaranteed product data-retention years.

decisions.text: 跨溫度量測並記錄讀取門檻
decisions.textEn: Measure across temperatures and record read threshold
decisions.feedback: 保持需明確定義失敗條件。
decisions.feedbackEn: Retention requires an explicit failure criterion.

decisions.text: 把算例 50 ms 當商品規格
decisions.textEn: Advertise the 50 ms example as a product specification
decisions.feedback: 數值為教學假設而非實測驗收。
decisions.feedbackEn: These are learning assumptions, not qualification data.

decisions.text: 把漏電設成零以取得無限壽命
decisions.textEn: Set leakage to zero for infinite life
decisions.feedback: 模型參數不能取代實驗證據。
decisions.feedbackEn: A model parameter cannot replace experimental evidence.

missions.title: 影像感測：訊號與光子雜訊
missions.titleEn: Image sensing: signal and shot noise
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 理想獨立電子計數，訊號 N、標準差 √N，忽略讀出與暗雜訊。
evidence.detailEn: Ideal independent electron counts have signal N and deviation √N; read and dark noise are omitted.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 曝光增加可能提升 N，但也有飽和、動態模糊與暗訊號代價。
evidence.detailEn: Longer exposure may increase N but can cause saturation, motion blur and dark signal.

decisions.text: 將讀出雜訊與飽和測試補齊
decisions.textEn: Add read-noise and saturation tests
decisions.feedback: 理想 shot-noise 極限不是整機 SNR。
decisions.feedbackEn: The shot-noise limit is not total-system SNR.

decisions.text: 忽略飽和持續增加曝光
decisions.textEn: Increase exposure while ignoring saturation
decisions.feedback: 飽和後不能線性增加有效訊號。
decisions.feedbackEn: Useful signal no longer scales linearly after saturation.

decisions.text: 把影像亮度當校準電子數
decisions.textEn: Use display brightness as electron count
decisions.feedback: 顯示增益與色調映射會改變外觀。
decisions.feedbackEn: Display gain and tone mapping alter appearance.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: SPAD：死時間下的觀測速率
missions.titleEn: SPAD: observed rate with dead time
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 使用非延展死時間模型；λ=2 counts/μs、τ=0.1 μs。
evidence.detailEn: Use a nonparalyzable dead-time model with λ=2 counts/μs and τ=0.1 μs.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: afterpulsing、串擾與延展型偵測器不符合這個簡式。
evidence.detailEn: Afterpulsing, crosstalk and paralyzable detectors are outside this model.

decisions.text: 標示模型並以多速率資料驗證
decisions.textEn: Label the model and validate at several rates
decisions.feedback: 可檢查死時間模型是否適用。
decisions.feedbackEn: This tests whether the dead-time model applies.

decisions.text: 以觀測速率當完全無損的真實速率
decisions.textEn: Treat observed rate as lossless true rate
decisions.feedback: 死時間會造成漏計。
decisions.feedbackEn: Dead time causes lost counts.

decisions.text: 混用延展與非延展公式
decisions.textEn: Mix paralyzable and nonparalyzable formulas
decisions.feedback: 兩種機制的高計數響應不同。
decisions.feedbackEn: The mechanisms have different high-rate responses.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 感測交班：增益與雜訊不得混算
missions.titleEn: Sensor handoff: do not mix gain and noise
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 示意輸入 50 電子、增益 10，平均輸出 500；未計倍增雜訊。
evidence.detailEn: Illustrative input 50 electrons and gain 10 yield mean output 500; multiplication noise is omitted.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: APD 倍增也可能增加雜訊；平均訊號增大不等於 SNR 同比改善。
evidence.detailEn: APD multiplication may add noise; greater mean signal does not imply proportional SNR improvement.

decisions.text: 交付增益、雜訊與溫度條件
decisions.textEn: Handoff gain, noise and temperature conditions
decisions.feedback: 才可比較不同偏壓與感測器。
decisions.feedbackEn: These permit comparison across bias conditions and sensors.

decisions.text: 把 10 倍增益稱作 10 倍 SNR
decisions.textEn: Call gain ten a tenfold SNR improvement
decisions.feedback: 忽略倍增雜訊與其他噪聲。
decisions.feedbackEn: Multiplication and other noise are omitted.

decisions.text: 只保留最高增益的一點
decisions.textEn: Keep only the maximum-gain point
decisions.feedback: 無法判斷工作區間與穩定性。
decisions.feedbackEn: Operating range and stability cannot be assessed.

missions.title: 功率元件：熱路徑而非只看能隙
missions.titleEn: Power devices: thermal paths, not bandgap alone
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假想穩態單一熱阻，10 W、4 °C/W、30 °C 環境給 70 °C。
evidence.detailEn: A synthetic steady single thermal resistance, 10 W, 4 °C/W and 30 °C ambient gives 70 °C.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 忽略瞬態與局部熱點；材料寬能隙不直接等於良好導熱。
evidence.detailEn: Transients and local hot spots are omitted; wide bandgap does not itself imply good thermal conductivity.

decisions.text: 檢查熱邊界與瞬態曲線
decisions.textEn: Check thermal boundary and transient curves
decisions.feedback: 熱路徑需連到封裝與散熱環境。
decisions.feedbackEn: The thermal path includes packaging and cooling conditions.

decisions.text: 以寬能隙宣稱不需散熱
decisions.textEn: Claim wide bandgap eliminates cooling
decisions.feedback: 耗散功率仍需排出。
decisions.feedbackEn: Dissipated power still needs removal.

decisions.text: 只降低圖上的溫度標籤
decisions.textEn: Lower only the temperature label
decisions.feedback: 不會改變功率或熱阻。
decisions.feedbackEn: This changes neither power nor thermal resistance.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 導通損耗：電流平方的代價
missions.titleEn: Conduction loss: the cost of current squared
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假想 I=10 A、Ron=0.03 Ω；只含直流導通，不含切換與驅動損耗。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic I=10 A and Ron=0.03 Ω; DC conduction only, without switching or drive loss.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: Ron 隨溫度與偏壓變化；不能在不同條件下任意比較材料。
evidence.detailEn: Ron changes with temperature and bias; materials cannot be compared under arbitrary conditions.

decisions.text: 加上切換與溫度相依資料
decisions.textEn: Add switching and temperature-dependent data
decisions.feedback: 完整效率需要多個損耗項。
decisions.feedbackEn: Total efficiency requires multiple loss terms.

decisions.text: 把導通損耗等同全部損耗
decisions.textEn: Equate conduction with all losses
decisions.feedback: 高頻切換可能有不同主導項。
decisions.feedbackEn: High-frequency switching may be dominated by other terms.

decisions.text: 把電流減半後宣稱材料改善
decisions.textEn: Halve current and claim better material
decisions.feedback: 負載條件改變而非材料被驗證改善。
decisions.feedbackEn: The load changed; material improvement was not shown.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 二維通道：片電阻與接觸分開
missions.titleEn: Two-dimensional channel: separate sheet and contacts
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 單載子 Drude 近似、q 為基本電荷；片密度使用 cm⁻² 配合 cm²/(V·s)。
evidence.detailEn: Single-carrier Drude approximation with elementary charge q; cm⁻² pairs with cm²/(V·s).

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 多載子、晶界、陷阱與接觸不一定符合此模型。
evidence.detailEn: Multiple carriers, grain boundaries, traps and contacts may violate this model.

decisions.text: 用 Hall 與四線結構互相檢查
decisions.textEn: Cross-check Hall and four-wire structures
decisions.feedback: 可避免接觸支配的兩端電阻誤判片電阻。
decisions.feedbackEn: This avoids mistaking contact-dominated two-terminal resistance for sheet resistance.

decisions.text: 以兩端電阻直接當片電阻
decisions.textEn: Treat two-terminal resistance as sheet resistance
decisions.feedback: 尚未處理幾何與接觸貢獻。
decisions.feedbackEn: Geometry and contacts remain unaccounted for.

decisions.text: 將 cm⁻² 當 m⁻² 不換算
decisions.textEn: Substitute cm⁻² for m⁻² without conversion
decisions.feedback: 單位不一致會造成巨大尺度錯誤。
decisions.feedbackEn: Inconsistent units cause a large scale error.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: LED：光電輸出與電力收支
missions.titleEn: LED: optical output and electrical balance
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假想光功率 0.5 W、電流 0.5 A、電壓 3 V；輸出約 33.3%。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic optical power 0.5 W, current 0.5 A and voltage 3 V give about 33.3%.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 光功率需校準且涵蓋指定收光立體角；不是光度流明，也不是內部量子效率。
evidence.detailEn: Optical power needs calibration and a defined collection solid angle; it is neither lumens nor internal quantum efficiency.

decisions.text: 註明積分球與收光校準條件
decisions.textEn: Record integrating-sphere and collection calibration
decisions.feedback: 電光效率需可比的量測邊界。
decisions.feedbackEn: Electro-optical efficiency needs comparable boundaries.

decisions.text: 以肉眼亮度代替光功率
decisions.textEn: Replace optical power with apparent brightness
decisions.feedback: 人眼光譜響應不同於能量功率。
decisions.feedbackEn: Eye spectral response differs from energy power.

decisions.text: 把內部效率當外部電光效率
decisions.textEn: Substitute internal for wall-plug efficiency
decisions.feedback: 忽略取光與電力轉換損失。
decisions.feedbackEn: Extraction and electrical conversion losses are omitted.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: MEMS：質量與彈簧的共振
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 單自由度、線性、小振幅、未阻尼近似；m=4×10⁻⁷ kg。
evidence.detailEn: A single-degree, linear, small-amplitude, undamped approximation with m=4×10⁻⁷ kg.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 實際共振受阻尼、殘留應力、錨點與模態耦合影響。
evidence.detailEn: Real resonance depends on damping, residual stress, anchors and mode coupling.

decisions.text: 比較頻率掃描與多模態模型
decisions.textEn: Compare frequency sweeps and multimode models
decisions.feedback: 單一公式可做初估，仍需模式識別。
decisions.feedbackEn: One formula estimates scale; mode identification remains necessary.

decisions.text: 把所有峰都稱作同一共振模態
decisions.textEn: Call every peak the same mode
decisions.feedback: 可能存在不同振形與耦合。
decisions.feedbackEn: Different shapes and couplings may be present.

decisions.text: 只增加剛度忽略感測靈敏度
decisions.textEn: Increase stiffness ignoring sensitivity
decisions.feedback: 頻率與位移靈敏度存在取捨。
decisions.feedbackEn: Frequency and displacement sensitivity trade off.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 背板保持：RC 時間常數
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: MΩ×nF = ms；理想 RC 一階模型，假想 τ=50 ms。
evidence.detailEn: MΩ × nF = ms; an ideal first-order RC model with synthetic τ=50 ms.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: τ 不是可接受保持時間本身；還需指定容許電壓衰減與更新週期。
evidence.detailEn: τ is not itself acceptable hold time; allowable voltage droop and refresh period must be specified.

decisions.text: 先定義容許衰減再比對更新週期
decisions.textEn: Define allowable droop then compare refresh period
decisions.feedback: 時間常數需轉成可驗證的顯示要求。
decisions.feedbackEn: A time constant must map to a testable display requirement.

decisions.text: 把一個 τ 當完全不漏電時間
decisions.textEn: Treat one τ as zero-leakage duration
decisions.feedback: 一個 τ 後理想電壓已衰減到初值的 e⁻¹。
decisions.feedbackEn: After one τ ideal voltage has fallen to e⁻¹ of its initial value.

decisions.text: 只看最大漏電阻忽略分佈
decisions.textEn: Look only at maximum leakage resistance
decisions.feedback: 陣列最弱像素與溫度漂移仍需分析。
decisions.feedbackEn: Weak pixels and thermal drift still need analysis.

missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 量測接力：合成標準不確定度
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 兩個已換成同一量綱的標準不確定度、敏感度係數皆 1，且不相關。
evidence.detailEn: Two standard uncertainties share one unit, sensitivity coefficients are one and sources are uncorrelated.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: uc 不是保證誤差界限；相關性、覆蓋因子與自由度需另行處理。
evidence.detailEn: uc is not a guaranteed error bound; correlation, coverage factor and degrees of freedom need separate treatment.

decisions.text: 附不確定度預算與適用條件
decisions.textEn: Attach an uncertainty budget and conditions
decisions.feedback: 可重建每個分量及相關性假設。
decisions.feedbackEn: Each component and correlation assumption becomes traceable.

decisions.text: 把儀器解析度直接當全部不確定度
decisions.textEn: Use instrument resolution as all uncertainty
decisions.feedback: 校準、重複性與模型分量仍存在。
decisions.feedbackEn: Calibration, repeatability and model terms remain.

decisions.text: 挑較小分量而不合成
decisions.textEn: Keep only the smaller component
decisions.feedback: 會低估測量不確定度。
decisions.feedbackEn: This underestimates measurement uncertainty.

missions.title: 能力指標：穩定後才比較規格
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假想規格 97–103 nm；穩定近常態資料才使用此教學 Cpk。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic specification 97–103 nm; this Cpk exercise assumes stable approximately normal data.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 規格界限與管制界限不同；Cpk 高不證明製程統計穩定。
evidence.detailEn: Specification and control limits differ; high Cpk does not establish statistical stability.

decisions.text: 先檢查管制圖再回報 Cpk
decisions.textEn: Inspect control charts before reporting Cpk
decisions.feedback: 能力比較應建立在可理解的穩定資料上。
decisions.feedbackEn: Capability comparisons need understood, stable data.

decisions.text: 用規格界限取代管制界限
decisions.textEn: Replace control limits with specification limits
decisions.feedback: 將客戶允收與歷史變異混為一談。
decisions.feedbackEn: This confuses customer acceptance with historical variation.

decisions.text: 刪除所有離群值再算漂亮 Cpk
decisions.textEn: Delete all outliers for a higher Cpk
decisions.feedback: 原因未查明便刪值會扭曲結論。
decisions.feedbackEn: Unexplained deletions bias the conclusion.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 缺陷與晶粒面積：良率尺度
missions.titleEn: Defect density and die area: yield scale
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假設獨立、空間均勻、每個致命缺陷使一顆晶粒失效；D=0.1 cm⁻²、A=1 cm²。
evidence.detailEn: Assume independent uniform fatal defects, each killing a die; D=0.1 cm⁻² and A=1 cm².

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 真實缺陷可能群聚、非致命或與版圖相依；此式不是企業公布良率。
evidence.detailEn: Real defects may cluster, be benign or depend on layout; this is not any company’s reported yield.

decisions.text: 比對缺陷地圖與電性失效
decisions.textEn: Correlate defect maps and electrical failures
decisions.feedback: 才能確認缺陷分類與致命性假設。
decisions.feedbackEn: This tests classification and fatality assumptions.

decisions.text: 把所有粒子都當致命缺陷
decisions.textEn: Treat every particle as a fatal defect
decisions.feedback: 檢測訊號不等同電性失效。
decisions.feedbackEn: A detected signal is not automatically an electrical failure.

decisions.text: 把算例百分比冠上廠商名稱
decisions.textEn: Attach a manufacturer name to the example
decisions.feedback: 教學數字不能冒充實測企業資訊。
decisions.feedbackEn: Learning values must not impersonate company data.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: OOC 接力：標準化偏移
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 原始 x=104 對基線 100±1 的 z=4；只有獨立重測證據才能更正 x，不能任意調資料。
evidence.detailEn: Original x=104 against baseline 100±1 gives z=4; only independent remeasurement can revise x, not arbitrary data tuning.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 本關的通過範圍是復核樣本練習；真實 OCAP 還需多點規則、時序與量測系統檢查。
evidence.detailEn: The passing range is a recheck exercise; real OCAP also needs run rules, chronology and metrology checks.

decisions.text: 保留原警報並附重測與處置
decisions.textEn: Retain the alarm with recheck and disposition
decisions.feedback: 警報不能因後來正常就刪除。
decisions.feedbackEn: A later normal result does not erase the original alarm.

decisions.text: 擴大基線標準差讓 OOC 消失
decisions.textEn: Widen baseline deviation to erase OOC
decisions.feedback: 改基準掩蓋特殊原因。
decisions.feedbackEn: Changing the baseline hides special causes.

decisions.text: 繼續生產等平均值回來
decisions.textEn: Continue and wait for the mean to return
decisions.feedback: 未執行既定異常處置。
decisions.feedbackEn: The defined abnormal-response process is bypassed.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 虛擬量測：時間切分驗證
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 保留未參與訓練的後續批次，參考量測 100 nm；預測版本可重建。
evidence.detailEn: Hold out later lots from training; reference measurement is 100 nm and prediction version is reproducible.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 單點誤差小不能保證所有批次泛化；需監測域外輸入與漂移。
evidence.detailEn: A small single-point error does not establish generalization; monitor out-of-domain inputs and drift.

decisions.text: 按時間驗證並保留域外警示
decisions.textEn: Validate chronologically and retain OOD alerts
decisions.feedback: 可降低未來資料洩漏造成的樂觀評估。
decisions.feedbackEn: This reduces optimistic evaluation from future-data leakage.

decisions.text: 將同批未來量測放進訓練特徵
decisions.textEn: Use future same-lot measurements as features
decisions.feedback: 預測時尚不存在的資料造成洩漏。
decisions.feedbackEn: Unavailable-at-prediction information leaks into the model.

decisions.text: 只留下誤差最小的批次
decisions.textEn: Keep only the smallest-error lot
decisions.feedback: 無法評估模型分佈與失敗模式。
decisions.feedbackEn: Model error distribution and failures cannot be assessed.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

missions.title: 探針交班：週期與重測代價
missions.titleEn: Probe handoff: cycle time and retest cost
missions.brief: 先查看兩份紀錄，調整教學模型並選擇有證據支持的處置。數值目標只用於本局練習。
missions.briefEn: Inspect both records, tune the teaching model and choose an evidence-supported response. The numeric target belongs only to this exercise.

evidence.title: 觀察紀錄
evidence.detail: 假想每晶粒首測 3 s、20% 晶粒恰重測一次，忽略索引與裝卸時間。
evidence.detailEn: Synthetic first test is 3 s per die; exactly 20% get one retest. Indexing and handling are omitted.

evidence.title: 驗證邊界
evidence.detail: 接觸不良、電流限制與測試程式版本可能造成假失敗，不能直接把重測通過當製程改善。
evidence.detailEn: Poor contact, compliance and program versions can create false failures; a retest pass is not automatically process improvement.

decisions.text: 分開首測良率、重測與最終分箱
decisions.textEn: Separate first-pass yield, retest and final bins
decisions.feedback: 可避免以重測掩蓋不穩定接觸。
decisions.feedbackEn: This prevents retesting from hiding unstable contact.

decisions.text: 重測到通過才保留結果
decisions.textEn: Retest until pass and keep only that result
decisions.feedback: 選擇性留存會高估良率。
decisions.feedbackEn: Selective retention inflates yield.

decisions.text: 為縮時間跳過電流限制
decisions.textEn: Skip compliance to shorten time
decisions.feedback: 可能損傷試片且使資料失真。
decisions.feedbackEn: This can damage the specimen and distort evidence.

missions.debrief: 交班需保留模型假設、原始資料、處置理由與尚未驗證項目。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff retains model assumptions, original evidence, decision rationale and unresolved checks.

campaigns.scope: 原創教學值班情境；數值、門檻與事件為明示假設，不能用作量產配方、設備操作授權或工廠驗收。照片是附署名的代表實拍；遊戲站點為示意配置，非照片中儀器的自動辨識。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original educational shift scenario. Values, thresholds and events are explicit assumptions, not production recipes, equipment authorization or factory acceptance. Credited photographs are representative; game stations are schematic placements, not automatic recognition of photographed instruments.
campaigns.sourceScope: 來源提供原理與方法背景，不代表本局假想數值或門檻取自來源，也不代表來源機構認證本遊戲。
campaigns.sourceScopeEn: Sources provide principles and methods; synthetic game values and thresholds are not attributed to them, and no source institution endorses this game.

campaigns.title: 接合線：失蹤的良率
campaigns.brief: 接手一批封裝試件，釐清異材位移、接點發熱與逐站掉率，交出可追溯的處置單。
campaigns.briefEn: Take over a packaging lot, reconcile thermal mismatch, contact heating and yield loss, and hand off a traceable disposition.

stations.title: 異材接合的熱位移
stations.description: 不同材料自由膨脹量不同；先計算位移差，再討論順應層與幾何配置。
stations.descriptionEn: Different materials expand by different amounts; compute mismatch before discussing compliance and geometry.

stations.title: 導體損耗與電流路徑
stations.description: 先確認回流路徑和接點電阻；電流加倍會使固定電阻的發熱變成四倍。
stations.descriptionEn: Identify the return path and contact resistance. Doubling current quadruples heat at fixed resistance.

stations.title: 定位殘差
stations.description: 殘差是相同座標系下的目標差，先核對零點、方向與工具中心點。
stations.descriptionEn: Residuals compare target and result in one coordinate system; verify origin, direction and tool center point.

stations.title: 逐站良率與重工追蹤
stations.description: 使用相同批次的條件通過率相乘；各站缺陷分母與重工紀錄必須一致。
stations.descriptionEn: Multiply conditional pass fractions for one lot; reconcile defect denominators and rework records.

missions.title: 01 · 異材接合的熱位移
missions.brief: 封裝邊角在冷卻後偏移，中心接點仍對準；交班單卻只列室溫尺寸。 你是封裝整合工程師。本次「接合線：失蹤的良率」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Package corners shift after cooldown while central joints align; the handoff lists only room-temperature dimensions. As package integration engineer in “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 封裝邊角在冷卻後偏移，中心接點仍對準；交班單卻只列室溫尺寸。 不同材料自由膨脹量不同；先計算位移差，再討論順應層與幾何配置。
evidence.detailEn: Package corners shift after cooldown while central joints align; the handoff lists only room-temperature dimensions. Different materials expand by different amounts; compute mismatch before discussing compliance and geometry.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 只計算自由熱位移，不預測焊點壽命、局部應力或翹曲；材料參數均為假設。
evidence.detailEn: Free expansion only; this does not predict solder life, local stress or warpage. Parameters are assumed.

decisions.text: 比較順應接合與較小溫差的方案，保留疲勞試驗需求
decisions.textEn: Compare compliant joints and a smaller temperature swing; retain fatigue testing
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。只計算自由熱位移，不預測焊點壽命、局部應力或翹曲；材料參數均為假設。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Free expansion only; this does not predict solder life, local stress or warpage. Parameters are assumed.

decisions.text: 把自由位移直接當成失效循環數
decisions.textEn: Treat free displacement as a fatigue-life prediction
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。不同材料自由膨脹量不同；先計算位移差，再討論順應層與幾何配置。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Different materials expand by different amounts; compute mismatch before discussing compliance and geometry.

decisions.text: 保留樣品作截面分析，暫不宣稱已找到唯一原因
decisions.textEn: Retain samples for cross-section analysis without claiming a unique cause
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。只計算自由熱位移，不預測焊點壽命、局部應力或翹曲；材料參數均為假設。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Free expansion only; this does not predict solder life, local stress or warpage. Parameters are assumed.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「異材接合的熱位移」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：先進封裝共同設計、晶圓對晶圓混合接合、銅柱微凸塊製作。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Thermal mismatch across a joint” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Advanced Packaging Co-Design, Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding, Copper-pillar microbump fabrication.

missions.title: 02 · 導體損耗與電流路徑
missions.brief: 接合線外觀完整，但同一低壓測試電流下，某接點比相鄰點更熱。 你是封裝整合工程師。本次「接合線：失蹤的良率」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A bond looks intact, yet one contact is hotter than adjacent contacts under the same low-voltage test current. As package integration engineer in “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 接合線外觀完整，但同一低壓測試電流下，某接點比相鄰點更熱。 先確認回流路徑和接點電阻；電流加倍會使固定電阻的發熱變成四倍。
evidence.detailEn: A bond looks intact, yet one contact is hotter than adjacent contacts under the same low-voltage test current. Identify the return path and contact resistance. Doubling current quadruples heat at fixed resistance.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 直流穩態簡化；不含集膚效應、溫升改變電阻或保護協調。
evidence.detailEn: Simplified steady DC model excluding skin effect, temperature-dependent resistance and protection coordination.

decisions.text: 降低負載並比較較低路徑電阻，保留熱點量測
decisions.textEn: Reduce load and compare lower path resistance while retaining hotspot measurement
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。直流穩態簡化；不含集膚效應、溫升改變電阻或保護協調。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Simplified steady DC model excluding skin effect, temperature-dependent resistance and protection coordination.

decisions.text: 只換更大的保險元件，忽略接點發熱
decisions.textEn: Fit a larger protective element while ignoring contact heating
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先確認回流路徑和接點電阻；電流加倍會使固定電阻的發熱變成四倍。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Identify the return path and contact resistance. Doubling current quadruples heat at fixed resistance.

decisions.text: 停止帶電操作，先在隔離的低壓模型檢查接點
decisions.textEn: Stop energized work and inspect contacts on an isolated low-voltage model
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。直流穩態簡化；不含集膚效應、溫升改變電阻或保護協調。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Simplified steady DC model excluding skin effect, temperature-dependent resistance and protection coordination.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「導體損耗與電流路徑」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：先進封裝共同設計、晶圓對晶圓混合接合、銅柱微凸塊製作。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Conductor loss and current path” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Advanced Packaging Co-Design, Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding, Copper-pillar microbump fabrication.

missions.title: 03 · 定位殘差
missions.brief: 貼合後的影像標記看似重合，獨立量測卻出現 X 與 Y 殘差。 你是封裝整合工程師。本次「接合線：失蹤的良率」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Post-bond image marks appear aligned, but independent metrology shows X and Y residuals. As package integration engineer in “The Bonding Line: Lost Yield”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 貼合後的影像標記看似重合，獨立量測卻出現 X 與 Y 殘差。 殘差是相同座標系下的目標差，先核對零點、方向與工具中心點。
evidence.detailEn: Post-bond image marks appear aligned, but independent metrology shows X and Y residuals. Residuals compare target and result in one coordinate system; verify origin, direction and tool center point.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 二維幾何殘差，不代表重複性、絕對精度或機器人安全距離。
evidence.detailEn: Two-dimensional geometric residual, not repeatability, absolute accuracy or robot safeguarding distance.

decisions.text: 先確認座標基準，再獨立量測修正後位置
decisions.textEn: Verify the coordinate datum and independently measure corrected position
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。二維幾何殘差，不代表重複性、絕對精度或機器人安全距離。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Two-dimensional geometric residual, not repeatability, absolute accuracy or robot safeguarding distance.

decisions.text: 把畫面圖示對齊當成實體位置已校正
decisions.textEn: Treat aligned screen icons as calibrated physical position
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。殘差是相同座標系下的目標差，先核對零點、方向與工具中心點。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Residuals compare target and result in one coordinate system; verify origin, direction and tool center point.

decisions.text: 保持致動器停用，使用標準件重建基準
decisions.textEn: Keep actuators disabled and re-establish the datum with a reference artifact
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。二維幾何殘差，不代表重複性、絕對精度或機器人安全距離。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Two-dimensional geometric residual, not repeatability, absolute accuracy or robot safeguarding distance.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「定位殘差」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：先進封裝共同設計、晶圓對晶圓混合接合、銅柱微凸塊製作。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Positioning residual” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Advanced Packaging Co-Design, Wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding, Copper-pillar microbump fabrication.

missions.title: 04 · 逐站良率與重工追蹤
