missions.brief: 接收功率下降發生在換接頭後；光源監測值相同，只有耦合紀錄未保存。 你是光子封裝測試工程師。本次「光引擎：把訊號接回來」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Received power drops after a connector change; source monitoring is unchanged but coupling records were not retained. As photonic package test engineer in “Optical Engine: Restore the Signal”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 接收功率下降發生在換接頭後；光源監測值相同，只有耦合紀錄未保存。 dBm 表示絕對功率，dB 表示損耗比；串接損耗在對數域相加。
evidence.detailEn: Received power drops after a connector change; source monitoring is unchanged but coupling records were not retained. dBm denotes absolute power, while dB denotes a loss ratio. Cascaded losses add in the logarithmic domain.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 不包含接收器靈敏度、眼圖與安全雷射等級判定；只計算假設的鏈路預算。
evidence.detailEn: Receiver sensitivity, eye diagrams and laser safety classes are outside this assumed link budget.

decisions.text: 先清查連接與對準損耗，再用量測比對預算
decisions.textEn: Inspect connection and alignment losses, then compare the budget with measurements
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。不包含接收器靈敏度、眼圖與安全雷射等級判定；只計算假設的鏈路預算。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Receiver sensitivity, eye diagrams and laser safety classes are outside this assumed link budget.

decisions.text: 忽略光學安全條件，直接提高光源功率
decisions.textEn: Increase source power without checking optical safety conditions
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。dBm 表示絕對功率，dB 表示損耗比；串接損耗在對數域相加。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. dBm denotes absolute power, while dB denotes a loss ratio. Cascaded losses add in the logarithmic domain.

decisions.text: 凍結目前配置並重新做暗訊號與參考功率校正
decisions.textEn: Freeze the setup and repeat dark and reference-power calibration
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。不包含接收器靈敏度、眼圖與安全雷射等級判定；只計算假設的鏈路預算。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Receiver sensitivity, eye diagrams and laser safety classes are outside this assumed link budget.

missions.title: 02 · 計數訊號與背景
missions.brief: 曝光時間加倍後亮點也增加，暗場圖顯示背景同時升高。 你是光子封裝測試工程師。本次「光引擎：把訊號接回來」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Doubling exposure increases bright counts, but dark frames show background also rising. As photonic package test engineer in “Optical Engine: Restore the Signal”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 曝光時間加倍後亮點也增加，暗場圖顯示背景同時升高。 假設訊號與背景是獨立 Poisson 計數，檢查背景控制是否比單純延長曝光更有效。
evidence.detailEn: Doubling exposure increases bright counts, but dark frames show background also rising. Assume independent Poisson signal and background counts; compare background control with simply extending exposure.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 已知平均背景的簡化模型；另行量背景、讀出雜訊、死時間或飽和會改變公式。
evidence.detailEn: Simplified known-mean background model; separately estimated background, read noise, dead time and saturation alter the formula.

decisions.text: 先量背景與飽和界線，再選擇曝光方案

decisions.text: 刪去背景計數，但不計入背景不確定度
decisions.textEn: Subtract background while ignoring its uncertainty
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。假設訊號與背景是獨立 Poisson 計數，檢查背景控制是否比單純延長曝光更有效。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Assume independent Poisson signal and background counts; compare background control with simply extending exposure.

decisions.text: 分開記錄暗場與亮場，待線性區確認後交付
decisions.textEn: Record dark and illuminated frames separately and verify linear response
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。已知平均背景的簡化模型；另行量背景、讀出雜訊、死時間或飽和會改變公式。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Simplified known-mean background model; separately estimated background, read noise, dead time and saturation alter the formula.

missions.title: 01 · 時間取樣與最高頻率
missions.brief: 同一振動訊號換取樣設定後出現另一個低頻峰，硬體本身沒有改動。 你是電子系統驗證工程師。本次「訊號診所：雜訊與錯頻」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Changing sampling settings creates a different low-frequency peak in the same vibration signal without changing the hardware. As electronic system verification engineer in “Signal Clinic: Noise and Aliasing”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 同一振動訊號換取樣設定後出現另一個低頻峰，硬體本身沒有改動。 先限定量測頻帶並使用抗混疊濾波；取樣比例超過一只是理想必要條件。
evidence.detailEn: Changing sampling settings creates a different low-frequency peak in the same vibration signal without changing the hardware. Limit the measurement band and use anti-alias filtering; a ratio above one is only an ideal necessary condition.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 不含濾波器過渡帶、時脈抖動與 ADC 雜訊；不是充分的儀器規格。
evidence.detailEn: Filter transition bands, clock jitter and ADC noise are excluded; this is not a sufficient instrument specification.

decisions.text: 確認抗混疊濾波，再以已知頻率注入訊號測試

decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。不含濾波器過渡帶、時脈抖動與 ADC 雜訊；不是充分的儀器規格。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Filter transition bands, clock jitter and ADC noise are excluded; this is not a sufficient instrument specification.

decisions.text: 用內插點數代替真正取樣頻率
decisions.textEn: Substitute interpolated points for real sampling rate
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先限定量測頻帶並使用抗混疊濾波；取樣比例超過一只是理想必要條件。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Limit the measurement band and use anti-alias filtering; a ratio above one is only an ideal necessary condition.

decisions.text: 縮小分析頻帶並保存原始取樣資料
decisions.textEn: Reduce the analysis band and preserve raw samples
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。不含濾波器過渡帶、時脈抖動與 ADC 雜訊；不是充分的儀器規格。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Filter transition bands, clock jitter and ADC noise are excluded; this is not a sufficient instrument specification.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「時間取樣與最高頻率」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：高精度類比訊號調理、低雜訊放大器設計、鎖相迴路頻率合成器。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Time sampling and bandwidth” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Precision analog signal conditioning, Low-noise amplifier design, Phase-locked-loop frequency synthesizers.

As electronic system verification engineer in “Signal Clinic: Noise and Aliasing”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界

decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Fixed sequential teaching delays; tail distributions and overlap require percentile and load testing.

decisions.text: 只換更快的處理器，忽略排隊與傳輸

decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先用同一筆交易的時間戳分解延遲，避免把非同批次的平均值當成最壞情況。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Decompose one transaction using consistent timestamps; unrelated averages do not form a worst case.

decisions.text: 保留原始追蹤，降低流量後逐段定位

decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。固定教學延遲相加，未描述尾端分布與併行重疊；實際 SLO 需要分位數與負載測試。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Fixed sequential teaching delays; tail distributions and overlap require percentile and load testing.

missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “End-to-end latency handoff” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Precision analog signal conditioning, Low-noise amplifier design, Phase-locked-loop frequency synthesizers.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 貼片圖面版本更新後少數元件偏位；相機座標原點仍沿用舊板。 殘差是相同座標系下的目標差，先核對零點、方向與工具中心點。

decisions.text: 把畫面圖示對齊當成實體位置已校正

decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。殘差是相同座標系下的目標差，先核對零點、方向與工具中心點。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Residuals compare target and result in one coordinate system; verify origin, direction and tool center point.

decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。二維幾何殘差，不代表重複性、絕對精度或機器人安全距離。

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界

decisions.text: 隔離可疑批次，增加一次獨立抽樣

decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。這是三站一次通過率，非企業實際良率；多次返工與不同批次不能直接混合。

stations.title: 平行化的上限

stations.title: 資料通道的餘量

stations.description: 先確認功率是轉成熱的耗散量，不是標示的輸出功率；依相同參考點比較溫度。

stations.descriptionEn: Use the same time window and system boundary for input and output, including auxiliaries.

missions.title: 01 · 平行化的上限
missions.brief: 工作核心翻倍，程式速度只增加少量；序列前處理占用大部分開始時間。 你是效能工程師。本次「算力中心：核心不是答案」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Doubling workers yields little acceleration because serial preprocessing dominates startup. As performance engineer in “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 工作核心翻倍，程式速度只增加少量；序列前處理占用大部分開始時間。 把序列部分與可平行部分分開；增加核心不會消除序列瓶頸。
evidence.detailEn: Doubling workers yields little acceleration because serial preprocessing dominates startup. Separate serial and parallel work; adding cores cannot remove the serial bottleneck.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 固定工作量且不含通訊成本的 Amdahl 上限；不是實測超級電腦效能。
evidence.detailEn: Amdahl bound for fixed work without communication costs, not measured supercomputer performance.

decisions.text: 先剖析序列路徑，再測量平行通信開銷
decisions.textEn: Profile the serial path and then measure parallel communication overhead

decisions.text: 把核心數直接寫成預期加速倍數

decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。把序列部分與可平行部分分開；增加核心不會消除序列瓶頸。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Separate serial and parallel work; adding cores cannot remove the serial bottleneck.

decisions.text: 保留小規模測試，延後擴充至結果可重現
decisions.textEn: Retain a small benchmark and delay expansion until results reproduce
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。固定工作量且不含通訊成本的 Amdahl 上限；不是實測超級電腦效能。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Amdahl bound for fixed work without communication costs, not measured supercomputer performance.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「平行化的上限」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：防禦性資訊安全網路、CPU 管線與分支預測、快取一致性多核心系統。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Limits of parallel execution” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Defensive Cybersecurity Network, CPU pipelines and branch prediction, Cache-coherent multicore systems.

missions.title: 02 · 資料通道的餘量
missions.brief: 加速器等待輸入，儲存通道平均負載看似足夠，但事件突發時出現丟棄。 你是效能工程師。本次「算力中心：核心不是答案」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Accelerators wait for input; average storage load looks acceptable, but bursts produce drops. As performance engineer in “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 加速器等待輸入，儲存通道平均負載看似足夠，但事件突發時出現丟棄。 一致使用十進位 kB，並把封包與儲存標頭計入有效容量的估計。
evidence.detailEn: Accelerators wait for input; average storage load looks acceptable, but bursts produce drops. Use decimal kB consistently and account for packet and storage overhead in effective capacity.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
evidence.detailEn: Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

decisions.text: 保留尖峰餘量並以固定負載重播檢查丟棄
decisions.textEn: Retain burst headroom and replay a fixed workload to check drops
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

decisions.text: 只看平均頻寬，隱藏丟棄計數
decisions.textEn: Inspect only average bandwidth and hide drop counts
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。一致使用十進位 kB，並把封包與儲存標頭計入有效容量的估計。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Use decimal kB consistently and account for packet and storage overhead in effective capacity.

decisions.text: 降採樣非關鍵流量並保留完整原始測試紀錄
decisions.textEn: Downsample noncritical traffic while preserving full test records
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Data-path headroom” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Defensive Cybersecurity Network, CPU pipelines and branch prediction, Cache-coherent multicore systems.

missions.title: 03 · 熱源與散熱路徑
missions.brief: 機架的散熱接觸修改後熱點轉移，不能只延用舊散熱係數。 你是效能工程師。本次「算力中心：核心不是答案」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A thermal-contact revision shifts the rack hotspot, invalidating blind reuse of the old thermal coefficient. As performance engineer in “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 機架的散熱接觸修改後熱點轉移，不能只延用舊散熱係數。 先確認功率是轉成熱的耗散量，不是標示的輸出功率；依相同參考點比較溫度。
evidence.detailEn: A thermal-contact revision shifts the rack hotspot, invalidating blind reuse of the old thermal coefficient. First identify dissipated heat rather than rated output power; compare temperatures at the same reference point.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
evidence.detailEn: Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

decisions.text: 先降低負載並檢查散熱接觸，再以同一測點重測
decisions.textEn: Reduce the load, inspect thermal contact, and repeat at the same measurement point

decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

decisions.text: 只把溫度顯示上限調高就放行
decisions.textEn: Raise only the display alarm limit and release
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先確認功率是轉成熱的耗散量，不是標示的輸出功率；依相同參考點比較溫度。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. First identify dissipated heat rather than rated output power; compare temperatures at the same reference point.

decisions.text: 暫停交付，完成熱穩定量測後再決定
decisions.textEn: Hold delivery until thermal stabilization is measured
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

missions.title: 04 · 輸入輸出的能源核對
missions.brief: 新工作排程縮短計算時間，卻讓輔助設備待機更久；需以相同工作量比較能源。 你是效能工程師。本次「算力中心：核心不是答案」在第 4 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A schedule reduces compute time but extends auxiliary standby; compare energy at equal completed work. As performance engineer in “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer”, investigate the record at station 4: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 新工作排程縮短計算時間，卻讓輔助設備待機更久；需以相同工作量比較能源。 輸入、輸出必須使用相同時間窗與系統邊界；輔助設備耗能要一起計入。
evidence.detailEn: A schedule reduces compute time but extends auxiliary standby; compare energy at equal completed work. Use the same time window and system boundary for input and output, including auxiliaries.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 固定邊界的能量比，不代表所有操作點效率；輸出大於輸入時應先檢查邊界與時間戳。
evidence.detailEn: Energy ratio for one fixed boundary, not every operating point; apparent output above input calls for boundary and timestamp checks.

decisions.text: 對齊電表時間與輔助負載，再比較改版前後
decisions.textEn: Align meter timestamps and auxiliary loads before comparing revisions
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。固定邊界的能量比，不代表所有操作點效率；輸出大於輸入時應先檢查邊界與時間戳。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Energy ratio for one fixed boundary, not every operating point; apparent output above input calls for boundary and timestamp checks.

decisions.text: 用瞬間峰值輸出除以全日平均輸入
decisions.textEn: Divide peak instantaneous output by daily-average input
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。輸入、輸出必須使用相同時間窗與系統邊界；輔助設備耗能要一起計入。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Use the same time window and system boundary for input and output, including auxiliaries.

decisions.text: 延長量測時間，等待儲能狀態回到相同基準
decisions.textEn: Extend measurement until stored energy returns to the same baseline
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。固定邊界的能量比，不代表所有操作點效率；輸出大於輸入時應先檢查邊界與時間戳。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Energy ratio for one fixed boundary, not every operating point; apparent output above input calls for boundary and timestamp checks.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「輸入輸出的能源核對」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：防禦性資訊安全網路、CPU 管線與分支預測、快取一致性多核心系統。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Input-output energy reconciliation” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Defensive Cybersecurity Network, CPU pipelines and branch prediction, Cache-coherent multicore systems.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程情境；各站使用明示假設的獨立教學算例，串接的是驗證與交班流程，不是同一實機的校準數位孿生、廠商配方或操作許可。照片為具來源的代表性實拍；教學目標區間不是法規或設備允收值。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering scenario. Stations use independent teaching fixtures with stated assumptions, linked by verification and handoff rather than a calibrated twin, vendor recipe or operating authorization. Credited photographs are representative. Target bands are teaching objectives, not regulatory or equipment limits.

missions.title: 01 · 端到端延遲交接
missions.brief: 服務延遲升高先於 CPU 負載，追蹤資料顯示請求在佇列內等待。 你是防禦性維運工程師。本次「可信服務：中斷後的交班」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Service latency rises before CPU load; traces show requests waiting in a queue. As defensive operations engineer in “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 服務延遲升高先於 CPU 負載，追蹤資料顯示請求在佇列內等待。 先用同一筆交易的時間戳分解延遲，避免把非同批次的平均值當成最壞情況。
evidence.detailEn: Service latency rises before CPU load; traces show requests waiting in a queue. Decompose one transaction using consistent timestamps; unrelated averages do not form a worst case.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 固定教學延遲相加，未描述尾端分布與併行重疊；實際 SLO 需要分位數與負載測試。
evidence.detailEn: Fixed sequential teaching delays; tail distributions and overlap require percentile and load testing.

decisions.text: 先處理主要排隊瓶頸，再重播相同測試流量
decisions.textEn: Address the dominant queue, then replay the same workload
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。固定教學延遲相加，未描述尾端分布與併行重疊；實際 SLO 需要分位數與負載測試。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Fixed sequential teaching delays; tail distributions and overlap require percentile and load testing.

decisions.text: 只換更快的處理器，忽略排隊與傳輸
decisions.textEn: Buy a faster processor while ignoring queue and transfer delays
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先用同一筆交易的時間戳分解延遲，避免把非同批次的平均值當成最壞情況。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Decompose one transaction using consistent timestamps; unrelated averages do not form a worst case.

decisions.text: 保留原始追蹤，降低流量後逐段定位
decisions.textEn: Preserve traces, reduce traffic, and isolate each stage
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。固定教學延遲相加，未描述尾端分布與併行重疊；實際 SLO 需要分位數與負載測試。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Fixed sequential teaching delays; tail distributions and overlap require percentile and load testing.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「端到端延遲交接」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：分散式檔案系統、物件儲存系統、資料庫交易與日誌。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “End-to-end latency handoff” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Distributed file systems, Object-storage systems, Database transactions and logging.

missions.title: 03 · 備份回復驗證
missions.brief: 備份檔存在，但最近一次演練沒有驗證雜湊，也沒有重建相依服務。 你是防禦性維運工程師。本次「可信服務：中斷後的交班」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Backup files exist, but the last drill neither checked hashes nor rebuilt dependencies. As defensive operations engineer in “Trusted Service: Handoff After an Outage”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 備份檔存在，但最近一次演練沒有驗證雜湊，也沒有重建相依服務。 完整回復包含資料傳輸及內容驗證，備份存在不等於可在期限內還原。

evidence.detail: 固定流量假設；不包含重新建立服務相依項與人員等待，真實演練要另量。

decisions.text: 在隔離環境試還原並驗證雜湊與服務相依項

decisions.text: 跳過驗證，把傳輸完成視為服務完全恢復

decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Recovery includes transfer and content verification; an existing backup does not prove timely recovery.

decisions.text: 先保護已知乾淨備份，再延長隔離驗證

decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。固定流量假設；不包含重新建立服務相依項與人員等待，真實演練要另量。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Fixed transfer rate; dependency rebuilds and human delays need measurement in a real drill.

missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Backup recovery verification” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Distributed file systems, Object-storage systems, Database transactions and logging.

missions.title: 04 · 兩個獨立誤差來源

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常

evidence.detailEn: Two monitors share a clock offset, so their uncertainties cannot be treated as fully independent. RSS applies here only to same-unit, uncorrelated standard uncertainties with sensitivity factors already included.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界

evidence.detailEn: Combined standard uncertainty is not a guaranteed error bound; correlated terms require covariance.

missions.briefEn: Two finite-shot results differ slightly for the same circuit; their shot counts differ by a factor of four. As quantum experiment data engineer in “Quantum Experiment Shift: How Precise Is the Evidence”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: p 是教學指定值；有限樣本估計、關聯雜訊和量子硬體漂移需額外分析。
evidence.detailEn: p is specified for teaching; finite-sample estimation, correlated noise and quantum hardware drift need separate analysis.

missions.title: 01 · 繞射極限與取樣
missions.brief: 影像經數位放大後更好看，標準樣品的兩個近點卻仍無法分開。 你是光學驗證工程師。本次「光學工作台：焦點失蹤」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Digital zoom improves appearance but does not resolve two close points on the reference sample. As optical verification engineer in “Optical Bench: Missing Focus”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 影像經數位放大後更好看，標準樣品的兩個近點卻仍無法分開。 先辨識波長和物方數值孔徑；高像素數不會自動改善繞射限制。
evidence.detailEn: Digital zoom improves appearance but does not resolve two close points on the reference sample. Identify wavelength and object-side numerical aperture; more pixels do not automatically improve diffraction resolution.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 圓形孔徑 Rayleigh 估計，未含像差、散射與取樣；不能代替量測解析度。
evidence.detailEn: Rayleigh estimate for a circular aperture, excluding aberration, scattering and sampling; not measured resolution.

decisions.text: 同時檢查孔徑、像差與相機取樣，再拍標準樣品
decisions.textEn: Check aperture, aberration and camera sampling, then image a reference target
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。圓形孔徑 Rayleigh 估計，未含像差、散射與取樣；不能代替量測解析度。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Rayleigh estimate for a circular aperture, excluding aberration, scattering and sampling; not measured resolution.

decisions.text: 只做數位放大就標示更高光學解析度
decisions.textEn: Label digital zoom as improved optical resolution
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先辨識波長和物方數值孔徑；高像素數不會自動改善繞射限制。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Identify wavelength and object-side numerical aperture; more pixels do not automatically improve diffraction resolution.

decisions.text: 保留原始影像並重新做對焦與標靶驗證
decisions.textEn: Preserve raw images and repeat focus and target validation
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。圓形孔徑 Rayleigh 估計，未含像差、散射與取樣；不能代替量測解析度。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Rayleigh estimate for a circular aperture, excluding aberration, scattering and sampling; not measured resolution.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「繞射極限與取樣」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：ASML 微影機系統工程、消色差透鏡設計、ASML 微影投影光學工程。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Diffraction limit and sampling” still cannot establish. Linked courses: ASML Lithography Systems Engineering, Achromatic lens design, ASML lithography projection-optics engineering.

As optical verification engineer in “Optical Bench: Missing Focus”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常

decisions.text: 把畫面圖示對齊當成實體位置已校正
decisions.textEn: Treat aligned screen icons as calibrated physical position
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。殘差是相同座標系下的目標差，先核對零點、方向與工具中心點。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Residuals compare target and result in one coordinate system; verify origin, direction and tool center point.

decisions.text: 保持致動器停用，使用標準件重建基準

decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。二維幾何殘差，不代表重複性、絕對精度或機器人安全距離。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Two-dimensional geometric residual, not repeatability, absolute accuracy or robot safeguarding distance.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「定位殘差」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：ASML 微影機系統工程、消色差透鏡設計、ASML 微影投影光學工程。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Positioning residual” still cannot establish. Linked courses: ASML Lithography Systems Engineering, Achromatic lens design, ASML lithography projection-optics engineering.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 不包含接收器靈敏度、眼圖與安全雷射等級判定；只計算假設的鏈路預算。

decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Receiver sensitivity, eye diagrams and laser safety classes are outside this assumed link budget.

decisions.text: 忽略光學安全條件，直接提高光源功率

decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. dBm denotes absolute power, while dB denotes a loss ratio. Cascaded losses add in the logarithmic domain.

decisions.text: 凍結目前配置並重新做暗訊號與參考功率校正

decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。不包含接收器靈敏度、眼圖與安全雷射等級判定；只計算假設的鏈路預算。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Receiver sensitivity, eye diagrams and laser safety classes are outside this assumed link budget.

missions.title: 01 · 計數訊號與背景
missions.brief: 天空背景變亮後目標計數增加，訊號品質卻未同步改善。 你是觀測系統工程師。本次「觀測站：找回微弱訊號」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: The target count rises under a brighter sky, but signal quality does not improve proportionally. As observing-system engineer in “Observatory: Recover a Faint Signal”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 天空背景變亮後目標計數增加，訊號品質卻未同步改善。 假設訊號與背景是獨立 Poisson 計數，檢查背景控制是否比單純延長曝光更有效。
evidence.detailEn: The target count rises under a brighter sky, but signal quality does not improve proportionally. Assume independent Poisson signal and background counts; compare background control with simply extending exposure.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 已知平均背景的簡化模型；另行量背景、讀出雜訊、死時間或飽和會改變公式。
evidence.detailEn: Simplified known-mean background model; separately estimated background, read noise, dead time and saturation alter the formula.

decisions.text: 先量背景與飽和界線，再選擇曝光方案

decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。已知平均背景的簡化模型；另行量背景、讀出雜訊、死時間或飽和會改變公式。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Simplified known-mean background model; separately estimated background, read noise, dead time and saturation alter the formula.

decisions.text: 刪去背景計數，但不計入背景不確定度
decisions.textEn: Subtract background while ignoring its uncertainty
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。假設訊號與背景是獨立 Poisson 計數，檢查背景控制是否比單純延長曝光更有效。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Assume independent Poisson signal and background counts; compare background control with simply extending exposure.

decisions.text: 分開記錄暗場與亮場，待線性區確認後交付
decisions.textEn: Record dark and illuminated frames separately and verify linear response
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。已知平均背景的簡化模型；另行量背景、讀出雜訊、死時間或飽和會改變公式。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Simplified known-mean background model; separately estimated background, read noise, dead time and saturation alter the formula.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「計數訊號與背景」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：天文自適應光學、望遠鏡主鏡主動支撐、分段鏡共相控制。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Counting signal and background” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Astronomical adaptive optics, Active support of telescope primary mirrors, Segmented-mirror co-phasing control.

missions.title: 02 · 時間取樣與最高頻率
missions.brief: 導引感測器記錄到緩慢擺動，另一頻率的注入測試顯示可能混疊。 你是觀測系統工程師。本次「觀測站：找回微弱訊號」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A guide sensor records a slow oscillation; a known-frequency injection suggests aliasing. As observing-system engineer in “Observatory: Recover a Faint Signal”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 導引感測器記錄到緩慢擺動，另一頻率的注入測試顯示可能混疊。 先限定量測頻帶並使用抗混疊濾波；取樣比例超過一只是理想必要條件。

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界

decisions.text: 確認抗混疊濾波，再以已知頻率注入訊號測試

decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

decisions.text: 只把溫度顯示上限調高就放行
decisions.textEn: Raise only the display alarm limit and release
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先確認功率是轉成熱的耗散量，不是標示的輸出功率；依相同參考點比較溫度。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. First identify dissipated heat rather than rated output power; compare temperatures at the same reference point.

decisions.text: 暫停交付，完成熱穩定量測後再決定
decisions.textEn: Hold delivery until thermal stabilization is measured
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Heat source and thermal path” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Fourier-transform infrared spectrometers, Ellipsometer construction, Integrating-sphere radiometry.

missions.title: 01 · 載荷配置與重心
missions.titleEn: 01 · Load placement and center of mass
missions.brief: 地面試件增加儀器盒後總質量變大，重心位置也改變，不能只更新重量欄。 你是航空結構驗證工程師。本次「機體試驗：載荷有跡可循」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Adding an instrument box changes both total mass and center of mass; updating weight alone is insufficient. As airframe verification engineer in “Airframe Trials: Trace the Load”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 地面試件增加儀器盒後總質量變大，重心位置也改變，不能只更新重量欄。 所有距離使用相同基準與符號方向，先核對質量清單再計算力矩。
evidence.detailEn: Adding an instrument box changes both total mass and center of mass; updating weight alone is insufficient. Use a common datum and sign convention; reconcile the mass manifest before summing moments.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 兩個質點的桌面模型；不能取代適航重心包線、船舶穩度計算或吊裝計畫。
evidence.detailEn: Two-point tabletop model, not an airworthiness envelope, stability analysis or lift plan.

decisions.text: 對照共同基準重排載荷，記錄每次配置版本
decisions.textEn: Reposition loads against one datum and record each configuration revision
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。兩個質點的桌面模型；不能取代適航重心包線、船舶穩度計算或吊裝計畫。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Two-point tabletop model, not an airworthiness envelope, stability analysis or lift plan.

decisions.text: 把幾何中心當成重心，略過質量表
decisions.textEn: Use the geometric center and omit the mass manifest
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。所有距離使用相同基準與符號方向，先核對質量清單再計算力矩。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Use a common datum and sign convention; reconcile the mass manifest before summing moments.

decisions.text: 先做獨立稱重，配置未確認前保持靜態
decisions.textEn: Independently weigh the model and keep it stationary until reconciled
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。兩個質點的桌面模型；不能取代適航重心包線、船舶穩度計算或吊裝計畫。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Two-point tabletop model, not an airworthiness envelope, stability analysis or lift plan.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「載荷配置與重心」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：經國號與航空製造概念、Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程、Boeing 787 複材與電力系統。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Load placement and center of mass” still cannot establish. Linked courses: IDF and Aircraft Manufacturing Concepts, Airbus A350 composite airliner systems, Boeing 787 composites and electrical integration.

missions.title: 02 · 截面載重路徑
missions.brief: 支架切出開孔後淨截面變小，試驗表仍使用原始外形面積。 你是航空結構驗證工程師。本次「機體試驗：載荷有跡可循」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A support cutout reduces net section, but the test sheet still uses the original gross area. As airframe verification engineer in “Airframe Trials: Trace the Load”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 支架切出開孔後淨截面變小，試驗表仍使用原始外形面積。 先找出真正承載的淨截面，確認 N/mm² 等於 MPa。
evidence.detailEn: A support cutout reduces net section, but the test sheet still uses the original gross area. Identify the net load-bearing section; N/mm² equals MPa.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 均勻軸向平均應力，不含缺口、屈曲、疲勞與複材方向性；不是結構設計驗證。
evidence.detailEn: Mean uniaxial stress excludes notches, buckling, fatigue and composite anisotropy; not design verification.

decisions.text: 檢查截面與載重方向，將缺口效應列入後續試驗
decisions.textEn: Check section and load direction; include notch effects in follow-up tests
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。均勻軸向平均應力，不含缺口、屈曲、疲勞與複材方向性；不是結構設計驗證。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Mean uniaxial stress excludes notches, buckling, fatigue and composite anisotropy; not design verification.

decisions.text: 只因平均應力小就宣稱整體安全
decisions.textEn: Declare the complete structure safe from low average stress alone
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先找出真正承載的淨截面，確認 N/mm² 等於 MPa。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Identify the net load-bearing section; N/mm² equals MPa.

decisions.text: 暫停放行，保留試片進行獨立載重檢查
decisions.textEn: Hold release and retain the specimen for independent load checks
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。均勻軸向平均應力，不含缺口、屈曲、疲勞與複材方向性；不是結構設計驗證。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Mean uniaxial stress excludes notches, buckling, fatigue and composite anisotropy; not design verification.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「截面載重路徑」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：經國號與航空製造概念、Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程、Boeing 787 複材與電力系統。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Load through a section” still cannot establish. Linked courses: IDF and Aircraft Manufacturing Concepts, Airbus A350 composite airliner systems, Boeing 787 composites and electrical integration.

missions.title: 03 · 異材接合的熱位移
missions.brief: 複材與金屬接合冷卻後出現相對位移，需先估算自由膨脹差。 你是航空結構驗證工程師。本次「機體試驗：載荷有跡可循」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A composite-metal joint moves after cooldown; first estimate its free-expansion mismatch. As airframe verification engineer in “Airframe Trials: Trace the Load”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 複材與金屬接合冷卻後出現相對位移，需先估算自由膨脹差。 不同材料自由膨脹量不同；先計算位移差，再討論順應層與幾何配置。
evidence.detailEn: A composite-metal joint moves after cooldown; first estimate its free-expansion mismatch. Different materials expand by different amounts; compute mismatch before discussing compliance and geometry.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 只計算自由熱位移，不預測焊點壽命、局部應力或翹曲；材料參數均為假設。
evidence.detailEn: Free expansion only; this does not predict solder life, local stress or warpage. Parameters are assumed.

decisions.text: 比較順應接合與較小溫差的方案，保留疲勞試驗需求
decisions.textEn: Compare compliant joints and a smaller temperature swing; retain fatigue testing
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。只計算自由熱位移，不預測焊點壽命、局部應力或翹曲；材料參數均為假設。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Free expansion only; this does not predict solder life, local stress or warpage. Parameters are assumed.

decisions.text: 把自由位移直接當成失效循環數
decisions.textEn: Treat free displacement as a fatigue-life prediction
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。不同材料自由膨脹量不同；先計算位移差，再討論順應層與幾何配置。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Different materials expand by different amounts; compute mismatch before discussing compliance and geometry.

decisions.text: 保留樣品作截面分析，暫不宣稱已找到唯一原因
decisions.textEn: Retain samples for cross-section analysis without claiming a unique cause
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。只計算自由熱位移，不預測焊點壽命、局部應力或翹曲；材料參數均為假設。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Free expansion only; this does not predict solder life, local stress or warpage. Parameters are assumed.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「異材接合的熱位移」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：經國號與航空製造概念、Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程、Boeing 787 複材與電力系統。

Linked courses: IDF and Aircraft Manufacturing Concepts, Airbus A350 composite airliner systems, Boeing 787 composites and electrical integration.

missions.title: 01 · 風洞升力配平
missions.brief: 風洞流速改變後升力曲線不符合預期，先檢查天平零點與密度記錄。 你是氣動試驗工程師。本次「風洞值班：把曲線說清楚」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A speed change produces an unexpected lift curve; inspect balance zero and density records first. As aerodynamic test engineer in “Wind-Tunnel Shift: Explain the Curves”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 風洞流速改變後升力曲線不符合預期，先檢查天平零點與密度記錄。 固定參考面積與密度後，將速度變化與天平量得的升力比較。
evidence.detailEn: A speed change produces an unexpected lift curve; inspect balance zero and density records first. Keep reference area and density fixed, then compare speed changes with measured balance loads.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: CL 為假設常數，只適用於指定教學區間；未含失速、壓縮性與地面效應。
evidence.detailEn: CL is assumed constant in a teaching range; stall, compressibility and ground effects are excluded.

decisions.text: 檢查天平零點與密度，再以小步長改變流速

decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。CL 為假設常數，只適用於指定教學區間；未含失速、壓縮性與地面效應。

decisions.text: 把固定 CL 公式外推到失速與任意高速

evidence.detail: 穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
evidence.detailEn: Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

decisions.text: 先降低負載並檢查散熱接觸，再以同一測點重測
decisions.textEn: Reduce the load, inspect thermal contact, and repeat at the same measurement point
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

decisions.text: 只把溫度顯示上限調高就放行
decisions.textEn: Raise only the display alarm limit and release
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先確認功率是轉成熱的耗散量，不是標示的輸出功率；依相同參考點比較溫度。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. First identify dissipated heat rather than rated output power; compare temperatures at the same reference point.

decisions.text: 暫停交付，完成熱穩定量測後再決定
decisions.textEn: Hold delivery until thermal stabilization is measured
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Heat source and thermal path” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Airbus A320 flight-control architecture, Solar Impulse solar aircraft, Transport-aircraft wind-tunnel validation.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常

evidence.detailEn: Sensor replay adds high-frequency disturbance without updating the recording bandwidth. Limit the measurement band and use anti-alias filtering; a ratio above one is only an ideal necessary condition.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界

decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Filter transition bands, clock jitter and ADC noise are excluded; this is not a sufficient instrument specification.

decisions.text: 縮小分析頻帶並保存原始取樣資料

decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。不含濾波器過渡帶、時脈抖動與 ADC 雜訊；不是充分的儀器規格。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Filter transition bands, clock jitter and ADC noise are excluded; this is not a sufficient instrument specification.

missions.title: 01 · 常壓浮體的質量平衡
missions.titleEn: 01 · Mass balance of an unpressurized float
missions.brief: 船模安裝感測器後吃水改變，配重表未更新新增質量。 你是船模試驗工程師。本次「船塢學院：一艘模型的交付」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Adding sensors changes model draft while the ballast record omits the added mass. As ship-model test engineer in “Dockyard Academy: Deliver a Scale Model”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 船模安裝感測器後吃水改變，配重表未更新新增質量。 完全浸沒時浮力取決於排水重量，先檢查體積與質量是否用了同一模型。
evidence.detailEn: Adding sensors changes model draft while the ballast record omits the added mass. For full immersion, buoyancy depends on displaced weight; ensure volume and mass refer to the same model.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 常壓、不可壓縮的桌面浮體，不評估深海耐壓、動態穩度或載人作業。
evidence.detailEn: Unpressurized incompressible tabletop float; no deep-pressure, dynamic stability or crewed-operation assessment.

decisions.text: 重新核對排水體積與配重，再在常壓水槽試驗
decisions.textEn: Reconcile displaced volume and ballast, then test in an unpressurized tank
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。常壓、不可壓縮的桌面浮體，不評估深海耐壓、動態穩度或載人作業。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Unpressurized incompressible tabletop float; no deep-pressure, dynamic stability or crewed-operation assessment.

decisions.text: 把常壓浮力結果當成深海耐壓證明
decisions.textEn: Treat surface buoyancy as evidence of deep-sea pressure strength
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。完全浸沒時浮力取決於排水重量，先檢查體積與質量是否用了同一模型。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. For full immersion, buoyancy depends on displaced weight; ensure volume and mass refer to the same model.

decisions.text: 先取出模型檢查吸水與秤重偏差
decisions.textEn: Remove the model and check water absorption and scale offset
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。常壓、不可壓縮的桌面浮體，不評估深海耐壓、動態穩度或載人作業。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Unpressurized incompressible tabletop float; no deep-pressure, dynamic stability or crewed-operation assessment.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「常壓浮體的質量平衡」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：Queen Mary 2 遠洋郵輪工程、Icon of the Seas 大型郵輪系統、Oasis of the Seas 船舶分區。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Mass balance of an unpressurized float” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Queen Mary 2 ocean-liner engineering, Icon of the Seas large cruise-ship systems, Oasis of the Seas ship zoning.

missions.title: 02 · 載荷配置與重心
missions.titleEn: 02 · Load placement and center of mass
missions.brief: 船模總質量相同但配重位置不同，必須核對共同基準的重心。 你是船模試驗工程師。本次「船塢學院：一艘模型的交付」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Equal total mass with different ballast placement requires center-of-mass reconciliation against one datum. As ship-model test engineer in “Dockyard Academy: Deliver a Scale Model”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 船模總質量相同但配重位置不同，必須核對共同基準的重心。 所有距離使用相同基準與符號方向，先核對質量清單再計算力矩。
evidence.detailEn: Equal total mass with different ballast placement requires center-of-mass reconciliation against one datum. Use a common datum and sign convention; reconcile the mass manifest before summing moments.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 兩個質點的桌面模型；不能取代適航重心包線、船舶穩度計算或吊裝計畫。
evidence.detailEn: Two-point tabletop model, not an airworthiness envelope, stability analysis or lift plan.

decisions.text: 對照共同基準重排載荷，記錄每次配置版本
decisions.textEn: Reposition loads against one datum and record each configuration revision
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。兩個質點的桌面模型；不能取代適航重心包線、船舶穩度計算或吊裝計畫。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Two-point tabletop model, not an airworthiness envelope, stability analysis or lift plan.

decisions.text: 把幾何中心當成重心，略過質量表
decisions.textEn: Use the geometric center and omit the mass manifest
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。所有距離使用相同基準與符號方向，先核對質量清單再計算力矩。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Use a common datum and sign convention; reconcile the mass manifest before summing moments.

decisions.text: 先做獨立稱重，配置未確認前保持靜態
decisions.textEn: Independently weigh the model and keep it stationary until reconciled
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。兩個質點的桌面模型；不能取代適航重心包線、船舶穩度計算或吊裝計畫。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Two-point tabletop model, not an airworthiness envelope, stability analysis or lift plan.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「載荷配置與重心」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：Queen Mary 2 遠洋郵輪工程、Icon of the Seas 大型郵輪系統、Oasis of the Seas 船舶分區。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Load placement and center of mass” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Queen Mary 2 ocean-liner engineering, Icon of the Seas large cruise-ship systems, Oasis of the Seas ship zoning.

missions.title: 03 · 阻力與推進需求
missions.brief: 拖曳速度改變後阻力大幅增加；先辨識平方速度項與縮尺限制。 你是船模試驗工程師。本次「船塢學院：一艘模型的交付」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Drag rises sharply with tow speed; identify the square-speed term and scale limits. As ship-model test engineer in “Dockyard Academy: Deliver a Scale Model”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 拖曳速度改變後阻力大幅增加；先辨識平方速度項與縮尺限制。 相同外形與參考面積下比較阻力；速度平方律不能跨越阻力係數變化仍當常數。
evidence.detailEn: Drag rises sharply with tow speed; identify the square-speed term and scale limits. Compare at fixed shape and reference area; the square-speed rule assumes drag coefficient remains fixed.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 縮尺水槽的常 CD 算例，不含波阻、空蝕與 Reynolds 相似性修正。

decisions.textEn: Match model scale and speed range before comparing drag curves

decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Constant-CD scaled tank fixture excluding wave resistance, cavitation and Reynolds scaling.

decisions.text: 直接把縮尺阻力當成全尺寸船舶阻力
decisions.textEn: Use scaled-model drag directly as full-scale vessel drag
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。相同外形與參考面積下比較阻力；速度平方律不能跨越阻力係數變化仍當常數。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Compare at fixed shape and reference area; the square-speed rule assumes drag coefficient remains fixed.

decisions.text: 增加空槽基線與支架校正測試
decisions.textEn: Add empty-tank baseline and support calibration tests
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。縮尺水槽的常 CD 算例，不含波阻、空蝕與 Reynolds 相似性修正。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Constant-CD scaled tank fixture excluding wave resistance, cavitation and Reynolds scaling.

missions.title: 04 · 截面載重路徑
missions.brief: 模型支架改為較薄截面後平均應力上升，但這仍不是全船強度驗證。 你是船模試驗工程師。本次「船塢學院：一艘模型的交付」在第 4 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A thinner model support raises mean stress, which still does not verify full-vessel strength. As ship-model test engineer in “Dockyard Academy: Deliver a Scale Model”, investigate the record at station 4: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 模型支架改為較薄截面後平均應力上升，但這仍不是全船強度驗證。 先找出真正承載的淨截面，確認 N/mm² 等於 MPa。
evidence.detailEn: A thinner model support raises mean stress, which still does not verify full-vessel strength. Identify the net load-bearing section; N/mm² equals MPa.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 均勻軸向平均應力，不含缺口、屈曲、疲勞與複材方向性；不是結構設計驗證。
evidence.detailEn: Mean uniaxial stress excludes notches, buckling, fatigue and composite anisotropy; not design verification.

decisions.text: 檢查截面與載重方向，將缺口效應列入後續試驗

decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。均勻軸向平均應力，不含缺口、屈曲、疲勞與複材方向性；不是結構設計驗證。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Mean uniaxial stress excludes notches, buckling, fatigue and composite anisotropy; not design verification.

decisions.text: 只因平均應力小就宣稱整體安全
decisions.textEn: Declare the complete structure safe from low average stress alone
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先找出真正承載的淨截面，確認 N/mm² 等於 MPa。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Identify the net load-bearing section; N/mm² equals MPa.

decisions.text: 暫停放行，保留試片進行獨立載重檢查
decisions.textEn: Hold release and retain the specimen for independent load checks
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。均勻軸向平均應力，不含缺口、屈曲、疲勞與複材方向性；不是結構設計驗證。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Mean uniaxial stress excludes notches, buckling, fatigue and composite anisotropy; not design verification.

missions.title: 01 · 可用能源與任務時間
missions.brief: 岸電示範任務加入額外負載，不能把原本返程保留能源全部用完。 你是船舶能源整合工程師。本次「海上能源：岸電交班」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: An added shore-power demonstration load must not consume the protected return reserve. As marine energy integration engineer in “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 岸電示範任務加入額外負載，不能把原本返程保留能源全部用完。 先從名目儲能扣除不能使用的餘量，再除以同一時間窗的平均負載。
evidence.detailEn: An added shore-power demonstration load must not consume the protected return reserve. Allow for unusable energy before dividing by the average load over the same mission window.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 常功率模型不描述老化、低溫、電壓崩落或充電控制；結果不是實際續航保證。
evidence.detailEn: Constant-power estimate excluding aging, cold weather, voltage sag and charging control; no endurance guarantee.

decisions.text: 保留返程餘量，降低非必要負載並重排任務
decisions.textEn: Retain return reserve, reduce nonessential loads, and reschedule the mission
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。常功率模型不描述老化、低溫、電壓崩落或充電控制；結果不是實際續航保證。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Constant-power estimate excluding aging, cold weather, voltage sag and charging control; no endurance guarantee.

decisions.text: 把安全保留量也計入可用電量
decisions.textEn: Count the protected reserve as usable energy
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先從名目儲能扣除不能使用的餘量，再除以同一時間窗的平均負載。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Allow for unusable energy before dividing by the average load over the same mission window.

decisions.text: 暫停任務並以代表負載記錄一次放電曲線
decisions.textEn: Hold the mission and record discharge under a representative load
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。常功率模型不描述老化、低溫、電壓崩落或充電控制；結果不是實際續航保證。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Constant-power estimate excluding aging, cold weather, voltage sag and charging control; no endurance guarantee.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「可用能源與任務時間」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：Laura Maersk 甲醇貨櫃船、Yara Birkeland 電動貨船、Ampere 電動渡輪。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Usable energy and mission duration” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Laura Maersk methanol container ship, Yara Birkeland electric cargo ship, Ampere electric ferry.

Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 較長供電路徑讓接點升溫，先估算電流平方損耗再安排檢查。 先確認回流路徑和接點電阻；電流加倍會使固定電阻的發熱變成四倍。
evidence.detailEn: A longer supply path heats contacts; estimate current-squared loss before inspection. Identify the return path and contact resistance. Doubling current quadruples heat at fixed resistance.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 直流穩態簡化；不含集膚效應、溫升改變電阻或保護協調。
evidence.detailEn: Simplified steady DC model excluding skin effect, temperature-dependent resistance and protection coordination.

decisions.text: 降低負載並比較較低路徑電阻，保留熱點量測

decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Simplified steady DC model excluding skin effect, temperature-dependent resistance and protection coordination.

decisions.text: 只換更大的保險元件，忽略接點發熱
decisions.textEn: Fit a larger protective element while ignoring contact heating
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先確認回流路徑和接點電阻；電流加倍會使固定電阻的發熱變成四倍。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Identify the return path and contact resistance. Doubling current quadruples heat at fixed resistance.

decisions.text: 停止帶電操作，先在隔離的低壓模型檢查接點
decisions.textEn: Stop energized work and inspect contacts on an isolated low-voltage model
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。直流穩態簡化；不含集膚效應、溫升改變電阻或保護協調。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Simplified steady DC model excluding skin effect, temperature-dependent resistance and protection coordination.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「導體損耗與電流路徑」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：Laura Maersk 甲醇貨櫃船、Yara Birkeland 電動貨船、Ampere 電動渡輪。

missions.brief: 引擎餘熱看似很多，需求端溫度卻更高；可利用熱量不能只看總 kJ。 你是船舶能源整合工程師。本次「海上能源：岸電交班」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。

As marine energy integration engineer in “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 引擎餘熱看似很多，需求端溫度卻更高；可利用熱量不能只看總 kJ。 先核對每批質量及可用溫差，區分能源 kJ 與功率 kW。
evidence.detailEn: Engine waste heat looks abundant, but the demand temperature is higher; total kJ does not determine usefulness. Reconcile batch mass and usable temperature change; distinguish energy in kJ from power in kW.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界

decisions.text: 列出冷熱流的溫度界線，再比較熱回收配置

decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。常數比熱且無相變；換熱效率、污染與溫度夾點另需分析。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Constant specific heat without phase change; effectiveness, fouling and pinch temperature need separate analysis.

decisions.text: 把所有熱量當成任何溫度都能利用的能源
decisions.textEn: Treat all heat as usable at any required temperature
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先核對每批質量及可用溫差，區分能源 kJ 與功率 kW。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Reconcile batch mass and usable temperature change; distinguish energy in kJ from power in kW.

decisions.text: 保留現有熱流紀錄，延長量測至負載穩定

decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。常數比熱且無相變；換熱效率、污染與溫度夾點另需分析。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Constant specific heat without phase change; effectiveness, fouling and pinch temperature need separate analysis.

As marine energy integration engineer in “Offshore Energy: Shore-Power Handoff”, investigate the record at station 4: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 報告漏列輔助泵耗能，改版效率需要用一致邊界重新比較。 輸入、輸出必須使用相同時間窗與系統邊界；輔助設備耗能要一起計入。

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 固定邊界的能量比，不代表所有操作點效率；輸出大於輸入時應先檢查邊界與時間戳。
evidence.detailEn: Energy ratio for one fixed boundary, not every operating point; apparent output above input calls for boundary and timestamp checks.

decisions.text: 對齊電表時間與輔助負載，再比較改版前後
decisions.textEn: Align meter timestamps and auxiliary loads before comparing revisions
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。固定邊界的能量比，不代表所有操作點效率；輸出大於輸入時應先檢查邊界與時間戳。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Energy ratio for one fixed boundary, not every operating point; apparent output above input calls for boundary and timestamp checks.

decisions.text: 用瞬間峰值輸出除以全日平均輸入
decisions.textEn: Divide peak instantaneous output by daily-average input
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。輸入、輸出必須使用相同時間窗與系統邊界；輔助設備耗能要一起計入。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Use the same time window and system boundary for input and output, including auxiliaries.

decisions.text: 延長量測時間，等待儲能狀態回到相同基準
decisions.textEn: Extend measurement until stored energy returns to the same baseline
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。固定邊界的能量比，不代表所有操作點效率；輸出大於輸入時應先檢查邊界與時間戳。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Energy ratio for one fixed boundary, not every operating point; apparent output above input calls for boundary and timestamp checks.

evidence.detailEn: Changing a science float battery changes net buoyancy; reconcile displaced volume and total mass. For full immersion, buoyancy depends on displaced weight; ensure volume and mass refer to the same model.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 常壓、不可壓縮的桌面浮體，不評估深海耐壓、動態穩度或載人作業。
evidence.detailEn: Unpressurized incompressible tabletop float; no deep-pressure, dynamic stability or crewed-operation assessment.

decisions.text: 重新核對排水體積與配重，再在常壓水槽試驗
decisions.textEn: Reconcile displaced volume and ballast, then test in an unpressurized tank
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。常壓、不可壓縮的桌面浮體，不評估深海耐壓、動態穩度或載人作業。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Unpressurized incompressible tabletop float; no deep-pressure, dynamic stability or crewed-operation assessment.

decisions.text: 把常壓浮力結果當成深海耐壓證明
decisions.textEn: Treat surface buoyancy as evidence of deep-sea pressure strength
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。完全浸沒時浮力取決於排水重量，先檢查體積與質量是否用了同一模型。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. For full immersion, buoyancy depends on displaced weight; ensure volume and mass refer to the same model.

decisions.text: 先取出模型檢查吸水與秤重偏差
decisions.textEn: Remove the model and check water absorption and scale offset
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。常壓、不可壓縮的桌面浮體，不評估深海耐壓、動態穩度或載人作業。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Unpressurized incompressible tabletop float; no deep-pressure, dynamic stability or crewed-operation assessment.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「常壓浮體的質量平衡」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：國造潛艦案例與水下載具工程、Alvin 載人科學潛器、Trieste 深海潛器工程史。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Mass balance of an unpressurized float” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Submarine Context and Underwater Vehicle Engineering, Alvin human-occupied research submersible, Trieste bathyscaphe engineering history.

missions.title: 03 · 資料通道的餘量
missions.brief: 多音束記錄速率提高後發生封包遺失，平均傳輸率掩蓋了尖峰。 你是海洋量測工程師。本次「海洋調查：回波裡的線索」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Higher multibeam recording rates cause packet loss while average throughput hides peaks. As ocean measurement engineer in “Ocean Survey: Clues in the Echoes”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 多音束記錄速率提高後發生封包遺失，平均傳輸率掩蓋了尖峰。 一致使用十進位 kB，並把封包與儲存標頭計入有效容量的估計。
evidence.detailEn: Higher multibeam recording rates cause packet loss while average throughput hides peaks. Use decimal kB consistently and account for packet and storage overhead in effective capacity.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
evidence.detailEn: Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

decisions.text: 保留尖峰餘量並以固定負載重播檢查丟棄

decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

decisions.text: 只看平均頻寬，隱藏丟棄計數
decisions.textEn: Inspect only average bandwidth and hide drop counts
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。一致使用十進位 kB，並把封包與儲存標頭計入有效容量的估計。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Use decimal kB consistently and account for packet and storage overhead in effective capacity.

decisions.text: 降採樣非關鍵流量並保留完整原始測試紀錄
decisions.textEn: Downsample noncritical traffic while preserving full test records
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「資料通道的餘量」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：國造潛艦案例與水下載具工程、Alvin 載人科學潛器、Trieste 深海潛器工程史。

missions.title: 04 · 兩個獨立誤差來源

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 多支感測器共用校正裝置，合併不確定度前須標出共同誤差來源。 確認兩項是同單位、靈敏度係數已納入且不相關的標準不確定度，才用平方和開根號。

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界

inputs.label: 重複量測標準不確定度

decisions.text: 保留來源與相關性假設，與允收區間一起交班

decisions.text: 把 uc 當成絕不超過的誤差上限

decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。確認兩項是同單位、靈敏度係數已納入且不相關的標準不確定度，才用平方和開根號。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. RSS applies here only to same-unit, uncorrelated standard uncertainties with sensitivity factors already included.

decisions.text: 先取得共同校正來源的相關性資料再作結論

decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。合成標準不確定度不是保證誤差上限；有相關性時要加共變異項。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Combined standard uncertainty is not a guaranteed error bound; correlated terms require covariance.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「兩個獨立誤差來源」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：國造潛艦案例與水下載具工程、Alvin 載人科學潛器、Trieste 深海潛器工程史。

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程情境；各站使用明示假設的獨立教學算例，串接的是驗證與交班流程，不是同一實機的校準數位孿生、廠商配方或操作許可。照片為具來源的代表性實拍；教學目標區間不是法規或設備允收值。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering scenario. Stations use independent teaching fixtures with stated assumptions, linked by verification and handoff rather than a calibrated twin, vendor recipe or operating authorization. Credited photographs are representative. Target bands are teaching objectives, not regulatory or equipment limits.

missions.title: 01 · 水力功率與效率
missions.brief: 水力示範報表使用總落差，現有管路損失卻沒有扣除。 你是能源系統驗證工程師。本次「能源站：把損失算回來」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A hydro demonstration uses gross elevation without subtracting pipe losses. As energy-system verification engineer in “Energy Station: Account for the Losses”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 水力示範報表使用總落差，現有管路損失卻沒有扣除。 使用有效水頭而非標示落差，將水力、機械與發電損失合併在總效率。
evidence.detailEn: A hydro demonstration uses gross elevation without subtracting pipe losses. Use net head, not nominal elevation; overall efficiency includes hydraulic, mechanical and generator losses.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 穩態不可壓縮水流算例，不包含水錘、環境流量與機組調速。
evidence.detailEn: Steady incompressible-water estimate excluding water hammer, environmental flows and governor behavior.

decisions.text: 先確認水頭與流量測點，保留損失帳
decisions.textEn: Verify head and flow measurement points and retain a loss account
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。穩態不可壓縮水流算例，不包含水錘、環境流量與機組調速。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Steady incompressible-water estimate excluding water hammer, environmental flows and governor behavior.

decisions.text: 忽略所有損失並把效率設成百分之百
decisions.textEn: Ignore every loss and set efficiency to 100 percent
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。使用有效水頭而非標示落差，將水力、機械與發電損失合併在總效率。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Use net head, not nominal elevation; overall efficiency includes hydraulic, mechanical and generator losses.

decisions.text: 保持模型低負載，重新校正流量讀值
decisions.textEn: Keep the model lightly loaded and recalibrate flow measurement
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。穩態不可壓縮水流算例，不包含水錘、環境流量與機組調速。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Steady incompressible-water estimate excluding water hammer, environmental flows and governor behavior.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「水力功率與效率」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：伊泰普水電站、道格灘離岸風電場、AP1000 壓水式發電架構。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Hydraulic power and efficiency” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Itaipu Hydroelectric Power Plant, Dogger Bank offshore wind farm, AP1000 pressurized-water generation architecture.

missions.briefEn: A subsystem heat-recovery report confuses batch energy with power; reconcile time first. As energy-system verification engineer in “Energy Station: Account for the Losses”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常

decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Constant specific heat without phase change; effectiveness, fouling and pinch temperature need separate analysis.

decisions.text: 把所有熱量當成任何溫度都能利用的能源

decisions.text: 保留現有熱流紀錄，延長量測至負載穩定

decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。常數比熱且無相變；換熱效率、污染與溫度夾點另需分析。

decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Constant-power estimate excluding aging, cold weather, voltage sag and charging control; no endurance guarantee.

decisions.text: 把安全保留量也計入可用電量

As material quality engineer in “Material Lifelines: Trace Every Stream”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. decisions.text: 把安全保留量也計入可用電量
decisions.textEn: Count the protected reserve as usable energy
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先從名目儲能扣除不能使用的餘量，再除以同一時間窗的平均負載。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Allow for unusable energy before dividing by the average load over the same mission window.

decisions.text: 暫停任務並以代表負載記錄一次放電曲線
decisions.textEn: Hold the mission and record discharge under a representative load
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。常功率模型不描述老化、低溫、電壓崩落或充電控制；結果不是實際續航保證。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Constant-power estimate excluding aging, cold weather, voltage sag and charging control; no endurance guarantee.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「可用能源與任務時間」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：法拉利與精密汽車製造、特斯拉與電動汽車工程、Toyota Prius 油電混合車。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Usable energy and mission duration” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Ferrari and Precision Automotive Manufacturing, Tesla and Electric Vehicle Engineering, Toyota Prius hybrid vehicle.

missions.title: 02 · 導體損耗與電流路徑
missions.brief: 馬達供電接頭更換後溫度上升，需檢查接點電阻。 你是車輛台架工程師。本次「車輛台架：續航與停止」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A replacement motor supply connector runs hotter; inspect contact resistance. As vehicle test-bench engineer in “Vehicle Bench: Endurance and Stopping”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 馬達供電接頭更換後溫度上升，需檢查接點電阻。 先確認回流路徑和接點電阻；電流加倍會使固定電阻的發熱變成四倍。
evidence.detailEn: A replacement motor supply connector runs hotter; inspect contact resistance. Identify the return path and contact resistance. Doubling current quadruples heat at fixed resistance.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 直流穩態簡化；不含集膚效應、溫升改變電阻或保護協調。
evidence.detailEn: Simplified steady DC model excluding skin effect, temperature-dependent resistance and protection coordination.

decisions.text: 降低負載並比較較低路徑電阻，保留熱點量測
decisions.textEn: Reduce load and compare lower path resistance while retaining hotspot measurement
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。直流穩態簡化；不含集膚效應、溫升改變電阻或保護協調。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Simplified steady DC model excluding skin effect, temperature-dependent resistance and protection coordination.

decisions.text: 只換更大的保險元件，忽略接點發熱
decisions.textEn: Fit a larger protective element while ignoring contact heating
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先確認回流路徑和接點電阻；電流加倍會使固定電阻的發熱變成四倍。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Identify the return path and contact resistance. Doubling current quadruples heat at fixed resistance.

decisions.text: 停止帶電操作，先在隔離的低壓模型檢查接點
decisions.textEn: Stop energized work and inspect contacts on an isolated low-voltage model
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。直流穩態簡化；不含集膚效應、溫升改變電阻或保護協調。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Simplified steady DC model excluding skin effect, temperature-dependent resistance and protection coordination.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「導體損耗與電流路徑」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：法拉利與精密汽車製造、特斯拉與電動汽車工程、Toyota Prius 油電混合車。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Conductor loss and current path” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Ferrari and Precision Automotive Manufacturing, Tesla and Electric Vehicle Engineering, Toyota Prius hybrid vehicle.

missions.title: 03 · 熱源與散熱路徑
missions.brief: 控制器在靜止台架上比流動空氣中更熱，熱阻條件不同。 你是車輛台架工程師。本次「車輛台架：續航與停止」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A stationary controller bench runs hotter than a flowing-air test because thermal conditions differ. As vehicle test-bench engineer in “Vehicle Bench: Endurance and Stopping”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 控制器在靜止台架上比流動空氣中更熱，熱阻條件不同。 先確認功率是轉成熱的耗散量，不是標示的輸出功率；依相同參考點比較溫度。
evidence.detailEn: A stationary controller bench runs hotter than a flowing-air test because thermal conditions differ. First identify dissipated heat rather than rated output power; compare temperatures at the same reference point.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
evidence.detailEn: Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

decisions.text: 先降低負載並檢查散熱接觸，再以同一測點重測
decisions.textEn: Reduce the load, inspect thermal contact, and repeat at the same measurement point
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

decisions.text: 只把溫度顯示上限調高就放行
decisions.textEn: Raise only the display alarm limit and release
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先確認功率是轉成熱的耗散量，不是標示的輸出功率；依相同參考點比較溫度。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. First identify dissipated heat rather than rated output power; compare temperatures at the same reference point.

decisions.text: 暫停交付，完成熱穩定量測後再決定
decisions.textEn: Hold delivery until thermal stabilization is measured
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「熱源與散熱路徑」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：法拉利與精密汽車製造、特斯拉與電動汽車工程、Toyota Prius 油電混合車。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Heat source and thermal path” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Ferrari and Precision Automotive Manufacturing, Tesla and Electric Vehicle Engineering, Toyota Prius hybrid vehicle.

missions.title: 04 · 桌面車輛停止距離
missions.brief: 顯示已回應不等於車模停止；反應時間與減速距離要分開記錄。 你是車輛台架工程師。本次「車輛台架：續航與停止」在第 4 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A responsive display does not mean the model has stopped; record response and braking travel separately. As vehicle test-bench engineer in “Vehicle Bench: Endurance and Stopping”, investigate the record at station 4: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 顯示已回應不等於車模停止；反應時間與減速距離要分開記錄。 將感知與反應距離、減速距離分開，檢查速度平方造成的差異。
evidence.detailEn: A responsive display does not mean the model has stopped; record response and braking travel separately. Separate sensing/response travel from braking travel and inspect the speed-squared term.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 常減速度、平面無坡度模型；不是實車煞車認證或道路駕駛建議。
evidence.detailEn: Constant-deceleration level-surface model, not vehicle brake certification or driving guidance.

decisions.text: 在低速隔離模型測試延遲與停止距離
decisions.textEn: Test delay and stopping distance with an isolated low-speed model
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。常減速度、平面無坡度模型；不是實車煞車認證或道路駕駛建議。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Constant-deceleration level-surface model, not vehicle brake certification or driving guidance.

decisions.text: 只改善顯示延遲，忽略真實致動與停止距離
decisions.textEn: Improve display delay while ignoring actuator delay and stopping distance
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。將感知與反應距離、減速距離分開，檢查速度平方造成的差異。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Separate sensing/response travel from braking travel and inspect the speed-squared term.

decisions.text: 暫停移動模型，完成感測與急停檢查
decisions.textEn: Stop model motion and inspect sensing and emergency stop
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。常減速度、平面無坡度模型；不是實車煞車認證或道路駕駛建議。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Constant-deceleration level-surface model, not vehicle brake certification or driving guidance.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「桌面車輛停止距離」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：法拉利與精密汽車製造、特斯拉與電動汽車工程、Toyota Prius 油電混合車。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Tabletop vehicle stopping distance” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Ferrari and Precision Automotive Manufacturing, Tesla and Electric Vehicle Engineering, Toyota Prius hybrid vehicle.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程情境；各站使用明示假設的獨立教學算例，串接的是驗證與交班流程，不是同一實機的校準數位孿生、廠商配方或操作許可。照片為具來源的代表性實拍；教學目標區間不是法規或設備允收值。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering scenario. Stations use independent teaching fixtures with stated assumptions, linked by verification and handoff rather than a calibrated twin, vendor recipe or operating authorization. Credited photographs are representative. Target bands are teaching objectives, not regulatory or equipment limits.

campaigns.titleEn: Earth Observation: Bring the Data Home

campaigns.briefEn: Reconcile communication geometry, sensor data rate and energy for a fictional observing payload and build a traceable ground handoff.
