stations.title: 通訊幾何延遲
stations.description: 這是單程幾何延遲；要另外加上排隊、編碼、處理及回程路徑。
stations.descriptionEn: This is one-way geometric delay; add queueing, encoding, processing and return-path terms separately.

stations.title: 資料通道的餘量
stations.description: 一致使用十進位 kB，並把封包與儲存標頭計入有效容量的估計。
stations.descriptionEn: Use decimal kB consistently and account for packet and storage overhead in effective capacity.

stations.title: 可用能源與任務時間
stations.description: 先從名目儲能扣除不能使用的餘量，再除以同一時間窗的平均負載。
stations.descriptionEn: Allow for unusable energy before dividing by the average load over the same mission window.

stations.title: 計數訊號與背景
stations.description: 假設訊號與背景是獨立 Poisson 計數，檢查背景控制是否比單純延長曝光更有效。
stations.descriptionEn: Assume independent Poisson signal and background counts; compare background control with simply extending exposure.

missions.title: 01 · 通訊幾何延遲
missions.brief: 地面站只報幾何傳播時間，使用者看到的等待卻還包括排程與處理。 你是酬載資料工程師。本次「地球觀測：把資料帶回家」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: The ground station reports geometry-only propagation, while user waiting also includes scheduling and processing. As payload data engineer in “Earth Observation: Bring the Data Home”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 地面站只報幾何傳播時間，使用者看到的等待卻還包括排程與處理。 這是單程幾何延遲；要另外加上排隊、編碼、處理及回程路徑。
evidence.detailEn: The ground station reports geometry-only propagation, while user waiting also includes scheduling and processing. This is one-way geometric delay; add queueing, encoding, processing and return-path terms separately.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 路徑長度為教學假設，不代表任何星系真實延遲或訊號覆蓋。
evidence.detailEn: Path length is a teaching assumption, not the measured latency or coverage of a constellation.

decisions.text: 分開記錄傳播與處理項，對照同方向時間戳
decisions.textEn: Record propagation and processing separately against same-direction timestamps
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。路徑長度為教學假設，不代表任何星系真實延遲或訊號覆蓋。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Path length is a teaching assumption, not the measured latency or coverage of a constellation.

decisions.text: 把幾何延遲當成完整端到端延遲
decisions.textEn: Treat geometric delay as complete end-to-end latency
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。這是單程幾何延遲；要另外加上排隊、編碼、處理及回程路徑。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. This is one-way geometric delay; add queueing, encoding, processing and return-path terms separately.

decisions.text: 保留延遲預算，待幾何與排隊資料完整再交班
decisions.textEn: Retain the delay budget until geometry and queue data are complete
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。路徑長度為教學假設，不代表任何星系真實延遲或訊號覆蓋。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Path length is a teaching assumption, not the measured latency or coverage of a constellation.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「通訊幾何延遲」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：星鏈與低軌通訊星系、Landsat 地球觀測計畫、James Webb 太空望遠鏡。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Geometric communication delay” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Starlink and Low-Earth-Orbit Networks, Landsat Earth-observation program, James Webb Space Telescope.

missions.title: 02 · 資料通道的餘量
missions.brief: 影像解析度增加後每事件資料量變大，原通道餘量不再足夠。 你是酬載資料工程師。本次「地球觀測：把資料帶回家」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Higher image resolution increases bytes per event and consumes the old channel headroom. As payload data engineer in “Earth Observation: Bring the Data Home”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 影像解析度增加後每事件資料量變大，原通道餘量不再足夠。 一致使用十進位 kB，並把封包與儲存標頭計入有效容量的估計。
evidence.detailEn: Higher image resolution increases bytes per event and consumes the old channel headroom. Use decimal kB consistently and account for packet and storage overhead in effective capacity.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
evidence.detailEn: Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

decisions.text: 保留尖峰餘量並以固定負載重播檢查丟棄
decisions.textEn: Retain burst headroom and replay a fixed workload to check drops
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

decisions.text: 只看平均頻寬，隱藏丟棄計數
decisions.textEn: Inspect only average bandwidth and hide drop counts
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。一致使用十進位 kB，並把封包與儲存標頭計入有效容量的估計。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Use decimal kB consistently and account for packet and storage overhead in effective capacity.

decisions.text: 降採樣非關鍵流量並保留完整原始測試紀錄
decisions.textEn: Downsample noncritical traffic while preserving full test records
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「資料通道的餘量」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：星鏈與低軌通訊星系、Landsat 地球觀測計畫、James Webb 太空望遠鏡。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Data-path headroom” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Starlink and Low-Earth-Orbit Networks, Landsat Earth-observation program, James Webb Space Telescope.

missions.title: 03 · 可用能源與任務時間
missions.brief: 回傳工作增加了平均負載，需要保留觀測任務結束後的能源。 你是酬載資料工程師。本次「地球觀測：把資料帶回家」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Extra downlink work raises average load; retain energy after the observation task ends. As payload data engineer in “Earth Observation: Bring the Data Home”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 回傳工作增加了平均負載，需要保留觀測任務結束後的能源。 先從名目儲能扣除不能使用的餘量，再除以同一時間窗的平均負載。
evidence.detailEn: Extra downlink work raises average load; retain energy after the observation task ends. Allow for unusable energy before dividing by the average load over the same mission window.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界

stations.title: 定位殘差
stations.description: 殘差是相同座標系下的目標差，先核對零點、方向與工具中心點。
stations.descriptionEn: Residuals compare target and result in one coordinate system; verify origin, direction and tool center point.

stations.title: 端到端延遲交接
stations.description: 先用同一筆交易的時間戳分解延遲，避免把非同批次的平均值當成最壞情況。
stations.descriptionEn: Decompose one transaction using consistent timestamps; unrelated averages do not form a worst case.

stations.title: 截面載重路徑
stations.description: 先找出真正承載的淨截面，確認 N/mm² 等於 MPa。
stations.descriptionEn: Identify the net load-bearing section; N/mm² equals MPa.

stations.title: 逐站良率與重工追蹤
stations.description: 使用相同批次的條件通過率相乘；各站缺陷分母與重工紀錄必須一致。
stations.descriptionEn: Multiply conditional pass fractions for one lot; reconcile defect denominators and rework records.

missions.title: 01 · 定位殘差
missions.brief: 機器人模擬工具更換後座標偏移，顯示中心未等於工具中心點。 你是製造工作格驗證工程師。本次「機器人工作格：定位之後」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Changing a simulated robot tool shifts coordinates; display center is not the tool center point. As workcell verification engineer in “Robot Workcell: Beyond Positioning”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 機器人模擬工具更換後座標偏移，顯示中心未等於工具中心點。 殘差是相同座標系下的目標差，先核對零點、方向與工具中心點。
evidence.detailEn: Changing a simulated robot tool shifts coordinates; display center is not the tool center point. Residuals compare target and result in one coordinate system; verify origin, direction and tool center point.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 二維幾何殘差，不代表重複性、絕對精度或機器人安全距離。
evidence.detailEn: Two-dimensional geometric residual, not repeatability, absolute accuracy or robot safeguarding distance.

decisions.text: 先確認座標基準，再獨立量測修正後位置
decisions.textEn: Verify the coordinate datum and independently measure corrected position
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。二維幾何殘差，不代表重複性、絕對精度或機器人安全距離。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Two-dimensional geometric residual, not repeatability, absolute accuracy or robot safeguarding distance.

decisions.text: 把畫面圖示對齊當成實體位置已校正
decisions.textEn: Treat aligned screen icons as calibrated physical position
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。殘差是相同座標系下的目標差，先核對零點、方向與工具中心點。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Residuals compare target and result in one coordinate system; verify origin, direction and tool center point.

decisions.text: 保持致動器停用，使用標準件重建基準
decisions.textEn: Keep actuators disabled and re-establish the datum with a reference artifact
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。二維幾何殘差，不代表重複性、絕對精度或機器人安全距離。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Two-dimensional geometric residual, not repeatability, absolute accuracy or robot safeguarding distance.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「定位殘差」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：Universal Robots UR5 協作手臂。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Positioning residual” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Universal Robots UR5 collaborative arm.

missions.title: 02 · 端到端延遲交接
missions.brief: 控制命令的時間戳不一致，需先拆解感知、排隊與計算。 你是製造工作格驗證工程師。本次「機器人工作格：定位之後」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Command timestamps disagree; first separate sensing, queueing and computation. As workcell verification engineer in “Robot Workcell: Beyond Positioning”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 控制命令的時間戳不一致，需先拆解感知、排隊與計算。 先用同一筆交易的時間戳分解延遲，避免把非同批次的平均值當成最壞情況。
evidence.detailEn: Command timestamps disagree; first separate sensing, queueing and computation. Decompose one transaction using consistent timestamps; unrelated averages do not form a worst case.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 固定教學延遲相加，未描述尾端分布與併行重疊；實際 SLO 需要分位數與負載測試。
evidence.detailEn: Fixed sequential teaching delays; tail distributions and overlap require percentile and load testing.

decisions.text: 先處理主要排隊瓶頸，再重播相同測試流量
decisions.textEn: Address the dominant queue, then replay the same workload
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。固定教學延遲相加，未描述尾端分布與併行重疊；實際 SLO 需要分位數與負載測試。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Fixed sequential teaching delays; tail distributions and overlap require percentile and load testing.

decisions.text: 只換更快的處理器，忽略排隊與傳輸
decisions.textEn: Buy a faster processor while ignoring queue and transfer delays
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先用同一筆交易的時間戳分解延遲，避免把非同批次的平均值當成最壞情況。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Decompose one transaction using consistent timestamps; unrelated averages do not form a worst case.

decisions.text: 保留原始追蹤，降低流量後逐段定位
decisions.textEn: Preserve traces, reduce traffic, and isolate each stage
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。固定教學延遲相加，未描述尾端分布與併行重疊；實際 SLO 需要分位數與負載測試。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Fixed sequential teaching delays; tail distributions and overlap require percentile and load testing.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「端到端延遲交接」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：Universal Robots UR5 協作手臂。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “End-to-end latency handoff” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Universal Robots UR5 collaborative arm.

missions.title: 03 · 截面載重路徑
missions.brief: 夾持架改版後截面縮小，先用停機試件檢查載重路徑。 你是製造工作格驗證工程師。本次「機器人工作格：定位之後」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A revised fixture has a smaller section; inspect the load path on a stopped specimen. As workcell verification engineer in “Robot Workcell: Beyond Positioning”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 夾持架改版後截面縮小，先用停機試件檢查載重路徑。 先找出真正承載的淨截面，確認 N/mm² 等於 MPa。
evidence.detailEn: A revised fixture has a smaller section; inspect the load path on a stopped specimen. Identify the net load-bearing section; N/mm² equals MPa.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 均勻軸向平均應力，不含缺口、屈曲、疲勞與複材方向性；不是結構設計驗證。
evidence.detailEn: Mean uniaxial stress excludes notches, buckling, fatigue and composite anisotropy; not design verification.

decisions.text: 檢查截面與載重方向，將缺口效應列入後續試驗
decisions.textEn: Check section and load direction; include notch effects in follow-up tests
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。均勻軸向平均應力，不含缺口、屈曲、疲勞與複材方向性；不是結構設計驗證。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Mean uniaxial stress excludes notches, buckling, fatigue and composite anisotropy; not design verification.

decisions.text: 只因平均應力小就宣稱整體安全
decisions.textEn: Declare the complete structure safe from low average stress alone
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先找出真正承載的淨截面，確認 N/mm² 等於 MPa。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Identify the net load-bearing section; N/mm² equals MPa.

decisions.text: 暫停放行，保留試片進行獨立載重檢查
decisions.textEn: Hold release and retain the specimen for independent load checks
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。均勻軸向平均應力，不含缺口、屈曲、疲勞與複材方向性；不是結構設計驗證。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Mean uniaxial stress excludes notches, buckling, fatigue and composite anisotropy; not design verification.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「截面載重路徑」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：Universal Robots UR5 協作手臂。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Load through a section” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Universal Robots UR5 collaborative arm.

missions.title: 04 · 逐站良率與重工追蹤
missions.brief: 工作格有重抓後才通過的件，品質報告卻沒有區分返工。 你是製造工作格驗證工程師。本次「機器人工作格：定位之後」在第 4 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Some workcell units pass only after regripping, but quality records do not distinguish rework. As workcell verification engineer in “Robot Workcell: Beyond Positioning”, investigate the record at station 4: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 工作格有重抓後才通過的件，品質報告卻沒有區分返工。 使用相同批次的條件通過率相乘；各站缺陷分母與重工紀錄必須一致。
evidence.detailEn: Some workcell units pass only after regripping, but quality records do not distinguish rework. Multiply conditional pass fractions for one lot; reconcile defect denominators and rework records.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 這是三站一次通過率，非企業實際良率；多次返工與不同批次不能直接混合。
evidence.detailEn: Three-station first-pass yield, not company data. Do not mix repeated rework with different lots.

decisions.text: 先依批號找出掉率站，再追查量測與製程條件
decisions.textEn: Trace the loss by lot and station, then inspect measurement and process conditions
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。這是三站一次通過率，非企業實際良率；多次返工與不同批次不能直接混合。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Three-station first-pass yield, not company data. Do not mix repeated rework with different lots.

decisions.text: 刪除失敗件後重算分母，讓良率看起來變高
decisions.textEn: Remove failed units from the denominator to inflate yield
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。使用相同批次的條件通過率相乘；各站缺陷分母與重工紀錄必須一致。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Multiply conditional pass fractions for one lot; reconcile defect denominators and rework records.

decisions.text: 隔離可疑批次，增加一次獨立抽樣
decisions.textEn: Quarantine the suspect lot and take an independent sample
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。這是三站一次通過率，非企業實際良率；多次返工與不同批次不能直接混合。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Three-station first-pass yield, not company data. Do not mix repeated rework with different lots.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「逐站良率與重工追蹤」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：Universal Robots UR5 協作手臂。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Station yields and rework traceability” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Universal Robots UR5 collaborative arm.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程情境；各站使用明示假設的獨立教學算例，串接的是驗證與交班流程，不是同一實機的校準數位孿生、廠商配方或操作許可。照片為具來源的代表性實拍；教學目標區間不是法規或設備允收值。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering scenario. Stations use independent teaching fixtures with stated assumptions, linked by verification and handoff rather than a calibrated twin, vendor recipe or operating authorization. Credited photographs are representative. Target bands are teaching objectives, not regulatory or equipment limits.

campaigns.title: 工業共生：交換的證據
campaigns.brief: 把工業共生案例轉成熱流、材料流與量測邊界的教學交班，不提供現廠化學操作參數。
campaigns.briefEn: Turn industrial symbiosis into handoff exercises about heat, material flows and measurement boundaries without plant chemical operating parameters.

stations.title: 可回收顯熱
stations.description: 先核對每批質量及可用溫差，區分能源 kJ 與功率 kW。
stations.descriptionEn: Reconcile batch mass and usable temperature change; distinguish energy in kJ from power in kW.

stations.title: 回收的質量帳
stations.description: 回收分母包含同批次全部投入，分子只計入符合指定品質的回收流。
stations.descriptionEn: The denominator includes all batch input; the numerator includes only recovered material meeting the stated quality.

stations.title: 輸入輸出的能源核對
stations.description: 輸入、輸出必須使用相同時間窗與系統邊界；輔助設備耗能要一起計入。
stations.descriptionEn: Use the same time window and system boundary for input and output, including auxiliaries.

stations.title: 兩個獨立誤差來源
stations.description: 確認兩項是同單位、靈敏度係數已納入且不相關的標準不確定度，才用平方和開根號。
stations.descriptionEn: RSS applies here only to same-unit, uncorrelated standard uncertainties with sensitivity factors already included.

missions.title: 01 · 可回收顯熱
missions.brief: 熱源有足夠總熱量，使用端溫度需求卻不同；先核對溫度界線。 你是資源交換工程師。本次「工業共生：交換的證據」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: A source has ample total heat, but the receiving process needs another temperature; reconcile limits first. As resource-exchange engineer in “Industrial Symbiosis: Evidence of Exchange”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 熱源有足夠總熱量，使用端溫度需求卻不同；先核對溫度界線。 先核對每批質量及可用溫差，區分能源 kJ 與功率 kW。
evidence.detailEn: A source has ample total heat, but the receiving process needs another temperature; reconcile limits first. Reconcile batch mass and usable temperature change; distinguish energy in kJ from power in kW.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 常數比熱且無相變；換熱效率、污染與溫度夾點另需分析。
evidence.detailEn: Constant specific heat without phase change; effectiveness, fouling and pinch temperature need separate analysis.

decisions.text: 列出冷熱流的溫度界線，再比較熱回收配置
decisions.textEn: Record hot/cold stream temperature limits before comparing heat recovery
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。常數比熱且無相變；換熱效率、污染與溫度夾點另需分析。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Constant specific heat without phase change; effectiveness, fouling and pinch temperature need separate analysis.

decisions.text: 把所有熱量當成任何溫度都能利用的能源
decisions.textEn: Treat all heat as usable at any required temperature
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先核對每批質量及可用溫差，區分能源 kJ 與功率 kW。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Reconcile batch mass and usable temperature change; distinguish energy in kJ from power in kW.

decisions.text: 保留現有熱流紀錄，延長量測至負載穩定
decisions.textEn: Retain heat-flow records and extend measurement until load stabilizes
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。常數比熱且無相變；換熱效率、污染與溫度夾點另需分析。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Constant specific heat without phase change; effectiveness, fouling and pinch temperature need separate analysis.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「可回收顯熱」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：卡倫堡工業共生系統。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Recoverable sensible heat” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Kalundborg Industrial Symbiosis.

missions.title: 02 · 回收的質量帳
missions.brief: 交換物料中含不明成分，不能全部算成可用回收流。 你是資源交換工程師。本次「工業共生：交換的證據」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: An exchanged material stream contains unknown constituents and cannot all count as usable recovery. As resource-exchange engineer in “Industrial Symbiosis: Evidence of Exchange”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 交換物料中含不明成分，不能全部算成可用回收流。 回收分母包含同批次全部投入，分子只計入符合指定品質的回收流。
evidence.detailEn: An exchanged material stream contains unknown constituents and cannot all count as usable recovery. The denominator includes all batch input; the numerator includes only recovered material meeting the stated quality.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 只算質量回收率，不等於碳排降低率、經濟效益或無害化證明。
evidence.detailEn: Mass recovery is not carbon reduction, economic benefit or proof of detoxification.

decisions.text: 分開登錄可用回收流、污染流與剩餘物
decisions.textEn: Record usable recovery, contaminated streams and residues separately
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。只算質量回收率，不等於碳排降低率、經濟效益或無害化證明。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Mass recovery is not carbon reduction, economic benefit or proof of detoxification.

decisions.text: 把污染殘渣一起算進合格回收量
decisions.textEn: Count contaminated residue as qualified recovery
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。回收分母包含同批次全部投入，分子只計入符合指定品質的回收流。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. The denominator includes all batch input; the numerator includes only recovered material meeting the stated quality.

decisions.text: 隔離未知成分材料，待分析後再決定去向
decisions.textEn: Isolate unknown material until analysis determines its destination
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。只算質量回收率，不等於碳排降低率、經濟效益或無害化證明。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Mass recovery is not carbon reduction, economic benefit or proof of detoxification.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「回收的質量帳」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：卡倫堡工業共生系統。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Recovery mass accounting” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Kalundborg Industrial Symbiosis.

missions.title: 03 · 輸入輸出的能源核對
missions.brief: 共用泵與輸送耗能沒列入，交換前後效益需要重新畫邊界。 你是資源交換工程師。本次「工業共生：交換的證據」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Shared pumping and transport energy are omitted; redraw boundaries before comparing benefits. As resource-exchange engineer in “Industrial Symbiosis: Evidence of Exchange”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 共用泵與輸送耗能沒列入，交換前後效益需要重新畫邊界。 輸入、輸出必須使用相同時間窗與系統邊界；輔助設備耗能要一起計入。
evidence.detailEn: Shared pumping and transport energy are omitted; redraw boundaries before comparing benefits. Use the same time window and system boundary for input and output, including auxiliaries.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 固定邊界的能量比，不代表所有操作點效率；輸出大於輸入時應先檢查邊界與時間戳。
evidence.detailEn: Energy ratio for one fixed boundary, not every operating point; apparent output above input calls for boundary and timestamp checks.

decisions.text: 對齊電表時間與輔助負載，再比較改版前後
decisions.textEn: Align meter timestamps and auxiliary loads before comparing revisions
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。固定邊界的能量比，不代表所有操作點效率；輸出大於輸入時應先檢查邊界與時間戳。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Energy ratio for one fixed boundary, not every operating point; apparent output above input calls for boundary and timestamp checks.

decisions.text: 用瞬間峰值輸出除以全日平均輸入
decisions.textEn: Divide peak instantaneous output by daily-average input
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。輸入、輸出必須使用相同時間窗與系統邊界；輔助設備耗能要一起計入。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Use the same time window and system boundary for input and output, including auxiliaries.

decisions.text: 延長量測時間，等待儲能狀態回到相同基準
decisions.textEn: Extend measurement until stored energy returns to the same baseline
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。固定邊界的能量比，不代表所有操作點效率；輸出大於輸入時應先檢查邊界與時間戳。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Energy ratio for one fixed boundary, not every operating point; apparent output above input calls for boundary and timestamp checks.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「輸入輸出的能源核對」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：卡倫堡工業共生系統。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Input-output energy reconciliation” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Kalundborg Industrial Symbiosis.

missions.title: 04 · 兩個獨立誤差來源
missions.brief: 兩間工廠使用不同量測時間窗，先核對校正與時間才合併帳。 你是資源交換工程師。本次「工業共生：交換的證據」在第 4 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 兩間工廠使用不同量測時間窗，先核對校正與時間才合併帳。 確認兩項是同單位、靈敏度係數已納入且不相關的標準不確定度，才用平方和開根號。
evidence.detailEn: Two facilities meter different time windows; reconcile calibration and time before merging accounts. RSS applies here only to same-unit, uncorrelated standard uncertainties with sensitivity factors already included.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 合成標準不確定度不是保證誤差上限；有相關性時要加共變異項。
evidence.detailEn: Combined standard uncertainty is not a guaranteed error bound; correlated terms require covariance.

inputs.label: 重複量測標準不確定度

decisions.text: 保留來源與相關性假設，與允收區間一起交班

decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。合成標準不確定度不是保證誤差上限；有相關性時要加共變異項。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Combined standard uncertainty is not a guaranteed error bound; correlated terms require covariance.

decisions.text: 把 uc 當成絕不超過的誤差上限

decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。確認兩項是同單位、靈敏度係數已納入且不相關的標準不確定度，才用平方和開根號。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. RSS applies here only to same-unit, uncorrelated standard uncertainties with sensitivity factors already included.

decisions.text: 先取得共同校正來源的相關性資料再作結論
decisions.textEn: Obtain correlation information for shared calibration sources before concluding
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。合成標準不確定度不是保證誤差上限；有相關性時要加共變異項。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Combined standard uncertainty is not a guaranteed error bound; correlated terms require covariance.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「兩個獨立誤差來源」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：卡倫堡工業共生系統。

campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering scenario. Stations use independent teaching fixtures with stated assumptions, linked by verification and handoff rather than a calibrated twin, vendor recipe or operating authorization. stations.title: 計數訊號與背景
stations.description: 假設訊號與背景是獨立 Poisson 計數，檢查背景控制是否比單純延長曝光更有效。
stations.descriptionEn: Assume independent Poisson signal and background counts; compare background control with simply extending exposure.

stations.title: 時間取樣與最高頻率
stations.description: 先限定量測頻帶並使用抗混疊濾波；取樣比例超過一只是理想必要條件。
stations.descriptionEn: Limit the measurement band and use anti-alias filtering; a ratio above one is only an ideal necessary condition.

stations.title: 資料通道的餘量
stations.description: 一致使用十進位 kB，並把封包與儲存標頭計入有效容量的估計。
stations.descriptionEn: Use decimal kB consistently and account for packet and storage overhead in effective capacity.

stations.title: 熱源與散熱路徑
stations.description: 先確認功率是轉成熱的耗散量，不是標示的輸出功率；依相同參考點比較溫度。
stations.descriptionEn: First identify dissipated heat rather than rated output power; compare temperatures at the same reference point.

missions.title: 01 · 計數訊號與背景
missions.brief: 觸發事件增加但背景更高，先檢查計數模型的假設。 你是偵測資料工程師。本次「大科學值班：事件不能丟」在第 1 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Triggers rise while background rises further; inspect the counting-model assumptions. As detector data engineer in “Big Science Shift: Preserve the Events”, investigate the record at station 1: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 觸發事件增加但背景更高，先檢查計數模型的假設。 假設訊號與背景是獨立 Poisson 計數，檢查背景控制是否比單純延長曝光更有效。
evidence.detailEn: Triggers rise while background rises further; inspect the counting-model assumptions. Assume independent Poisson signal and background counts; compare background control with simply extending exposure.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 已知平均背景的簡化模型；另行量背景、讀出雜訊、死時間或飽和會改變公式。
evidence.detailEn: Simplified known-mean background model; separately estimated background, read noise, dead time and saturation alter the formula.

decisions.text: 先量背景與飽和界線，再選擇曝光方案
decisions.textEn: Measure background and saturation limits before choosing exposure
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。已知平均背景的簡化模型；另行量背景、讀出雜訊、死時間或飽和會改變公式。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Simplified known-mean background model; separately estimated background, read noise, dead time and saturation alter the formula.

decisions.text: 刪去背景計數，但不計入背景不確定度
decisions.textEn: Subtract background while ignoring its uncertainty
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。假設訊號與背景是獨立 Poisson 計數，檢查背景控制是否比單純延長曝光更有效。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Assume independent Poisson signal and background counts; compare background control with simply extending exposure.

decisions.text: 分開記錄暗場與亮場，待線性區確認後交付
decisions.textEn: Record dark and illuminated frames separately and verify linear response
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。已知平均背景的簡化模型；另行量背景、讀出雜訊、死時間或飽和會改變公式。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Simplified known-mean background model; separately estimated background, read noise, dead time and saturation alter the formula.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「計數訊號與背景」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：大型強子對撞機LHC。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Counting signal and background” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Large Hadron Collider LHC.

missions.title: 02 · 時間取樣與最高頻率
missions.brief: 脈衝波形改變後讀出仍用舊取樣頻率，可能失去高頻資訊。 你是偵測資料工程師。本次「大科學值班：事件不能丟」在第 2 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: Pulse shapes change while readout retains its old sampling rate, potentially losing high-frequency information. As detector data engineer in “Big Science Shift: Preserve the Events”, investigate the record at station 2: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 脈衝波形改變後讀出仍用舊取樣頻率，可能失去高頻資訊。 先限定量測頻帶並使用抗混疊濾波；取樣比例超過一只是理想必要條件。
evidence.detailEn: Pulse shapes change while readout retains its old sampling rate, potentially losing high-frequency information. Limit the measurement band and use anti-alias filtering; a ratio above one is only an ideal necessary condition.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 不含濾波器過渡帶、時脈抖動與 ADC 雜訊；不是充分的儀器規格。
evidence.detailEn: Filter transition bands, clock jitter and ADC noise are excluded; this is not a sufficient instrument specification.

decisions.text: 確認抗混疊濾波，再以已知頻率注入訊號測試
decisions.textEn: Verify anti-alias filtering and test with known injected frequencies
decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。不含濾波器過渡帶、時脈抖動與 ADC 雜訊；不是充分的儀器規格。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Filter transition bands, clock jitter and ADC noise are excluded; this is not a sufficient instrument specification.

decisions.text: 用內插點數代替真正取樣頻率
decisions.textEn: Substitute interpolated points for real sampling rate
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先限定量測頻帶並使用抗混疊濾波；取樣比例超過一只是理想必要條件。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Limit the measurement band and use anti-alias filtering; a ratio above one is only an ideal necessary condition.

decisions.text: 縮小分析頻帶並保存原始取樣資料
decisions.textEn: Reduce the analysis band and preserve raw samples
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。不含濾波器過渡帶、時脈抖動與 ADC 雜訊；不是充分的儀器規格。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Filter transition bands, clock jitter and ADC noise are excluded; this is not a sufficient instrument specification.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「時間取樣與最高頻率」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：大型強子對撞機LHC。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Time sampling and bandwidth” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Large Hadron Collider LHC.

missions.title: 03 · 資料通道的餘量
missions.brief: 高事件率讓傳輸通道丟棄資料，需保留丟棄計數與尖峰紀錄。 你是偵測資料工程師。本次「大科學值班：事件不能丟」在第 3 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。
missions.briefEn: High event rates drop transport data; preserve drop counters and burst records. As detector data engineer in “Big Science Shift: Preserve the Events”, investigate the record at station 3: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. Values are original fictional fixtures.

evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 高事件率讓傳輸通道丟棄資料，需保留丟棄計數與尖峰紀錄。 一致使用十進位 kB，並把封包與儲存標頭計入有效容量的估計。
evidence.detailEn: High event rates drop transport data; preserve drop counters and burst records. Use decimal kB consistently and account for packet and storage overhead in effective capacity.

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界
evidence.detail: 平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
evidence.detailEn: Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

decisions.text: 保留尖峰餘量並以固定負載重播檢查丟棄

decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

decisions.text: 只看平均頻寬，隱藏丟棄計數
decisions.textEn: Inspect only average bandwidth and hide drop counts
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。一致使用十進位 kB，並把封包與儲存標頭計入有效容量的估計。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. Use decimal kB consistently and account for packet and storage overhead in effective capacity.

decisions.text: 降採樣非關鍵流量並保留完整原始測試紀錄
decisions.textEn: Downsample noncritical traffic while preserving full test records
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。平均利用率不是尾端延遲或突發保證；必須另看佇列與丟棄計數。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Average utilization is not a tail-latency or burst guarantee; inspect queues and drops separately.

missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Data-path headroom” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Large Hadron Collider LHC.

missions.title: 04 · 熱源與散熱路徑
missions.brief: 讀出模組持續運轉後熱漂移，需比較負載和散熱接觸狀態。 你是偵測資料工程師。本次「大科學值班：事件不能丟」在第 4 站遇到一筆待查資料：先讀兩張證據卡，再調整假設參數使教學算例落入目標區間，最後選擇處置。數值為原創虛構資料。

As detector data engineer in “Big Science Shift: Preserve the Events”, investigate the record at station 4: read both evidence cards, adjust assumed parameters into the teaching target band, and choose a disposition. evidence.title: 值班紀錄：待查異常
evidence.detail: 讀出模組持續運轉後熱漂移，需比較負載和散熱接觸狀態。 先確認功率是轉成熱的耗散量，不是標示的輸出功率；依相同參考點比較溫度。

evidence.title: 試驗卡：模型適用邊界

decisions.feedback: 留下可重現的處置證據。穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reproducible disposition evidence is retained. Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

decisions.text: 只把溫度顯示上限調高就放行
decisions.textEn: Raise only the display alarm limit and release
decisions.feedback: 這個捷徑沒有解除原始疑點。先確認功率是轉成熱的耗散量，不是標示的輸出功率；依相同參考點比較溫度。
decisions.feedbackEn: This shortcut does not resolve the original concern. First identify dissipated heat rather than rated output power; compare temperatures at the same reference point.

decisions.text: 暫停交付，完成熱穩定量測後再決定
decisions.textEn: Hold delivery until thermal stabilization is measured
decisions.feedback: 保守暫停有助保留證據，但增加時間與資源成本。穩態集中熱阻模型；熱阻依安裝與氣流而變，不能把算例當成器件額定值。
decisions.feedbackEn: A cautious hold retains evidence at additional time and resource cost. Steady lumped thermal model; mounting and airflow change resistance. This fixture is not a device rating.

missions.debrief: 交班須包含：輸入與單位、算式、兩張證據卡、處置原因，以及「熱源與散熱路徑」仍不能證明的事項。延伸課程：大型強子對撞機LHC。
missions.debriefEn: Handoff includes inputs and units, formula, both evidence cards, rationale and what “Heat source and thermal path” still cannot establish. Linked courses: Large Hadron Collider LHC.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程情境；各站使用明示假設的獨立教學算例，串接的是驗證與交班流程，不是同一實機的校準數位孿生、廠商配方或操作許可。照片為具來源的代表性實拍；教學目標區間不是法規或設備允收值。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering scenario. Stations use independent teaching fixtures with stated assumptions, linked by verification and handoff rather than a calibrated twin, vendor recipe or operating authorization. Credited photographs are representative. Target bands are teaching objectives, not regulatory or equipment limits.

campaigns.title: 跨河橋梁試載日
campaigns.brief: 偏心載重與撓度報告不一致，你要從靜力帳、截面、位移到索力逐站復核。
campaigns.briefEn: Eccentric-load and deflection reports disagree. Reconcile equilibrium, section stress, displacement and cable forces.

stations.descriptionEn: A deck model receives an eccentric load. Choose its position and inspect the left support reaction.

stations.description: 以單軸拉伸試片比較截面方案，選出能在本任務應力範圍內的面積。
stations.descriptionEn: Compare ideal axial coupon areas and select one inside the learning stress range.

stations.description: 實驗梁中點位移過大；增加截面慣性矩並觀察撓度如何改變。
stations.descriptionEn: A test beam deflects too much at midspan; vary inertia and observe the response.

stations.description: 檢查模型索的垂直及水平分量，避免把兩個正交分量直接相加。
stations.descriptionEn: Check vertical and horizontal force components without adding perpendicular components directly.

missions.title: 移動載重與支承反力
missions.brief: 橋面模型收到偏心載重，先選擇試載位置，再判斷左支承所承受的反力。
missions.briefEn: A deck model receives an eccentric load. Choose its position and inspect the left support reaction.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 簡支跨距 10 m；單一垂直載重 1200 kN；忽略梁自重。
evidence.detailEn: Simply supported span 10 m; one vertical load 1200 kN; beam self-weight omitted.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 位置 x 從左側量；兩支承反力總和應為 1200 kN。這不是多跨橋的分配模型。
evidence.detailEn: x is measured from the left. Reactions must sum to 1200 kN; this is not a continuous-span bridge model.

decisions.text: 保存兩支承反力並檢查總力平衡
decisions.textEn: Save both reactions and check equilibrium
decisions.feedback: 先做總力與力矩平衡，才知道負載移動造成哪一端反力增大。
decisions.feedbackEn: Force and moment equilibrium identify which support load increases.

decisions.text: 把載重平均分給兩端
decisions.textEn: Split every load equally between supports
decisions.feedback: 僅在對稱位置才可平均；偏心載重不能如此處理。
decisions.feedbackEn: Equal splitting only applies to symmetric loading.

decisions.text: 只增加梁的重量來修正反力
decisions.textEn: Add beam weight to correct the reaction
decisions.feedback: 新增重量改變問題本身，不能代替釐清量測位置。
decisions.feedbackEn: Adding weight changes the case rather than resolving the position.

missions.debrief: 先做總力與力矩平衡，才知道負載移動造成哪一端反力增大。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Force and moment equilibrium identify which support load increases. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 吊裝耳板的截面檢核
missions.brief: 以單軸拉伸試片比較截面方案，選出能在本任務應力範圍內的面積。
missions.briefEn: Compare ideal axial coupon areas and select one inside the learning stress range.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 虛構試件承受 900 kN 軸力；1 N/mm² = 1 MPa。
evidence.detailEn: Fictional specimen axial force is 900 kN; 1 N/mm² equals 1 MPa.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 未計孔口應力集中、屈曲、疲勞或焊縫；平均應力通過不等於吊裝核准。
evidence.detailEn: Hole concentration, buckling, fatigue and welds are omitted; average stress is not lifting approval.

decisions.text: 保留平均應力結果並提出孔口局部分析
decisions.textEn: Keep average stress and request local hole analysis
decisions.feedback: 截面計算只完成第一層檢核；幾何集中與接合仍需另行驗證。
decisions.feedbackEn: Section stress is only the first check; concentrations and joints need separate verification.

decisions.text: 平均應力合格便直接吊裝
decisions.textEn: Authorize a lift from average stress alone
decisions.feedback: 平均值未涵蓋孔口、接合與動態荷載。
decisions.feedbackEn: Average stress omits holes, connections and dynamic loads.

decisions.text: 將 kN 當成 N 計算
decisions.textEn: Treat kN as N
decisions.feedback: 力的換算少了 1000 倍，應力會嚴重低估。
decisions.feedbackEn: The missing factor of 1000 severely understates stress.

missions.debrief: 截面計算只完成第一層檢核；幾何集中與接合仍需另行驗證。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Section stress is only the first check; concentrations and joints need separate verification. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 撓度與慣性矩的取捨
missions.brief: 實驗梁中點位移過大；增加截面慣性矩並觀察撓度如何改變。
missions.briefEn: A test beam deflects too much at midspan; vary inertia and observe the response.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 跨距 20 m、中央集中力 400 kN、E = 200000000 kN/m²。
evidence.detailEn: Span 20 m, central point load 400 kN, E = 200000000 kN/m².

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: Euler–Bernoulli 小撓度、簡支梁；忽略剪切變形。此式不適用整座斜張橋。
evidence.detailEn: Small-deflection Euler–Bernoulli simply supported beam; shear deformation omitted. It is not a cable-stayed bridge model.

decisions.text: 記錄慣性矩與撓度並核對模型邊界
decisions.textEn: Record inertia and deflection with the model limits
decisions.feedback: 慣性矩增加會降低此模型的撓度，但自重與施工成本也應另列比較。
decisions.feedbackEn: Larger inertia reduces this deflection, while weight and cost require separate comparisons.

decisions.text: 把截面面積代入慣性矩
decisions.textEn: Substitute area for second moment
decisions.feedback: m² 與 m⁴ 維度不同，結果沒有正確物理意義。
decisions.feedbackEn: Area in m² cannot replace inertia in m⁴.

decisions.text: 把梁計算當成整橋認證
decisions.textEn: Treat a beam result as bridge certification
decisions.feedback: 邊界、索力及多構件相互作用均未納入。
decisions.feedbackEn: Boundary conditions, cables and member interactions are not included.

missions.debrief: 慣性矩增加會降低此模型的撓度，但自重與施工成本也應另列比較。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Larger inertia reduces this deflection, while weight and cost require separate comparisons. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 索力分量的向量合成
missions.brief: 檢查模型索的垂直及水平分量，避免把兩個正交分量直接相加。
missions.briefEn: Check vertical and horizontal force components without adding perpendicular components directly.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 垂直分量固定 600 kN；水平分量為可比較的虛構幾何方案。
evidence.detailEn: Vertical component is 600 kN; horizontal component represents fictional geometry alternatives.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 僅為二維靜力向量；未含索垂度、預力損失及錨具效率。
evidence.detailEn: Two-dimensional static vector only; sag, prestress loss and anchorage efficiency omitted.

decisions.text: 用向量模長回報並標出座標方向
decisions.textEn: Report vector magnitude with coordinate directions
decisions.feedback: 索力是向量合成；分量方向及共同座標必須保留。
decisions.feedbackEn: Cable tension comes from vector resolution; directions and coordinates must remain explicit.

decisions.text: 直接把水平與垂直分量相加
decisions.textEn: Add horizontal and vertical components directly
decisions.feedback: 只有同方向分量才可如此相加。
decisions.feedbackEn: Only collinear components can be added this way.

decisions.text: 只檢查垂直分量
decisions.textEn: Check only the vertical component
decisions.feedback: 忽略水平分量會低估索力，也遺漏錨碇反力。
decisions.feedbackEn: Omitting the horizontal component understates tension and anchorage reaction.

missions.debrief: 索力是向量合成；分量方向及共同座標必須保留。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Cable tension comes from vector resolution; directions and coordinates must remain explicit. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程教學任務；實拍為代表性背景，數值和通過範圍不是同名設施規格、法規門檻或現場操作指令。模型分站獨立，不宣稱校準數位孿生。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

campaigns.title: 高樓模型整合室
campaigns.brief: 重力、側推與振動組提供不同模型，建立可以追溯的共同交班。
campaigns.briefEn: Gravity, lateral and vibration teams use different idealizations. Build a traceable common handover.

photo.titleEn: Representative photograph: Danjiang Bridge under construction, 2025
photo.author: Taiwankengo

stations.title: 柱截面與軸向壓應力
stations.description: 模型柱需承受同一組重力荷載，比較截面積的影響。
stations.descriptionEn: Compare column areas under the same model gravity load.

stations.title: 側向剛度與層間位移
stations.description: 樓層等效彈簧模型在側推力下過軟；選擇新的剛度方案。
stations.descriptionEn: A single-story equivalent spring is too flexible under lateral force; choose another stiffness.

stations.title: 單自由度頻率辨識
stations.description: 檢查振動模型是否把質量與重量混用。
stations.descriptionEn: Check whether the vibration model confuses mass and weight.

stations.title: 基礎抗傾覆的力矩帳
stations.description: 整理桌面模型的穩定與傾覆力矩，避免只比較垂直力大小。
stations.descriptionEn: Tabulate stabilizing and overturning moments for a tabletop model.

missions.title: 柱截面與軸向壓應力
missions.brief: 模型柱需承受同一組重力荷載，比較截面積的影響。
missions.briefEn: Compare column areas under the same model gravity load.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 軸力 18000 kN；面積以 m² 輸入，kN/m² 再除以 1000 得 MPa。
evidence.detailEn: Axial force 18000 kN; divide kN/m² by 1000 for MPa.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 平均壓應力忽略彎矩、偏心與長柱穩定；需在結果中保留此限制。
evidence.detailEn: Average compression omits bending, eccentricity and slender-column stability.

decisions.text: 提出軸力與彎矩共同檢核需求
decisions.textEn: Request combined axial and bending checks
decisions.feedback: 截面平均值不能代替長柱穩定與偏心分析。
decisions.feedbackEn: Average stress cannot replace stability and eccentricity analysis.

decisions.text: 將平均壓力當完整承載力
decisions.textEn: Use average pressure as complete capacity
decisions.feedback: 構件穩定和材料非線性尚未計算。
decisions.feedbackEn: Stability and material nonlinearity remain unchecked.

decisions.text: 更改荷載紀錄讓數字過關
decisions.textEn: Change the load record to pass
decisions.feedback: 荷載是案例條件，不能為了過關任意降低。
decisions.feedbackEn: The load is case evidence and cannot be reduced merely to pass.

missions.debrief: 截面平均值不能代替長柱穩定與偏心分析。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Average stress cannot replace stability and eccentricity analysis. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 側向剛度與層間位移
missions.brief: 樓層等效彈簧模型在側推力下過軟；選擇新的剛度方案。
missions.briefEn: A single-story equivalent spring is too flexible under lateral force; choose another stiffness.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 水平力 600 kN；單自由度線性模型，樓層高度未用作真實規範檢核。
evidence.detailEn: Lateral force 600 kN; linear single-degree-of-freedom model, not a code story-drift check.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 高樓扭轉、P–Δ 與非線性未含；剛度增加也可能改變受力分配。
evidence.detailEn: Tower torsion, P–Δ and nonlinearity omitted; added stiffness may redistribute loads.

decisions.text: 同時保存剛度方案與位移變化
decisions.textEn: Keep stiffness alternatives and displacement changes
decisions.feedback: 把位移改善和可能的力重分配一起交班。
decisions.feedbackEn: Handover records both drift reduction and possible force redistribution.

decisions.text: 只把畫面位移縮小
decisions.textEn: Shrink the displayed displacement only
decisions.feedback: 改圖比例沒有改變剛度或計算結果。
decisions.feedbackEn: Changing display scale changes neither stiffness nor the result.

decisions.text: 無限制加剛而不看受力
decisions.textEn: Add unlimited stiffness without force review
decisions.feedback: 位移下降不等於每個構件需求下降。
decisions.feedbackEn: Lower drift does not imply lower demand in every member.

missions.debrief: 把位移改善和可能的力重分配一起交班。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Handover records both drift reduction and possible force redistribution. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 單自由度頻率辨識
missions.brief: 檢查振動模型是否把質量與重量混用。
missions.briefEn: Check whether the vibration model confuses mass and weight.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 等效質量 200000 kg；剛度以 N/m 輸入。
evidence.detailEn: Equivalent mass 200000 kg; stiffness is entered in N/m.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 這是未阻尼單模態練習；實際高樓有多模態、阻尼與風致作用。
evidence.detailEn: Undamped single-mode exercise; real towers have multiple modes, damping and wind effects.

decisions.text: 用質量單位重算並比對頻譜
decisions.textEn: Recalculate with mass units and compare the spectrum
decisions.feedback: 頻率只約束這個簡化模態，不能推出全部舒適度或抗震能力。
decisions.feedbackEn: Frequency constrains only this simplified mode, not all comfort or seismic performance.

decisions.text: 把公斤重量再乘重力後代入
decisions.textEn: Multiply mass by gravity before substitution
decisions.feedback: 公式需要質量，代入重量將破壞維度。
decisions.feedbackEn: The formula requires mass; weight breaks dimensional consistency.

decisions.text: 頻率吻合就忽略阻尼
decisions.textEn: Ignore damping after matching frequency
decisions.feedback: 共振振幅仍與阻尼和激振有關。
decisions.feedbackEn: Resonant amplitude still depends on damping and forcing.

missions.debrief: 頻率只約束這個簡化模態，不能推出全部舒適度或抗震能力。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Frequency constrains only this simplified mode, not all comfort or seismic performance. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 基礎抗傾覆的力矩帳
missions.brief: 整理桌面模型的穩定與傾覆力矩，避免只比較垂直力大小。
missions.briefEn: Tabulate stabilizing and overturning moments for a tabletop model.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 重力 25000 kN；傾覆力矩 120000 kN·m；本關目標比值為虛構條件。
evidence.detailEn: Weight 25000 kN; overturning moment 120000 kN·m; target ratio is fictional.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 僅比較合力矩，不含地基承載、滑動、揚壓或地震組合。
evidence.detailEn: Resultant moment balance only; bearing, sliding, uplift and seismic combinations omitted.

decisions.text: 附力臂草圖並列出未檢項目
decisions.textEn: Attach lever-arm sketch and unchecked items
decisions.feedback: 力矩比值有用，但地基接觸壓力及其他失效模式仍需另看。
decisions.feedbackEn: The moment ratio is useful, but bearing pressure and other failure modes need review.

decisions.text: 直接比較重量與力矩
decisions.textEn: Compare weight directly with moment
decisions.feedback: kN 與 kN·m 不能直接相除當無因次安全判斷。
decisions.feedbackEn: kN and kN·m cannot be compared as a dimensionless safety check.

decisions.text: 將結果稱為建築設計安全係數
decisions.textEn: Label the result a design safety factor
decisions.feedback: 本關的虛構比值不是任何法規所定義的安全係數。
decisions.feedbackEn: The fictional ratio is not a code-defined safety factor.

missions.debrief: 力矩比值有用，但地基接觸壓力及其他失效模式仍需另看。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: The moment ratio is useful, but bearing pressure and other failure modes need review. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程教學任務；實拍為代表性背景，數值和通過範圍不是同名設施規格、法規門檻或現場操作指令。模型分站獨立，不宣稱校準數位孿生。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

campaigns.title: 城市結構維護班
campaigns.brief: 巡檢同時收到溫差、減薄與裂縫警訊，分清真變化和量測偏差。
campaigns.briefEn: Inspection reports thermal movement, thinning and crack alerts. Separate real change from measurement bias.

photo.titleEn: Representative photograph: Danjiang Bridge construction view, 2025

stations.title: 伸縮縫的溫差位移
stations.description: 維護日誌顯示伸縮縫接近行程端點；估算自由熱伸長。
stations.descriptionEn: A maintenance log shows a joint near its travel limit; estimate free thermal expansion.

stations.title: 腐蝕剩餘厚度與餘裕
stations.description: 對局部均勻腐蝕的教學試片安排再次量測期限。
stations.descriptionEn: Plan a repeat measurement for an ideal uniformly corroding coupon.

stations.title: 裂縫比較的共同基準
stations.description: 兩次照片比例不同；先扣除量測偏差，再比較裂縫開度。
stations.descriptionEn: Two photographs use different scales; remove measurement bias before comparing openings.

stations.title: 維護樣本的抽樣涵蓋
stations.description: 比較巡檢工時內可重複檢查的構件比例，保留高風險點的加查需求。
stations.descriptionEn: Compare repeatable inspection coverage within available hours, keeping high-risk follow-up separate.

missions.title: 伸縮縫的溫差位移
missions.brief: 維護日誌顯示伸縮縫接近行程端點；估算自由熱伸長。
missions.briefEn: A maintenance log shows a joint near its travel limit; estimate free thermal expansion.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 示意鋼構長 120 m；假設均一溫差與自由伸縮。
evidence.detailEn: Illustrative steel length 120 m; uniform temperature and free movement assumed.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 拘束與溫度梯度會引入力；不能把空氣溫度直接視為構件均溫。
evidence.detailEn: Restraint and gradients induce force; air temperature is not automatically member temperature.

decisions.text: 比對構件溫度、縫寬與基準日期
decisions.textEn: Compare member temperature, gap and baseline date
decisions.feedback: 同時保留溫度與位移才能區分正常熱變形和卡滯。
decisions.feedbackEn: Temperature and movement together help distinguish thermal response from binding.

decisions.text: 把縫隙焊死防止移動
decisions.textEn: Weld the gap shut to stop movement
decisions.feedback: 限制熱變形可能引入額外內力。
decisions.feedbackEn: Restraining thermal movement may introduce additional forces.

decisions.text: 只用當天氣溫判定異常
decisions.textEn: Use daily air temperature alone
decisions.feedback: 構件溫度和基準狀態可能不同。
decisions.feedbackEn: Member temperature and baseline conditions may differ.

missions.debrief: 同時保留溫度與位移才能區分正常熱變形和卡滯。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Temperature and movement together help distinguish thermal response from binding. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 腐蝕剩餘厚度與餘裕
missions.brief: 對局部均勻腐蝕的教學試片安排再次量測期限。
missions.briefEn: Plan a repeat measurement for an ideal uniformly corroding coupon.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 初厚 12 mm；腐蝕率是本關假設常數，目標保留至少 9 mm。
evidence.detailEn: Initial thickness 12 mm; constant rate is fictional; retain at least 9 mm for this case.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 局部坑蝕不服從均勻減薄；不能由此給出實橋壽命。
evidence.detailEn: Pitting does not follow uniform thinning; the result is not bridge remaining life.

decisions.text: 以多點測厚驗證腐蝕型態
decisions.textEn: Verify corrosion type with multiple thickness points
decisions.feedback: 預測需用實測更新，並另外檢查坑蝕與接合。
decisions.feedbackEn: Update forecasts with measurements and inspect pitting and connections separately.

decisions.text: 只測最厚的位置
decisions.textEn: Measure only the thickest location
decisions.feedback: 會系統性高估剩餘截面。
decisions.feedbackEn: This systematically overestimates the remaining section.

decisions.text: 把負厚度繼續外插
decisions.textEn: Continue extrapolating negative thickness
decisions.feedback: 厚度不能為負；模型在材料耗盡前就應停止外推。
decisions.feedbackEn: Thickness cannot be negative; extrapolation must stop before depletion.

missions.debrief: 預測需用實測更新，並另外檢查坑蝕與接合。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Update forecasts with measurements and inspect pitting and connections separately. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 裂縫比較的共同基準
missions.brief: 兩次照片比例不同；先扣除量測偏差，再比較裂縫開度。
missions.briefEn: Two photographs use different scales; remove measurement bias before comparing openings.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 基準裂縫寬 0.30 mm；本次影像 0.42 mm；獨立標尺指示 +0.10 mm 偏差。
evidence.detailEn: Baseline 0.30 mm; current image 0.42 mm; independent scale indicates +0.10 mm bias.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 本模型只做偏差修正；光照、方向與辨識不確定度尚未合併。
evidence.detailEn: Bias correction only; lighting, orientation and detection uncertainty are not combined.

decisions.text: 保留原值與修正值並安排複測
decisions.textEn: Keep raw and corrected values and repeat measurement
decisions.feedback: 可追溯校正避免把量測偏差誤判成結構劣化。
decisions.feedbackEn: Traceable correction avoids mistaking measurement bias for deterioration.

decisions.text: 刪除較大的原始讀值
decisions.textEn: Delete the larger raw reading
decisions.feedback: 刪除證據會失去追溯性。
decisions.feedbackEn: Deleting evidence destroys traceability.

decisions.text: 把修正後小差值視為無風險
decisions.textEn: Treat a small corrected difference as no risk
decisions.feedback: 其他裂縫特徵與載重狀態尚未審查。
decisions.feedbackEn: Other crack features and loading remain unreviewed.

missions.debrief: 可追溯校正避免把量測偏差誤判成結構劣化。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Traceable correction avoids mistaking measurement bias for deterioration. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 維護樣本的抽樣涵蓋
missions.brief: 比較巡檢工時內可重複檢查的構件比例，保留高風險點的加查需求。
missions.briefEn: Compare repeatable inspection coverage within available hours, keeping high-risk follow-up separate.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 本輪清單共 80 個構件；已核對數不能包含只有拍照但未判讀的項目。
evidence.detailEn: The list has 80 components; photos without interpretation do not count as verified.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 涵蓋率不是缺陷檢出率，也不代表未檢點沒有問題。
evidence.detailEn: Coverage is not detection probability and says nothing certain about uninspected items.

decisions.text: 交班列出未檢清單與風險排序
decisions.textEn: Handover uninspected items with risk priorities
decisions.feedback: 分母和未完成項目透明，比只報高百分比有用。
decisions.feedbackEn: An explicit denominator and unfinished list are more useful than a high percentage alone.

decisions.text: 把未看照片也算完成
decisions.textEn: Count unseen photographs as completed
decisions.feedback: 這會虛增涵蓋率並隱藏工作缺口。
decisions.feedbackEn: This inflates coverage and hides unfinished work.

decisions.text: 只反覆檢查容易抵達的點
decisions.textEn: Repeatedly inspect only easy-to-reach points
decisions.feedback: 重複點不能當成新增涵蓋，且可能漏掉高風險區。
decisions.feedbackEn: Repeated points do not add coverage and may omit high-risk areas.

missions.debrief: 分母和未完成項目透明，比只報高百分比有用。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: An explicit denominator and unfinished list are more useful than a high percentage alone. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程教學任務；實拍為代表性背景，數值和通過範圍不是同名設施規格、法規門檻或現場操作指令。模型分站獨立，不宣稱校準數位孿生。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

campaigns.title: 隧道模型掘進交班
campaigns.brief: 進尺帳與出土帳對不上；先查時間與幾何基準，再核對環隙和測量閉合。
campaigns.briefEn: Advance and spoil ledgers disagree. Review time and geometry before annulus and survey closure.

photo.title: 代表性實拍：雪山隧道坪林端施工，2002 年
photo.titleEn: Representative photograph: Hsuehshan Tunnel Pinglin portal construction, 2002
photo.author: Encino

stations.title: 切削與利用率分開記帳
stations.description: 模型掘進紀錄顯示高轉速但低日進尺；檢查停機時間。
stations.descriptionEn: A model drive shows high rotation but low daily advance; inspect utilization.

stations.title: 出土量與幾何基準
stations.description: 用理論開挖體積檢查量測帳，避免把鬆方直接當實方。
stations.descriptionEn: Use theoretical excavation volume to check the ledger without confusing loose and in-situ volume.

stations.title: 環隙幾何與材料預算
stations.description: 管片與開挖外徑不同；算出理想環隙，核對材料單位。
stations.descriptionEn: Segments and excavation have different diameters; calculate ideal annulus volume.

stations.title: 導線閉合與定位復核
stations.description: 兩方向閉合差都不大，但需要合成後再與本關誤差預算比較。
stations.descriptionEn: Both coordinate closure components look small; combine them before comparing the case budget.

missions.title: 切削與利用率分開記帳
missions.brief: 模型掘進紀錄顯示高轉速但低日進尺；檢查停機時間。
missions.briefEn: A model drive shows high rotation but low daily advance; inspect utilization.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 轉速固定 4 rev/min；有效利用率包含換刀、搬運及檢查停時。
evidence.detailEn: Rotation is 4 rev/min; utilization accounts for cutter, transport and inspection downtime.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 單純運動學估計，未含地層、推力與扭矩，不是機台設定建議。
evidence.detailEn: Kinematic estimate only; ground, thrust and torque omitted; not machine-setting advice.

decisions.text: 把停機分類後再比較進尺
decisions.textEn: Classify downtime before comparing advance
decisions.feedback: 平均進尺同時受切削效率與系統等待影響。
decisions.feedbackEn: Average advance depends on cutting and system waiting.

decisions.text: 只提高轉速追進度
decisions.textEn: Increase rotation alone to recover schedule
decisions.feedback: 未審查載荷與地層便改轉速，模型也無法支持。
decisions.feedbackEn: The model cannot justify speed changes without load and ground review.

decisions.text: 刪去停機時間再報高產能
decisions.textEn: Remove downtime to report higher output
decisions.feedback: 利用率定義被改寫，跨班資料失去可比性。
decisions.feedbackEn: Changing utilization definitions makes shifts incomparable.

missions.debrief: 平均進尺同時受切削效率與系統等待影響。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Average advance depends on cutting and system waiting. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 出土量與幾何基準
missions.brief: 用理論開挖體積檢查量測帳，避免把鬆方直接當實方。
missions.briefEn: Use theoretical excavation volume to check the ledger without confusing loose and in-situ volume.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 開挖直徑 6 m；此關比較 1.5 m 記錄段的實方幾何量。
evidence.detailEn: Excavation diameter 6 m; compare in-situ geometry for the logged 1.5 m segment.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 實際出土量需含含水率、膨脹係數與計量誤差；此式只給幾何基準。
evidence.detailEn: Spoil totals need moisture, bulking and measurement corrections; this is only geometric reference.

decisions.text: 先統一實方與鬆方再比對
decisions.textEn: Convert in-situ and loose volumes before comparison
decisions.feedback: 同一體積基準才能判斷差異是否值得追查。
decisions.feedbackEn: A common volume basis is needed before interpreting discrepancies.

decisions.text: 把任何出土多量都當坍方
decisions.textEn: Label every excess spoil volume a collapse
decisions.feedback: 膨脹與含水可能改變帳面體積，需先排除計量差異。
decisions.feedbackEn: Bulking and water can change reported volume; check measurement first.

decisions.text: 強制把實測量改為理論值
decisions.textEn: Force measurements to equal theory
decisions.feedback: 這抹去了可用於異常診斷的證據。
decisions.feedbackEn: This erases evidence useful for anomaly diagnosis.

missions.debrief: 同一體積基準才能判斷差異是否值得追查。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: A common volume basis is needed before interpreting discrepancies. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 環隙幾何與材料預算
missions.brief: 管片與開挖外徑不同；算出理想環隙，核對材料單位。
missions.briefEn: Segments and excavation have different diameters; calculate ideal annulus volume.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 開挖直徑 6 m、環長 1.5 m；D_inner 指環隙內界，即管片外徑。
evidence.detailEn: Excavation diameter 6 m and ring length 1.5 m; D_inner is the annulus inner boundary, the segment outside diameter.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 理想環隙不等於現場注入量；地層流失、管路與材料收縮未計。
evidence.detailEn: Ideal void is not site injection quantity; losses, pipes and shrinkage are omitted.

decisions.text: 標示兩個直徑並分開理論量與實測量
decisions.textEn: Label both diameters and separate theory from measured use
decisions.feedback: 清楚的幾何定義避免把管片內徑誤當外徑。
decisions.feedbackEn: Explicit geometry avoids confusing segment inner and outer diameters.

decisions.text: 用管片內徑算外側環隙
decisions.textEn: Use segment inside diameter for the external annulus
decisions.feedback: 會把管片實體也算進空隙。
decisions.feedbackEn: This incorrectly includes solid segment material in the void.

decisions.text: 把算出體積直接當注入指令
decisions.textEn: Use calculated volume as an injection command
decisions.feedback: 現場控制需要材料、壓力和監測等獨立設計。
decisions.feedbackEn: Site control requires separate material, pressure and monitoring design.

missions.debrief: 清楚的幾何定義避免把管片內徑誤當外徑。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Explicit geometry avoids confusing segment inner and outer diameters. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 導線閉合與定位復核
missions.brief: 兩方向閉合差都不大，但需要合成後再與本關誤差預算比較。
missions.briefEn: Both coordinate closure components look small; combine them before comparing the case budget.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 獨立復測後預期 dx = 3 mm、dy = 4 mm；本關合成上限 5 mm。
evidence.detailEn: Repeat survey expects dx 3 mm and dy 4 mm; case resultant limit 5 mm.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 閉合差小不代表沒有系統誤差；座標基準和儀器校正仍需核對。
evidence.detailEn: Small closure does not exclude systematic error; datum and calibration still matter.

decisions.text: 保留閉合向量並核對共同基準
decisions.textEn: Keep the closure vector and confirm the datum
decisions.feedback: 向量及原始觀測一起保存，才能追查定位差異。
decisions.feedbackEn: Vectors and raw observations together preserve traceability.

decisions.text: 取兩誤差中的較小值
decisions.textEn: Use the smaller coordinate error
decisions.feedback: 這沒有表示平面合成偏差。
decisions.feedbackEn: This does not represent planar displacement.

decisions.text: 調整坐標直到差值消失
decisions.textEn: Adjust coordinates until error disappears
decisions.feedback: 沒有獨立觀測支持的調整會隱藏問題。
decisions.feedbackEn: Unsupported coordinate changes hide the problem.

missions.debrief: 向量及原始觀測一起保存，才能追查定位差異。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Vectors and raw observations together preserve traceability. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程教學任務；實拍為代表性背景，數值和通過範圍不是同名設施規格、法規門檻或現場操作指令。模型分站獨立，不宣稱校準數位孿生。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

campaigns.title: 地下水與沉陷觀測室
campaigns.brief: 水位、流量與沉陷是三種不同證據，不能只用單一數值決定作業。
campaigns.briefEn: Head, flow and settlement are different evidence types; a single value cannot decide work.

photo.title: 代表性實拍：雪山隧道南側洞口，2007 年
photo.titleEn: Representative photograph: Hsuehshan Tunnel south portal, 2007
photo.author: Encino

stations.title: 水頭與孔隙壓力
stations.description: 不同儀器報告水頭與壓力，先統一單位。
stations.descriptionEn: Instruments report head and pressure; first use a common unit.

stations.title: 滲流與水力梯度
stations.description: 比較降低梯度與降低流通截面對模型流量的影響。
stations.descriptionEn: Compare the effects of gradient and flow area on model seepage.

stations.title: 壓密估算與模型層厚
stations.description: 用一維線性試算比較不同土層厚度下的沉陷。
stations.descriptionEn: Compare layer thicknesses in a one-dimensional linear settlement estimate.

stations.title: 積水量與排水時間帳
stations.description: 以有限積水量估算模型排水時間，辨識持續入流帶來的差異。
stations.descriptionEn: Estimate drain time for stored water and identify the effect of continuing inflow.

missions.title: 水頭與孔隙壓力
missions.brief: 不同儀器報告水頭與壓力，先統一單位。
missions.briefEn: Instruments report head and pressure; first use a common unit.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 採淡水 ρ = 1000 kg/m³；校核水頭 10 m。
evidence.detailEn: Fresh water density 1000 kg/m³; checking head is 10 m.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 水頭需相對同一測點與基準；此關不給開挖面壓力設定。
evidence.detailEn: Head must refer to the same point and datum; this is not an excavation pressure setting.

decisions.text: 記錄測點高程並比對壓力
decisions.textEn: Record point elevation and compare pressure
decisions.feedback: 同一基準可避免把地表水位與測點水頭混淆。
decisions.feedbackEn: A common datum avoids confusing surface level with head above the sensor.

decisions.text: 把水位高程直接當水頭
decisions.textEn: Use absolute water elevation as head
decisions.feedback: 缺少測點高程便無法得到壓力水頭。
decisions.feedbackEn: Sensor elevation is required to obtain pressure head.

decisions.text: 直接套用此值到機台控制
decisions.textEn: Apply this value directly to machine control
decisions.feedback: 機台控制還涉及地層與總應力，不由此單式決定。
decisions.feedbackEn: Machine control also depends on ground and total stress.

missions.debrief: 同一基準可避免把地表水位與測點水頭混淆。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: A common datum avoids confusing surface level with head above the sensor. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 滲流與水力梯度
missions.brief: 比較降低梯度與降低流通截面對模型流量的影響。
missions.briefEn: Compare the effects of gradient and flow area on model seepage.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 滲透係數 10⁻⁴ m/s、截面 120 m²；達西模型假設飽和層流。
evidence.detailEn: Hydraulic conductivity 10⁻⁴ m/s and area 120 m²; Darcy model assumes saturated laminar flow.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 不含裂隙優勢流、非均質及時間變化；低流量不代表地層穩定。
evidence.detailEn: Preferential fractures, heterogeneity and transients omitted; low flow does not prove stability.

decisions.text: 以流量與水頭共同檢查模型
decisions.textEn: Check flow and head together
decisions.feedback: 單點流量應與梯度及監測時間一起解讀。
decisions.feedbackEn: Interpret point flow with gradient and observation time.

decisions.text: 用流量小證明沒有滲流風險
decisions.textEn: Use low flow to claim no seepage risk
decisions.feedback: 局部高梯度與土粒流失未由總流量排除。
decisions.feedbackEn: Total flow does not exclude local gradients or soil loss.

decisions.text: 把小時當秒代入
decisions.textEn: Substitute hours as seconds
decisions.feedback: 單位錯誤造成 3600 倍差異。
decisions.feedbackEn: The unit error creates a factor of 3600.

missions.debrief: 單點流量應與梯度及監測時間一起解讀。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Interpret point flow with gradient and observation time. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 壓密估算與模型層厚
missions.brief: 用一維線性試算比較不同土層厚度下的沉陷。
missions.briefEn: Compare layer thicknesses in a one-dimensional linear settlement estimate.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 體積壓縮係數 0.0002 m²/kN、應力增量 80 kPa。
evidence.detailEn: Volume compressibility 0.0002 m²/kN; stress increment 80 kPa.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 小應變一維終值估算，不含施工流失、固結時間及土層非線性。
evidence.detailEn: Small-strain one-dimensional final estimate; ground loss, time and nonlinearity omitted.

decisions.text: 把終值估算與時間監測分開
decisions.textEn: Separate final settlement from time monitoring
decisions.feedback: 算得終值不能說明何時發生，也不能代替現場位移趨勢。
decisions.feedbackEn: A final estimate says nothing about timing and cannot replace measured trends.

decisions.text: 把終值當成本日沉陷
decisions.textEn: Treat final settlement as today’s movement
decisions.feedback: 缺少時間模型，無法如此推論。
decisions.feedbackEn: No time model supports that inference.

decisions.text: 套用到所有土層
decisions.textEn: Apply one compressibility to every layer
decisions.feedback: 不同土層及應力範圍可能需要不同參數。
decisions.feedbackEn: Different layers and stress ranges may require different parameters.

missions.debrief: 算得終值不能說明何時發生，也不能代替現場位移趨勢。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: A final estimate says nothing about timing and cannot replace measured trends. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 積水量與排水時間帳
missions.brief: 以有限積水量估算模型排水時間，辨識持續入流帶來的差異。
missions.briefEn: Estimate drain time for stored water and identify the effect of continuing inflow.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 初始積水 240 m³；持續入流 20 m³/h；泵量為理想常數。
evidence.detailEn: Initial stored water 240 m³; inflow 20 m³/h; pump flow assumed constant.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 未計揚程效率、備援與水位變化；排水可能改變鄰地地下水條件。
evidence.detailEn: Head efficiency, backup and changing level omitted; dewatering can affect adjacent groundwater.

decisions.text: 用淨排量計時並附地下水監測需求
decisions.textEn: Use net removal rate and include groundwater monitoring
decisions.feedback: 泵量需先扣入流，且不能把排空時間當成環境可接受性。
decisions.feedbackEn: Subtract inflow first; emptying time does not establish environmental acceptability.

decisions.text: 用總泵量直接除積水量
decisions.textEn: Divide stored water by total pump flow
decisions.feedback: 忽略持續入流會低估所需時間。
decisions.feedbackEn: Ignoring inflow understates drain time.

decisions.text: 只追求最快排空
decisions.textEn: Optimize only for the fastest drain
decisions.feedback: 鄰地沉陷與排放條件仍未評估。
decisions.feedbackEn: Adjacent settlement and discharge conditions remain unchecked.

missions.debrief: 泵量需先扣入流，且不能把排空時間當成環境可接受性。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Subtract inflow first; emptying time does not establish environmental acceptability. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 通風換氣率的體積基準
missions.brief: 地下空間模型有新風量與循環風量，先區分後計算換氣率。
missions.briefEn: A model underground space has fresh and recirculated air; distinguish them before calculating air changes.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 模型空間 12000 m³；只有新風流量進入本關 ACH。
evidence.detailEn: Space volume 12000 m³; only fresh air enters this ACH calculation.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 換氣率不表示污染分布均勻，也不是消防或人員進入許可。
evidence.detailEn: ACH does not prove uniform pollutant distribution or provide fire/access clearance.

decisions.text: 保留新風與回風分帳
decisions.textEn: Keep separate fresh-air and recirculation records
decisions.feedback: 換氣量需與局部量測共同判讀。
decisions.feedbackEn: Air change must be interpreted with local measurements.

decisions.text: 把回風也算成全新空氣
decisions.textEn: Count all recirculation as fresh air
decisions.feedback: 會高估外氣稀釋能力。
decisions.feedbackEn: This overestimates outdoor-air dilution.

decisions.text: 只用 ACH 核准人員進入
decisions.textEn: Approve entry from ACH alone
decisions.feedback: 有害氣體、氧氣及其他風險未量測。
decisions.feedbackEn: Hazardous gases, oxygen and other risks remain unmeasured.

missions.debrief: 換氣量需與局部量測共同判讀。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Air change must be interpreted with local measurements. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 開挖與支護的進度接口
missions.brief: 以虛構工序看板檢查未完成支護的工作量。
missions.briefEn: Check unfinished support work in a fictional sequencing board.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 本輪開挖記錄 26 m；只有驗證過的支護計入完成。
evidence.detailEn: Logged excavation 26 m; only verified support counts as complete.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 長度差只是工作接口指標，不是允許無支護長度或施工方法。
evidence.detailEn: Length difference is a workflow indicator, not allowable unsupported length or a construction method.

decisions.text: 先處理未驗證支護並停止新增工作票
decisions.textEn: Resolve unverified support before adding work tickets
decisions.feedback: 看板暴露接口缺口，實際作業仍須由專業方案控制。
decisions.feedbackEn: The board exposes interface gaps; actual work remains governed by professional plans.

decisions.text: 把已排程支護也算完成
decisions.textEn: Count scheduled support as completed
decisions.feedback: 排程不等於驗證完成。
decisions.feedbackEn: Scheduled work is not verified completion.

decisions.text: 忽略接口只追開挖長度
decisions.textEn: Track excavation length alone
decisions.feedback: 只看單工序產出會掩蓋未完成保護。
decisions.feedbackEn: Single-process output hides unfinished protection.

missions.debrief: 看板暴露接口缺口，實際作業仍須由專業方案控制。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: The board exposes interface gaps; actual work remains governed by professional plans. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 監測變化率與時間戳
missions.brief: 相同位移差若發生於不同時間，趨勢判讀也不同。
missions.briefEn: The same movement over different intervals implies different rates.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 兩次有效觀測為 5 mm 與 8 mm；時間戳證據為間隔 6 小時。
evidence.detailEn: Valid observations are 5 and 8 mm; timestamp evidence indicates 6 hours.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 兩點差分不代表趨勢持續；變化率需連同基準、噪聲與其他測點檢查。
evidence.detailEn: Two-point difference does not establish a continuing trend; inspect baseline, noise and other points.

decisions.text: 保存原時間戳並加密複測
decisions.textEn: Keep original timestamps and repeat more frequently
decisions.feedback: 監測警訊需要追查，不能以平均值抹去加速變化。
decisions.feedbackEn: Follow up alerts instead of smoothing away acceleration.

decisions.text: 把六小時記成一天
decisions.textEn: Record six hours as one day
decisions.feedback: 改時間會人為壓低變化率。
decisions.feedbackEn: Changing the interval artificially lowers the rate.

decisions.text: 用兩點趨勢保證未來穩定
decisions.textEn: Guarantee future stability from two points
decisions.feedback: 資料不足以支持保證。
decisions.feedbackEn: Two observations cannot support a guarantee.

missions.debrief: 監測警訊需要追查，不能以平均值抹去加速變化。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Follow up alerts instead of smoothing away acceleration. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 地下箱體的揚壓比
missions.brief: 比較假設水位下的向上合力與模型自重。
missions.briefEn: Compare upward force and weight for a model box at a hypothetical water head.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 箱體重 9000 kN、底面積 100 m²；本關忽略側摩擦。
evidence.detailEn: Box weight 9000 kN, base area 100 m²; side friction omitted.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 是合力平衡示意，不包含浮力分項係數、錨定或地基模型。
evidence.detailEn: Resultant-force illustration only; uplift factors, anchors and ground model omitted.

decisions.text: 列出高水位情境供工程師復核
decisions.textEn: List high-water scenarios for engineering review
decisions.feedback: 水位是外在情境，不能為了比值合格任意選低水位。
decisions.feedbackEn: Head is an external scenario, not a value to lower just to pass.

decisions.text: 只用最低水位當設計情境
decisions.textEn: Use only the lowest head
decisions.feedback: 會漏掉上浮需求較高的情境。
decisions.feedbackEn: This omits scenarios with larger uplift demand.

decisions.text: 把自重增加當唯一解法
decisions.textEn: Treat more weight as the only solution
decisions.feedback: 地基與施工荷載也會改變，方案需要整體比較。
decisions.feedbackEn: Foundation and construction loads also change; compare the whole system.

missions.debrief: 水位是外在情境，不能為了比值合格任意選低水位。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Head is an external scenario, not a value to lower just to pass. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程教學任務；實拍為代表性背景，數值和通過範圍不是同名設施規格、法規門檻或現場操作指令。模型分站獨立，不宣稱校準數位孿生。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

campaigns.briefEn: Rising inflow requires joint storage and power checks; first align data references.

stations.title: 一小時庫容收支
stations.description: 入流增加時，以收支核對庫容變化，不把水位直接當體積。
stations.descriptionEn: During increased inflow, use a balance instead of treating water level as volume.

stations.title: 淨水頭與發電能力
stations.description: 比較同水量下不同淨水頭，不把裝置容量當作每刻可發功率。
stations.descriptionEn: Compare net heads at the same flow without confusing nameplate capacity and current capability.
