missions.title: 一小時庫容收支
missions.brief: 入流增加時，以收支核對庫容變化，不把水位直接當體積。
missions.briefEn: During increased inflow, use a balance instead of treating water level as volume.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 初始庫容 500000 m³；入流 80 m³/s，持續 1 h。
evidence.detailEn: Initial storage 500000 m³; inflow 80 m³/s for one hour.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 無蒸發、滲漏和水位庫容曲線；不是水庫放流指令。
evidence.detailEn: Evaporation, seepage and elevation-storage curve omitted; not a reservoir release command.

decisions.text: 交班庫容收支與下游影響待查項
decisions.textEn: Handover storage balance and downstream review items
decisions.feedback: 庫內收支成立仍需檢查下游流量限制與預報。
decisions.feedbackEn: Storage balance still requires downstream constraints and forecasts.

decisions.text: 只看庫容下降就算成功
decisions.textEn: Count lower storage alone as success
decisions.feedback: 下游可能增加風險，不能只最佳化單一指標。
decisions.feedbackEn: Downstream impacts may worsen; one metric is insufficient.

decisions.text: 把每秒流量直接加到庫容
decisions.textEn: Add per-second flow directly to storage
decisions.feedback: 必須乘以正確時間，單位才相符。
decisions.feedbackEn: Flow must be multiplied by time to match volume units.

missions.debrief: 庫內收支成立仍需檢查下游流量限制與預報。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Storage balance still requires downstream constraints and forecasts. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 淨水頭與發電能力
missions.brief: 比較同水量下不同淨水頭，不把裝置容量當作每刻可發功率。
missions.briefEn: Compare net heads at the same flow without confusing nameplate capacity and current capability.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 流量 40 m³/s、假設效率 0.90；淨水頭已扣水力損失。
evidence.detailEn: Flow 40 m³/s and assumed efficiency 0.90; net head already subtracts losses.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 效率為常數假設，未納設備額定限制、尾水或調度條件。
evidence.detailEn: Constant efficiency assumed; equipment limits, tailwater and dispatch omitted.

decisions.text: 分列能力、額定上限與效率假設
decisions.textEn: Separate capability, nameplate limit and efficiency
decisions.feedback: 能量方程給條件能力，實際輸出仍受設備與環境限制。
decisions.feedbackEn: The energy equation gives conditional capability; equipment and environment still constrain output.

decisions.text: 直接以壩高當淨水頭
decisions.textEn: Use dam height as net head
decisions.feedback: 壩高與有效水頭不是同一量。
decisions.feedbackEn: Dam height and available head are different quantities.

decisions.text: 報告永遠等於裝置容量
decisions.textEn: Always report nameplate capacity
decisions.feedback: 流量、水頭和效率變動會改變可發功率。
decisions.feedbackEn: Flow, head and efficiency change available power.

missions.debrief: 能量方程給條件能力，實際輸出仍受設備與環境限制。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: The energy equation gives conditional capability; equipment and environment still constrain output. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 水頭差與滲流路徑
missions.brief: 比較模型滲流路徑長度，理解水力梯度的維度。
missions.briefEn: Compare model seepage path lengths and hydraulic gradient.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 水頭差 12 m；均一一維路徑為本關理想化。
evidence.detailEn: Head difference 12 m; a uniform one-dimensional path is idealized.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 平均梯度不能排除出口局部高梯度與管湧；沒有給真實臨界值。
evidence.detailEn: Average gradient does not exclude local exit gradients or piping; no real critical threshold is provided.

decisions.text: 保留平均結果並要求出口測點
decisions.textEn: Keep average result and request exit measurements
decisions.feedback: 局部觀測與材料條件是判讀不可缺的部分。
decisions.feedbackEn: Local measurements and material conditions are essential to interpretation.

decisions.text: 平均梯度小便刪除警報
decisions.textEn: Delete alerts because average gradient is small
decisions.feedback: 局部風險仍可能存在。
decisions.feedbackEn: Local risk may remain.

decisions.text: 把路徑長度當深度
decisions.textEn: Replace path length with depth
decisions.feedback: 水頭耗散路徑和埋深不一定相同。
decisions.feedbackEn: Flow-path length and burial depth need not match.

missions.debrief: 局部觀測與材料條件是判讀不可缺的部分。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Local measurements and material conditions are essential to interpretation. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 兩套水位的基準校核
missions.brief: 兩支水位計使用不同零點，先做基準轉換再判斷差異。
missions.briefEn: Two gauges use different zeros; transform datums before judging disagreement.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: A 讀值 12.40 m，B 共同基準值 13.00 m；水準測量指示 A 需加 0.60 m。
evidence.detailEn: A reads 12.40 m, B common datum reads 13.00 m; leveling gives +0.60 m for A.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 基準轉換不等於儀器校正；還要核對同步時間與量測誤差。
evidence.detailEn: Datum transformation is not calibration; synchronize time and check measurement uncertainty.

decisions.text: 保留各自原值與轉換規則
decisions.textEn: Keep both raw values and transformation rule
decisions.feedback: 資料可追溯，才能區分真水位變化與基準差異。
decisions.feedbackEn: Traceability distinguishes real changes from datum offsets.

decisions.text: 取兩者平均當真值
decisions.textEn: Average mismatched datums as truth
decisions.feedback: 未統一基準的平均沒有物理意義。
decisions.feedbackEn: A mean across different datums is physically invalid.

decisions.text: 刪掉讀值較高的水位計
decisions.textEn: Discard the higher gauge
decisions.feedback: 不能因讀值較高就判定儀器故障。
decisions.feedbackEn: A higher reading alone does not establish failure.

missions.debrief: 資料可追溯，才能區分真水位變化與基準差異。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Traceability distinguishes real changes from datum offsets. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程教學任務；實拍為代表性背景，數值和通過範圍不是同名設施規格、法規門檻或現場操作指令。模型分站獨立，不宣稱校準數位孿生。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

stations.description: 量測斷面發生變化，用更新後的面積重建流量。
stations.descriptionEn: The measured section changed; reconstruct flow with the updated area.

stations.title: 糙率假設與通水能力
stations.description: 比較同一模型河段的糙率假設，記錄對通水量的敏感度。
stations.descriptionEn: Compare roughness assumptions in the same model reach and record sensitivity.

stations.title: 滯洪容積的事件尺度
stations.description: 用一段簡化洪水歷線檢查需暫存的水量。
stations.descriptionEn: Check temporary storage for one simplified flood-hydrograph interval.

stations.title: 獨立誤差的合成
stations.description: 合併斷面與流速的相對標準不確定度，保留獨立假設。
stations.descriptionEn: Combine area and velocity relative standard uncertainties and preserve the independence assumption.

missions.title: 斷面與流速合成流量
missions.brief: 量測斷面發生變化，用更新後的面積重建流量。
missions.briefEn: The measured section changed; reconstruct flow with the updated area.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 斷面平均流速 1.20 m/s；更新後量測面積為 60 m²。
evidence.detailEn: Section mean velocity is 1.20 m/s; updated measured area 60 m².

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 必須用斷面平均速度，表面漂浮物速度不能直接代入。
evidence.detailEn: Use section-mean velocity; surface-float speed is not interchangeable.

decisions.text: 回存更新斷面並註明流速方法
decisions.textEn: Save the updated section and velocity method
decisions.feedback: 幾何及速度來源清楚，流量才有可比較基礎。
decisions.feedbackEn: Explicit geometry and velocity sources make flow comparable.

decisions.text: 沿用洪水前斷面
decisions.textEn: Reuse the pre-flood section
decisions.feedback: 沖淤可能改變面積。
decisions.feedbackEn: Erosion and deposition may change area.

decisions.text: 把最高點流速當平均
decisions.textEn: Use the highest point velocity as the mean
decisions.feedback: 會偏高估計斷面流量。
decisions.feedbackEn: This biases discharge upward.

missions.debrief: 幾何及速度來源清楚，流量才有可比較基礎。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Explicit geometry and velocity sources make flow comparable. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 糙率假設與通水能力
missions.brief: 比較同一模型河段的糙率假設，記錄對通水量的敏感度。
missions.briefEn: Compare roughness assumptions in the same model reach and record sensitivity.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 面積 40 m²、水力半徑 1.5 m、能坡 0.001；定常均勻流假設。
evidence.detailEn: Area 40 m², hydraulic radius 1.5 m, energy slope 0.001; steady uniform flow assumed.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 不可將任意糙率調小來達標；需用植生、材料與率定證據支持。
evidence.detailEn: Do not reduce roughness merely to pass; vegetation, materials and calibration must support it.

decisions.text: 報告 n 的來源與敏感度
decisions.textEn: Report roughness basis and sensitivity
decisions.feedback: 模型參數需可追溯，水位與流量應再共同率定。
decisions.feedbackEn: Trace parameters and calibrate stage with flow.

decisions.text: 選最小 n 讓通水量最大
decisions.textEn: Choose minimum roughness to maximize flow
decisions.feedback: 這可能高估實際通水能力。
decisions.feedbackEn: This can overstate actual conveyance.

decisions.text: 把河床坡度一律當能坡
decisions.textEn: Always use bed slope as energy slope
decisions.feedback: 回水與非均勻流中兩者可能不同。
decisions.feedbackEn: They may differ in backwater or nonuniform flow.

missions.debrief: 模型參數需可追溯，水位與流量應再共同率定。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Trace parameters and calibrate stage with flow. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 滯洪容積的事件尺度
missions.brief: 用一段簡化洪水歷線檢查需暫存的水量。
missions.briefEn: Check temporary storage for one simplified flood-hydrograph interval.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 入流 90 m³/s 持續 2 h；出流為模型比較方案，並非河道許可量。
evidence.detailEn: Inflow 90 m³/s for 2 hours; outflow is a model alternative, not a permitted river discharge.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 只有矩形歷線，不含初始蓄水、路由、滲透與溢流。
evidence.detailEn: Rectangular hydrograph only; initial storage, routing, infiltration and spill omitted.

decisions.text: 逐時累積收支並核對剩餘容量
decisions.textEn: Accumulate interval balances and remaining capacity
decisions.feedback: 洪水事件需要完整歷線，單一時段僅能示範質量守恆。
decisions.feedbackEn: A flood requires the full hydrograph; one interval only demonstrates conservation.

decisions.text: 把尖峰流量當儲水體積
decisions.textEn: Treat peak flow as storage volume
decisions.feedback: 流量與體積的單位不同。
decisions.feedbackEn: Flow and volume have different units.

decisions.text: 提高出流而不看下游
decisions.textEn: Increase outflow without downstream review
decisions.feedback: 會把蓄洪問題轉移給下游。
decisions.feedbackEn: This can transfer flooding downstream.

missions.debrief: 洪水事件需要完整歷線，單一時段僅能示範質量守恆。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: A flood requires the full hydrograph; one interval only demonstrates conservation. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 獨立誤差的合成
missions.brief: 合併斷面與流速的相對標準不確定度，保留獨立假設。
missions.briefEn: Combine area and velocity relative standard uncertainties and preserve the independence assumption.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 流速相對標準不確定度 3%；面積改進到 4% 時合成為 5%。
evidence.detailEn: Velocity relative standard uncertainty 3%; improving area to 4% gives combined 5%.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 只對小誤差且獨立的乘積線性化適用；不是保證誤差上限。
evidence.detailEn: First-order small-error independent-product propagation; not a guaranteed error bound.

inputs.label: 面積相對標準不確定度

decisions.text: 把標準不確定度與相關性一起回報
decisions.textEn: Report standard uncertainty with correlation assumption
decisions.feedback: 如有共同偏差，需加入共變異數而不能直接平方和。
decisions.feedbackEn: Common bias requires covariance rather than a simple root-sum-square.

decisions.text: 宣稱真值一定在 ±5% 內
decisions.textEn: Guarantee truth lies within ±5%
decisions.feedback: 標準不確定度不是保證界限。
decisions.feedbackEn: Standard uncertainty is not a guaranteed bound.

decisions.text: 忽略面積誤差
decisions.textEn: Ignore area uncertainty
decisions.feedback: 乘積結果同時受兩項量測影響。
decisions.feedbackEn: Both measurements affect the product.

missions.debrief: 如有共同偏差，需加入共變異數而不能直接平方和。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Common bias requires covariance rather than a simple root-sum-square. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程教學任務；實拍為代表性背景，數值和通過範圍不是同名設施規格、法規門檻或現場操作指令。模型分站獨立，不宣稱校準數位孿生。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

campaigns.title: 海岸水槽與港區實驗
campaigns.brief: 比較縮尺波流、泵浦與混合算例，學會說明不能直接外推的條件。
campaigns.briefEn: Compare scaled waves, pumping and mixing, and state conditions that cannot be directly extrapolated.

photo.title: 代表性實拍：USGS 水流儀器校準拖曳水槽
photo.titleEn: Representative photograph: USGS HIF water-velocity instrument calibration towing tank
photo.author: USGS Hydrologic Instrumentation Facility

stations.title: 波流水槽的相似參數
stations.description: 用佛祿數比較縮尺水槽速度，分清幾何和動力相似。
stations.descriptionEn: Compare flume speed using Froude number and distinguish geometric from dynamic similarity.

stations.title: 深水波長的週期敏感度
stations.description: 波週期變長時，波長不是等比例增加；以深水近似比較。
stations.descriptionEn: Longer period does not increase wavelength linearly; compare the deep-water approximation.

stations.title: 港區泵浦的能量帳
stations.description: 排水方案增加揚程，檢查輸入功率的需求。
stations.descriptionEn: A drainage alternative raises head; check required input power.

stations.title: 鹽水混合的質量守恆
stations.description: 兩股水流混合，核對流量加權濃度，避免直接平均。
stations.descriptionEn: Mix two streams and use flow-weighted concentration rather than an unweighted mean.

missions.title: 波流水槽的相似參數
missions.brief: 用佛祿數比較縮尺水槽速度，分清幾何和動力相似。
missions.briefEn: Compare flume speed using Froude number and distinguish geometric from dynamic similarity.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 模型特徵長度 0.50 m；比較重力主導的慣性效應。
evidence.detailEn: Characteristic model length 0.50 m; compare inertia relative to gravity.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 相同 Fr 不會同時保證雷諾數或表面張力相似。
evidence.detailEn: Matching Froude number does not also match Reynolds or surface-tension effects.

decisions.text: 標出尺度與未匹配的相似條件
decisions.textEn: State scale and unmatched similarity conditions
decisions.feedback: 縮尺試驗的適用範圍需和結果一起交付。
decisions.feedbackEn: Scale-test limits belong with the results.

decisions.text: 只按長度比例縮小速度
decisions.textEn: Scale speed by length ratio alone
decisions.feedback: 重力相似的速度比例是長度比例平方根。
decisions.feedbackEn: Gravity similarity scales speed with square root of length.

decisions.text: 宣稱完全複製原型海況
decisions.textEn: Claim a complete copy of prototype seas
decisions.feedback: 黏性、破波及邊界效應可能不同。
decisions.feedbackEn: Viscosity, breaking and boundary effects may differ.

missions.debrief: 縮尺試驗的適用範圍需和結果一起交付。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Scale-test limits belong with the results. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 深水波長的週期敏感度
missions.brief: 波週期變長時，波長不是等比例增加；以深水近似比較。
missions.briefEn: Longer period does not increase wavelength linearly; compare the deep-water approximation.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 規則小振幅波、T = 8 s 的虛構案例。
evidence.detailEn: Fictional regular small-amplitude wave with T = 8 s.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 深水近似需水深相對波長足夠大；近岸淺水不能沿用。
evidence.detailEn: Deep-water approximation requires sufficient depth relative to wavelength; not valid for shallow nearshore water.

decisions.text: 先查相對水深再使用近似
decisions.textEn: Check relative depth before using the approximation
decisions.feedback: 模型適用性先於數值計算。
decisions.feedbackEn: Model applicability comes before arithmetic.

decisions.text: 在岸邊也直接套深水式
decisions.textEn: Apply the deep-water formula at shore
decisions.feedback: 近岸色散與變形需有限水深模型。
decisions.feedbackEn: Nearshore dispersion and transformation require finite-depth modeling.

decisions.text: 把週期加倍視為波長加倍
decisions.textEn: Treat twice the period as twice the wavelength
decisions.feedback: 本式中波長與週期平方成正比。
decisions.feedbackEn: Here wavelength is proportional to period squared.

missions.debrief: 模型適用性先於數值計算。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Model applicability comes before arithmetic. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 港區泵浦的能量帳
missions.brief: 排水方案增加揚程，檢查輸入功率的需求。
missions.briefEn: A drainage alternative raises head; check required input power.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 流量 0.50 m³/s、總效率假設 0.75。
evidence.detailEn: Flow 0.50 m³/s; assumed total efficiency 0.75.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 未含泵曲線、汽蝕與潮位變化；此值不是泵選型核准。
evidence.detailEn: Pump curve, cavitation and tides omitted; not a pump selection approval.

decisions.text: 將功率與潮位情境一起比較
decisions.textEn: Compare power with tidal-head scenarios
decisions.feedback: 揚程應對應特定工況，效率不能當永遠固定的保證。
decisions.feedbackEn: Head belongs to a duty point; efficiency is not a permanent guarantee.

decisions.text: 用效率乘而不是除輸入功率
decisions.textEn: Multiply by efficiency for input power
decisions.feedback: 輸入功率應高於有效水力功率。
decisions.feedbackEn: Input power must exceed useful hydraulic power.

decisions.text: 只照額定功率採購
decisions.textEn: Select only by nameplate power
decisions.feedback: 尚需工作點、材料與汽蝕條件。
decisions.feedbackEn: Duty point, materials and cavitation conditions are still needed.

missions.debrief: 揚程應對應特定工況，效率不能當永遠固定的保證。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Head belongs to a duty point; efficiency is not a permanent guarantee. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 鹽水混合的質量守恆
missions.brief: 兩股水流混合，核對流量加權濃度，避免直接平均。
missions.briefEn: Mix two streams and use flow-weighted concentration rather than an unweighted mean.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 鹽水 10 m³/s、35 g/L；淡水以 0 g/L 示意。
evidence.detailEn: Salt water 10 m³/s at 35 g/L; fresh stream represented as 0 g/L.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 完全瞬間混合且密度近似相同；實際河口有分層與潮汐。
evidence.detailEn: Instant complete mixing with similar density assumed; real estuaries have stratification and tides.

decisions.text: 記錄混合假設並要求垂向剖面
decisions.textEn: Record mixing assumption and request a vertical profile
decisions.feedback: 平均濃度不能排除局部高鹽層。
decisions.feedbackEn: A mean concentration does not exclude a locally saline layer.

decisions.text: 把 35 與 0 直接平均
decisions.textEn: Average 35 and 0 directly
decisions.feedback: 兩股流量不同，需流量加權。
decisions.feedbackEn: Unequal flows require weighting.

decisions.text: 視平均值為所有位置濃度
decisions.textEn: Use the mean for every location
decisions.feedback: 模型未解析空間分布與分層。
decisions.feedbackEn: The model does not resolve spatial distribution or stratification.

missions.debrief: 平均濃度不能排除局部高鹽層。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: A mean concentration does not exclude a locally saline layer. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程教學任務；實拍為代表性背景，數值和通過範圍不是同名設施規格、法規門檻或現場操作指令。模型分站獨立，不宣稱校準數位孿生。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

campaigns.title: 列車性能與時刻表室
campaigns.brief: 以簡化列車試算連接煞車、能量、牽引與服務量，保留正式驗證接口。
campaigns.briefEn: Connect braking, energy, traction and service-rate exercises while retaining formal validation interfaces.

photo.titleEn: Representative photograph: THSR 700T approaching Hsinchu station
photo.author: T Gordon Cheng

stations.title: 反應時間與簡化煞停距離
stations.description: 列車模型的延遲不可被省略；調整情境速度觀察距離平方效應。
stations.descriptionEn: Do not omit model delay; vary scenario speed and observe the quadratic distance effect.

stations.title: 動能與再生煞車上限
stations.titleEn: Kinetic energy and regenerative upper bound
stations.description: 比較虛構列車不同速度的動能，分清能量與功率。
stations.descriptionEn: Compare kinetic energy at different speeds and distinguish energy from power.

stations.title: 牽引力與瞬時功率
stations.description: 以定速工況比較不同牽引力需求的輸入功率。
stations.descriptionEn: Compare input power at a fixed speed for alternative tractive-force demands.

stations.title: 班距與理論服務量

missions.title: 反應時間與簡化煞停距離
missions.brief: 列車模型的延遲不可被省略；調整情境速度觀察距離平方效應。
missions.briefEn: Do not omit model delay; vary scenario speed and observe the quadratic distance effect.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 延遲 3 s、常減速度 0.8 m/s²；平直乾燥示意情境。
evidence.detailEn: Delay 3 s, constant deceleration 0.8 m/s²; level dry illustrative scenario.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 不是 ETCS 或真車煞車曲線；坡度、附著與煞車建立時間未完整建模。
evidence.detailEn: Not an ETCS or real-train braking curve; gradient, adhesion and brake build-up not fully modeled.

decisions.text: 保留延遲並要求正式煞車曲線
decisions.textEn: Keep delay and request the validated braking curve
decisions.feedback: 簡化算例用於理解速度敏感度，不可直接設號誌間距。
decisions.feedbackEn: The exercise explains speed sensitivity, not signal spacing.

decisions.text: 只算減速段而省略延遲
decisions.textEn: Omit delay and calculate deceleration only
decisions.feedback: 會低估停止前移動距離。
decisions.feedbackEn: This understates distance traveled before stopping.

decisions.text: 套用到雨天全部車型
decisions.textEn: Apply to all trains in rain
decisions.feedback: 減速度和附著條件不可任意移植。
decisions.feedbackEn: Deceleration and adhesion cannot be transferred arbitrarily.

missions.debrief: 簡化算例用於理解速度敏感度，不可直接設號誌間距。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: The exercise explains speed sensitivity, not signal spacing. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 動能與再生煞車上限
missions.titleEn: Kinetic energy and regenerative upper bound
missions.brief: 比較虛構列車不同速度的動能，分清能量與功率。
missions.briefEn: Compare kinetic energy at different speeds and distinguish energy from power.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 質量 200000 kg；只含平移動能。
evidence.detailEn: Mass 200000 kg; translational kinetic energy only.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 再生回收受效率、電網接納與輔機消耗限制，不等於全部動能。
evidence.detailEn: Regeneration is limited by efficiency, network receptivity and auxiliaries; it is not all kinetic energy.

decisions.text: 把動能與可回收量分開報告
decisions.textEn: Report kinetic energy separately from recoverable energy
decisions.feedback: 熱損與系統限制要另列，才能避免誇大節能。
decisions.feedbackEn: List losses and system constraints to avoid overstating savings.

decisions.text: 把 MJ 當 MW
decisions.textEn: Treat MJ as MW
decisions.feedback: 能量需要除以時間才是平均功率。
decisions.feedbackEn: Energy divided by time gives average power.

decisions.text: 宣稱所有動能都能回到電網
decisions.textEn: Claim all energy returns to the grid
decisions.feedback: 忽略損失與電網接納限制。
decisions.feedbackEn: This ignores losses and network receptivity.

missions.debrief: 熱損與系統限制要另列，才能避免誇大節能。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: List losses and system constraints to avoid overstating savings. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 牽引力與瞬時功率
missions.brief: 以定速工況比較不同牽引力需求的輸入功率。
missions.briefEn: Compare input power at a fixed speed for alternative tractive-force demands.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 速度 20 m/s、傳動效率 0.90；kN·m/s = kW。
evidence.detailEn: Speed 20 m/s, drivetrain efficiency 0.90; kN·m/s equals kW.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 未含加速度、坡道和輪軌附著；需求力不等於可提供最大力。
evidence.detailEn: Acceleration, grade and adhesion omitted; demand is not available maximum force.

decisions.text: 附力速工況與效率假設
decisions.textEn: Attach force-speed duty point and efficiency
decisions.feedback: 瞬時功率需對應明確工況，不能與全程能耗混淆。
decisions.feedbackEn: Instantaneous power needs a duty point and is not whole-trip energy.

decisions.text: 把最大牽引力用在所有速度
decisions.textEn: Use maximum force at every speed
decisions.feedback: 牽引特性可能受電流、功率與附著限制。
decisions.feedbackEn: Traction may be current-, power- or adhesion-limited.

decisions.text: 把功率直接報成每趟耗能
decisions.textEn: Report power as trip energy
decisions.feedback: 還需要沿時間積分。
decisions.feedbackEn: Time integration is still required.

missions.debrief: 瞬時功率需對應明確工況，不能與全程能耗混淆。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Instantaneous power needs a duty point and is not whole-trip energy. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 班距與理論服務量
missions.brief: 比較時刻表方案時，先算理論每小時班次，再留下折返和停站限制。
missions.briefEn: Calculate theoretical hourly service before adding turnback and dwell constraints.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 本關使用均勻班距；目標約 30 班/h。
evidence.detailEn: Uniform headway assumed; target about 30 trains/hour.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 算式不建立安全班距，也未含轉乘、停站波動與道岔衝突。
evidence.detailEn: The equation does not establish safe headway; transfer, dwell variation and switch conflicts omitted.

decisions.text: 將理論班次與瓶頸站能力並列
decisions.textEn: Compare theoretical service and bottleneck capacity
decisions.feedback: 班距縮短可能把瓶頸移到月臺或折返線。
decisions.feedbackEn: Shorter headway may move the bottleneck to platforms or turnbacks.

decisions.text: 數字達標就宣稱可營運
decisions.textEn: Declare operational readiness after the number passes
decisions.feedback: 系統與安全驗證尚未完成。
decisions.feedbackEn: System and safety validation remain incomplete.

decisions.text: 為追班次忽略停站時間
decisions.textEn: Ignore dwell to increase frequency
decisions.feedback: 乘客上下車與清空時間不可憑空刪除。
decisions.feedbackEn: Boarding and clearance time cannot be erased.

missions.debrief: 班距縮短可能把瓶頸移到月臺或折返線。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。

missions.title: 鋼軌自由伸長基準
missions.brief: 以短試片的自由熱伸長建立基準，再指出無縫軌拘束的差異。
missions.briefEn: Build a free-expansion reference for a short specimen and identify restrained-track differences.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 長度 25 m 的等效鋼試片、線膨脹係數 12×10⁻⁶/°C。
evidence.detailEn: Equivalent 25 m steel specimen, expansion coefficient 12×10⁻⁶/°C.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 自由伸長不是無縫軌實際位移；拘束時需分析軸力與穩定。
evidence.detailEn: Free expansion is not actual continuous-welded rail motion; restraint requires force and stability analysis.

decisions.text: 明確區分自由試片與拘束鋼軌
decisions.textEn: Distinguish free specimen from restrained rail
decisions.feedback: 相同溫差在不同邊界下產生不同位移與內力。
decisions.feedbackEn: Identical temperature change gives different movement and force under different boundaries.

decisions.text: 把自由伸長當軌道接縫設定
decisions.textEn: Use free expansion as a track-joint setting
decisions.feedback: 實際設計涉及中性溫度與拘束條件。
decisions.feedbackEn: Real design involves neutral temperature and restraint.

decisions.text: 忽略溫度只看氣象日曆
decisions.textEn: Ignore temperature and use the calendar
decisions.feedback: 鋼軌溫度不能僅由月份推定。
decisions.feedbackEn: Rail temperature cannot be inferred from month alone.

missions.debrief: 相同溫差在不同邊界下產生不同位移與內力。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Identical temperature change gives different movement and force under different boundaries. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 曲線速度與向心加速度
missions.brief: 比較相同曲率下速度變化，先把單位轉為 m/s。
missions.briefEn: Compare speeds at fixed curvature after converting to m/s.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 曲線半徑 500 m；此關沒有超高補償。
evidence.detailEn: Curve radius 500 m; no cant compensation in this case.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 不是允許營運速度；舒適度、超高、車型和輪軌力未完整納入。
evidence.detailEn: Not a permitted operating speed; comfort, cant, vehicle and wheel-rail forces are incomplete.

decisions.text: 保留未補償加速度供超高模型使用
decisions.textEn: Keep unbalanced acceleration for a separate cant model
decisions.feedback: 先確定向心需求，再討論超高和其他限制。
decisions.feedbackEn: Establish centripetal demand before cant and other constraints.

decisions.text: 把 km/h 直接代入
decisions.textEn: Insert km/h directly
decisions.feedback: 平方後單位錯誤會放大。
decisions.feedbackEn: The squared unit error magnifies the mistake.

decisions.text: 只有加速度小就取消限速
decisions.textEn: Remove restrictions from acceleration alone
decisions.feedback: 其他結構、號誌及車輛條件仍適用。
decisions.feedbackEn: Other infrastructure, signalling and vehicle constraints remain.

missions.debrief: 先確定向心需求，再討論超高和其他限制。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Establish centripetal demand before cant and other constraints. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 軌距量測的偏差修正
missions.brief: 試件量規有零點偏差，修正後再計算與名義軌距的差。
missions.briefEn: A test gauge has zero bias; correct it before comparing nominal gauge.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 名義示例 1435 mm，原始讀值 1438 mm；校正件指出 +2.5 mm 偏差。
evidence.detailEn: Illustrative nominal 1435 mm, raw 1438 mm; calibration artifact indicates +2.5 mm bias.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 這是試件量測練習，目標差值不是軌道維修容許值。
evidence.detailEn: A specimen metrology exercise; target difference is not a track maintenance tolerance.

decisions.text: 保存原值、校正件與修正值
decisions.textEn: Save raw value, calibration artifact and correction
decisions.feedback: 量測溯源和位置編號要一起保留。
decisions.feedbackEn: Keep traceability and location identity together.

decisions.text: 刪去不喜歡的讀值
decisions.textEn: Delete unwanted readings
decisions.feedback: 資料完整性被破壞。
decisions.feedbackEn: This compromises data integrity.

decisions.text: 把修正當作實際調軌
decisions.textEn: Treat correction as physically adjusting track
decisions.feedback: 修正量測不等於改變實物。
decisions.feedbackEn: Correcting a reading does not alter the physical track.

missions.debrief: 量測溯源和位置編號要一起保留。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Keep traceability and location identity together. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 回路壓降與截面
missions.titleEn: Loop voltage drop and cable area
missions.brief: 在低壓教學回路中比較導線截面，記得回程長度。
missions.briefEn: Compare cable areas in a low-voltage teaching loop and include the return length.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 單程長度 100 m、電流 10 A、ρ = 0.0175 Ω·mm²/m 的理想銅線。
evidence.detailEn: One-way length 100 m, current 10 A, ideal copper resistivity 0.0175 Ω·mm²/m.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 直流定溫模型；載流量、保護、接地與號誌認證另行驗證。
evidence.detailEn: DC constant-temperature model; ampacity, protection, grounding and signalling certification separate.

decisions.text: 保留回路長度與溫升待查項
decisions.textEn: Keep loop length and thermal review items
decisions.feedback: 壓降合適不表示載流與保護條件已滿足。
decisions.feedbackEn: Acceptable voltage drop does not establish ampacity or protection.

decisions.text: 只算去程長度
decisions.textEn: Use only the outgoing length
decisions.feedback: 會漏掉回程壓降。
decisions.feedbackEn: This omits return-path drop.

decisions.text: 直接據此更改號誌電纜
decisions.textEn: Modify signalling cables from this result
decisions.feedback: 教學回路計算不能授權現場修改。
decisions.feedbackEn: A teaching-loop calculation does not authorize site changes.

missions.debrief: 壓降合適不表示載流與保護條件已滿足。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Acceptable voltage drop does not establish ampacity or protection. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

stations.description: 將模型列車需求功率換成等效直流電流，標示效率邊界。
stations.descriptionEn: Convert model train demand into equivalent DC current with an explicit efficiency boundary.

stations.title: 工作票與區段清空餘裕
stations.description: 調度模擬收到區段佔用時間，檢查下一工作票的時間餘裕。

missions.title: 牽引供電的電流需求
missions.brief: 將模型列車需求功率換成等效直流電流，標示效率邊界。
missions.briefEn: Convert model train demand into equivalent DC current with an explicit efficiency boundary.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 直流端電壓假設 1500 V；power 已是供電端功率。
evidence.detailEn: Assumed DC-terminal voltage 1500 V; power is already electrical supply-side demand.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 不再重複除馬達效率；真實線壓會隨位置和負載變化。
evidence.detailEn: Do not divide by motor efficiency again; real line voltage varies with location and loading.

decisions.text: 註明供電端定義再彙整多車需求
decisions.textEn: Define the supply boundary before summing train demand
decisions.feedback: 清楚的能量邊界避免效率被重複計入。
decisions.feedbackEn: A clear energy boundary prevents double-counting efficiency.

decisions.text: 重複除效率
decisions.textEn: Divide by efficiency a second time
decisions.feedback: 若功率已在電氣端，會重複計損。
decisions.feedbackEn: If power is electrical-side demand, this double-counts loss.

decisions.text: 將定電壓假設當實網保證
decisions.textEn: Treat constant voltage as a network guarantee
decisions.feedback: 線路阻抗與再生電力尚未建模。
decisions.feedbackEn: Line impedance and regeneration are not modeled.

missions.debrief: 清楚的能量邊界避免效率被重複計入。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: A clear energy boundary prevents double-counting efficiency. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 工作票與區段清空餘裕
missions.brief: 調度模擬收到區段佔用時間，檢查下一工作票的時間餘裕。
missions.briefEn: Dispatch simulation receives occupancy duration; check margin before the next work ticket.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 佔用 95 s、模型交接準備 20 s；目標餘裕為虛構教學值。
evidence.detailEn: Occupancy 95 s and model handover 20 s; target margin is fictional.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 不代表號誌閉塞設計或行車許可，系統安全邏輯不由此時間式取代。
evidence.detailEn: Not block signalling design or movement authority; safety logic is not replaced by this time equation.

decisions.text: 確認清空證據再發下一張模擬票
decisions.textEn: Confirm clearance evidence before the next simulated ticket
decisions.feedback: 時間排程不能替代區段狀態確認。
decisions.feedbackEn: Schedule time cannot replace confirmation of block state.

decisions.text: 時間一到就忽略佔用
decisions.textEn: Ignore occupancy once the timer expires
decisions.feedback: 時鐘不等於區段清空證據。
decisions.feedbackEn: A clock is not clearance evidence.

decisions.text: 把準備時間刪掉提高產量
decisions.textEn: Delete handover time for throughput
decisions.feedback: 會隱藏真實工作接口需求。
decisions.feedbackEn: This hides handover requirements.

missions.debrief: 時間排程不能替代區段狀態確認。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Schedule time cannot replace confirmation of block state. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 定位封包的資料年齡
missions.brief: 控制室看到的定位已過期，計算期間列車可能前進距離。
missions.briefEn: The control room position is stale; calculate distance traveled during the age interval.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 模型速度 25 m/s；資料年齡含通訊、排隊與顯示延遲。
evidence.detailEn: Model speed 25 m/s; age includes communications, queueing and display delays.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 恆速估計不含定位誤差、加速度與失聯處置。
evidence.detailEn: Constant-speed estimate omits location uncertainty, acceleration and loss-of-link response.

decisions.text: 顯示時間戳並切換過期資料狀態
decisions.textEn: Display timestamps and mark stale data explicitly
decisions.feedback: 操作人員需知道資料的新鮮度，不能把舊點當即時點。
decisions.feedbackEn: Operators need data freshness, not old positions presented as live.

decisions.text: 隱藏時間戳讓畫面簡潔
decisions.textEn: Hide timestamps to simplify the screen
decisions.feedback: 會失去判斷資料年齡的關鍵證據。
decisions.feedbackEn: This removes key evidence of freshness.

decisions.text: 只看網路 ping 值
decisions.textEn: Use network ping alone
decisions.feedback: 顯示與處理排隊可能增加總延遲。
decisions.feedbackEn: Display and processing queues may add substantial age.

missions.debrief: 操作人員需知道資料的新鮮度，不能把舊點當即時點。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Operators need data freshness, not old positions presented as live. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 維修後回復的證據完整度
missions.brief: 模型工單有八項獨立驗證，先檢查缺漏再交班。
missions.briefEn: A model work order requires eight independent checks; find omissions before handover.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 八項為本關虛構證據清單；每項需有位置、時間和結果。
evidence.detailEn: Eight fictional evidence items; each needs location, time and result.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 完整度只是清單指標，不表示系統可靠度為 100%。
evidence.detailEn: Completeness is a checklist metric, not 100% system reliability.

decisions.text: 逐項補齊缺漏並保存異常追蹤
decisions.textEn: Complete missing evidence and keep anomaly follow-up
decisions.feedback: 紀錄完整和性能合格是不同問題，兩者都要審查。
decisions.feedbackEn: Complete records and adequate performance are different and both require review.

decisions.text: 把待驗項目勾成完成
decisions.textEn: Mark pending checks as done
decisions.feedback: 虛假完成會掩蓋未驗證狀態。
decisions.feedbackEn: False completion hides unverified state.

decisions.text: 把清單百分比當可靠度
decisions.textEn: Treat checklist percentage as reliability
decisions.feedback: 沒有統計可靠度試驗支持這個結論。
decisions.feedbackEn: No reliability test supports that inference.

missions.debrief: 紀錄完整和性能合格是不同問題，兩者都要審查。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Complete records and adequate performance are different and both require review. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scope: 原創虛構工程教學任務；實拍為代表性背景，數值和通過範圍不是同名設施規格、法規門檻或現場操作指令。模型分站獨立，不宣稱校準數位孿生。
campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

campaigns.title: 再生水品質交班
campaigns.brief: 暴雨改變流量，檢查停留、配對樣本、質量負荷與膜回收帳。
campaigns.briefEn: Wet weather changes flow. Check residence, paired samples, mass load and membrane recovery.

photo.title: 代表性實拍：柏林Ruhleben污水處理廠曝氣池
photo.titleEn: Representative photograph: Aeration tanks at Berlin Ruhleben wastewater plant
photo.author: Susanne Ott

stations.title: 有效容積與水力停留時間
stations.titleEn: Effective volume and hydraulic residence time
stations.description: 暴雨入流增加時，檢查有效容積能提供的平均停留時間。
stations.descriptionEn: During wet-weather flow, check average residence from effective volume.

stations.title: 去除率與進出水配對
stations.description: 使用同一事件的進出水資料，避免把不同時段濃度相減。
stations.descriptionEn: Pair influent and effluent from the same event instead of unrelated times.

stations.title: 濃度與日負荷的換算
stations.description: 將出水濃度轉成質量，核對升與立方公尺換算。
stations.descriptionEn: Convert concentration to mass and check liters versus cubic meters.

stations.title: 膜系統回收率與濃縮流
stations.description: 核對透過水與進水比例，同時保存濃縮流量。
stations.descriptionEn: Check permeate-to-feed ratio while preserving concentrate flow.

missions.title: 有效容積與水力停留時間
missions.titleEn: Effective volume and hydraulic residence time
missions.brief: 暴雨入流增加時，檢查有效容積能提供的平均停留時間。
missions.briefEn: During wet-weather flow, check average residence from effective volume.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 流量 250 m³/h；有效容積需扣除不可用區。
evidence.detailEn: Flow 250 m³/h; effective volume excludes unusable zones.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 平均停留時間不等於每滴水停留時間，短流與反應動力未解析。
evidence.detailEn: Mean residence is not every parcel’s time; short-circuiting and kinetics are unresolved.

decisions.text: 核對有效容積並提出短流驗證
decisions.textEn: Check effective volume and request short-circuit testing
decisions.feedback: 幾何容積與實際接觸條件需區分。
decisions.feedbackEn: Geometric volume and actual contact conditions differ.

decisions.text: 把池子總容積全算有效
decisions.textEn: Count all gross volume as effective
decisions.feedback: 死區可能使有效容積低於幾何容積。
decisions.feedbackEn: Dead zones may reduce effective volume.

decisions.text: HRT 過關就保證出水品質
decisions.textEn: Guarantee effluent quality from HRT alone
decisions.feedback: 污染負荷與生物反應等仍有影響。
decisions.feedbackEn: Loading and biological response also matter.

missions.debrief: 幾何容積與實際接觸條件需區分。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Geometric volume and actual contact conditions differ. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 去除率與進出水配對
missions.brief: 使用同一事件的進出水資料，避免把不同時段濃度相減。
missions.briefEn: Pair influent and effluent from the same event instead of unrelated times.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 配對進水 200 mg/L；本關驗證樣本出水 20 mg/L。
evidence.detailEn: Paired influent 200 mg/L; verified case effluent 20 mg/L.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 只有濃度比，流量變動時還需負荷收支；目標不是排放標準。
evidence.detailEn: Concentration ratio only; variable flow needs mass-load balance; target is not a discharge limit.

decisions.text: 保存採樣時間與流量再報去除率
decisions.textEn: Keep sampling times and flows with removal
decisions.feedback: 配對與流量能避免稀釋被誤認為污染消失。
decisions.feedbackEn: Pairing and flow prevent dilution being mistaken for removal.

decisions.text: 只加水稀釋讓濃度降低
decisions.textEn: Dilute to lower concentration only
decisions.feedback: 濃度下降不代表污染物質量被去除。
decisions.feedbackEn: Lower concentration does not prove pollutant mass removal.

decisions.text: 混用不同日的進出水
decisions.textEn: Mix influent and effluent from different days
decisions.feedback: 來源變化可能產生虛假的去除率。
decisions.feedbackEn: Changing input can create a false removal estimate.

missions.debrief: 配對與流量能避免稀釋被誤認為污染消失。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Pairing and flow prevent dilution being mistaken for removal. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 濃度與日負荷的換算
missions.brief: 將出水濃度轉成質量，核對升與立方公尺換算。
missions.briefEn: Convert concentration to mass and check liters versus cubic meters.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 每日水量 6000 m³/day；1 mg/L = 1 g/m³。
evidence.detailEn: Daily flow 6000 m³/day; 1 mg/L equals 1 g/m³.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 日均值不揭示尖峰；污染物種類和許可條件需另行查核。
evidence.detailEn: Daily average hides peaks; constituent identity and permits require separate review.

decisions.text: 回報濃度和負荷兩項指標
decisions.textEn: Report concentration and mass load together
decisions.feedback: 兩者共同呈現水量變化及污染質量。
decisions.feedbackEn: Together they describe flow changes and pollutant mass.

decisions.text: 把 mg/L 直接當 kg/m³
decisions.textEn: Treat mg/L directly as kg/m³
decisions.feedback: 缺少 1000 倍換算。
decisions.feedbackEn: This misses a factor of 1000.

decisions.text: 低濃度便忽略大流量
decisions.textEn: Ignore large flow because concentration is low
decisions.feedback: 大流量仍可能有顯著污染負荷。
decisions.feedbackEn: Large flow can still carry substantial mass.

missions.debrief: 兩者共同呈現水量變化及污染質量。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Together they describe flow changes and pollutant mass. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 膜系統回收率與濃縮流
missions.brief: 核對透過水與進水比例，同時保存濃縮流量。
missions.briefEn: Check permeate-to-feed ratio while preserving concentrate flow.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 進水 100 m³/h；本關透過水 70 m³/h、忽略清洗耗水。
evidence.detailEn: Feed 100 m³/h; case permeate 70 m³/h; cleaning-water losses omitted.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 提高回收率會改變濃縮條件；此關不計污染結垢、壓力與膜完整性。
evidence.detailEn: Higher recovery changes concentrate conditions; fouling, pressure and integrity omitted.

decisions.text: 把 30 m³/h 濃縮流納入處理帳
decisions.textEn: Include 30 m³/h concentrate in the treatment ledger
decisions.feedback: 回收水增加不代表濃縮污染消失。
decisions.feedbackEn: More recovered water does not eliminate concentrated contaminants.

decisions.text: 宣稱未透過的水都消失
decisions.textEn: Claim non-permeate water disappears
decisions.feedback: 質量與流量收支不閉合。
decisions.feedbackEn: Mass and flow balances fail.

decisions.text: 只把回收率推到最大
decisions.textEn: Maximize recovery alone
decisions.feedback: 壓力、結垢與水質限制尚未比較。
decisions.feedbackEn: Pressure, scaling and quality constraints remain.

missions.debrief: 回收水增加不代表濃縮污染消失。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: More recovered water does not eliminate concentrated contaminants. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.briefEn: Recovery is more than weight. Handover purity, energy, volume and explicit emission boundaries.

missions.title: 回收純度與有效產出
missions.brief: 回收場有高重量但雜質多的批次，計算可用材料而非總秤重。
missions.briefEn: A recycling batch is heavy but contaminated; calculate useful material instead of gross weight.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 原批次 10000 kg；純度與後處理回收率為不同指標。
evidence.detailEn: Gross batch 10000 kg; purity and process recovery are different metrics.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 沒有隱含價格或品質認證；混雜物與處理損耗要分帳。
evidence.detailEn: No price or certification implied; contaminants and process loss need separate ledgers.

decisions.text: 交班可用料、雜質與處理損失
decisions.textEn: Handover usable material, contaminants and process losses
decisions.feedback: 清楚的物料平衡比只報總回收重量更有用。
decisions.feedbackEn: A clear mass balance is more useful than gross recovered weight.

decisions.text: 把雜質也算成高品質回收料
decisions.textEn: Count contaminants as high-quality recovered material
decisions.feedback: 會誇大有效產出。
decisions.feedbackEn: This exaggerates useful output.

decisions.text: 把純度與回收率相加
decisions.textEn: Add purity and recovery
decisions.feedback: 兩項比例描述串接步驟，應相乘。
decisions.feedbackEn: The fractions describe consecutive stages and must multiply.

missions.debrief: 清楚的物料平衡比只報總回收重量更有用。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: A clear mass balance is more useful than gross recovered weight. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 熱值到可用能量
missions.brief: 比較虛構燃料批次的能量收支，把 MJ 轉成 kWh。
missions.briefEn: Compare a fictional fuel batch and convert MJ into kWh.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 批次 500 kg、假設低位熱值 12 MJ/kg；1 kWh = 3.6 MJ。
evidence.detailEn: Batch 500 kg; assumed LHV 12 MJ/kg; 1 kWh equals 3.6 MJ.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 只做能量帳，不涉及焚化操作；排放控制、含水與熱損另議。
evidence.detailEn: Energy ledger only, not combustion operation; emissions, moisture and losses need separate treatment.

decisions.text: 將能量收益與排放控制分列
decisions.textEn: Separate energy benefit and emissions control
decisions.feedback: 能量回收不會自動證明環境影響較低。
decisions.feedbackEn: Energy recovery does not automatically prove lower environmental impact.

decisions.text: 把熱值直接當電能
decisions.textEn: Treat heating value directly as electricity
decisions.feedback: 需要效率與單位換算。
decisions.feedbackEn: Efficiency and unit conversion are required.

decisions.text: 只看發電忽略殘渣
decisions.textEn: Count power and ignore residues
decisions.feedback: 物料收支仍需處理灰渣與其他產物。
decisions.feedbackEn: The mass balance still needs residues and other products.

missions.debrief: 能量回收不會自動證明環境影響較低。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Energy recovery does not automatically prove lower environmental impact. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 壓縮密度與暫存體積
missions.brief: 暫存空間不足時，比較密度方案，保留安全與材料限制。
missions.briefEn: Compare density scenarios when storage is tight while retaining safety and material constraints.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 暫存質量 12000 kg；密度需由實測批次支持。
evidence.detailEn: Stored mass 12000 kg; density must be supported by batch measurements.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 壓縮不減少質量，也不代表所有廢棄物可採相同處理。
evidence.detailEn: Compaction does not reduce mass or imply all wastes can be handled alike.

decisions.text: 記錄體積、質量及可壓縮性
decisions.textEn: Record volume, mass and compressibility
decisions.feedback: 空間改善要與材料特性、分類和儲存條件共同檢查。
decisions.feedbackEn: Space improvements need material, segregation and storage review.

decisions.text: 把體積減少當質量減少
decisions.textEn: Treat lower volume as lower mass
decisions.feedback: 壓縮只改變密度和體積。
decisions.feedbackEn: Compaction changes density and volume, not mass.

decisions.text: 全部物料一律壓到最高密度
decisions.textEn: Compact every material to maximum density
decisions.feedback: 不同材料可能有反應、破損或其他限制。
decisions.feedbackEn: Different materials may have reaction, damage or other constraints.

missions.debrief: 空間改善要與材料特性、分類和儲存條件共同檢查。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Space improvements need material, segregation and storage review. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 假設排放係數的活動帳
missions.titleEn: Activity ledger with an assumed emission factor
missions.brief: 以明示的假設係數比較兩方案，保留係數來源待查。
missions.briefEn: Compare alternatives with an explicitly assumed factor and keep source verification open.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 係數 0.40 kg CO₂e/kWh 是遊戲假設，不代表台灣或特定年度電力排放係數。
evidence.detailEn: Factor 0.40 kg CO₂e/kWh is fictional, not Taiwan or any year’s grid factor.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 只計電力單一邊界，不是完整生命週期評估，也未納回收替代利益。
evidence.detailEn: Electricity-only boundary, not a full life-cycle assessment; avoided-production credits omitted.

decisions.text: 把邊界與係數年份待查項一起附上
decisions.textEn: Attach boundary and factor-year verification
decisions.feedback: 透明假設可比較方案，但不能冒充正式碳盤查。
decisions.feedbackEn: Transparent assumptions compare options without claiming a formal inventory.

decisions.text: 宣稱這就是官方減碳量
decisions.textEn: Claim this is an official reduction
decisions.feedback: 係數和邊界都未經正式核對。
decisions.feedbackEn: Neither factor nor boundary has formal verification.

decisions.text: 只挑有利的排放項目
decisions.textEn: Select only favorable emission items
decisions.feedback: 邊界不一致會失去可比性。
decisions.feedbackEn: Inconsistent boundaries destroy comparability.

missions.debrief: 透明假設可比較方案，但不能冒充正式碳盤查。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Transparent assumptions compare options without claiming a formal inventory. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.

campaigns.brief: 從校正到雨水、時間積分和土樣混合，練習區分觀測與治理結論。
campaigns.briefEn: From calibration to runoff, time integrals and soil mixtures, separate observations from management conclusions.

stations.descriptionEn: A teaching sensor has offset; correct against a reference before comparing concentration.

missions.title: 空品感測器的線性校正
missions.brief: 一支教學感測器有零點偏移，先用校正件修正再比較濃度。
missions.briefEn: A teaching sensor has offset; correct against a reference before comparing concentration.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 原始 42 µg/m³、增益 1.10；參考試驗辨識 offset = 9。
evidence.detailEn: Raw 42 µg/m³, gain 1.10; reference test identifies offset 9.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 單一直線校正不涵蓋濕度、溫度與交叉敏感性。
evidence.detailEn: One linear correction does not capture humidity, temperature or cross-sensitivity.

decisions.text: 保留原值並標出校正適用範圍
decisions.textEn: Keep raw values and calibration range
decisions.feedback: 校正應可追溯且有適用條件。
decisions.feedbackEn: Calibration needs traceability and valid conditions.

decisions.text: 為符目標任意調 offset
decisions.textEn: Tune offset merely to hit target
decisions.feedback: 校正值必須由參考證據支持。
decisions.feedbackEn: Reference evidence must support the correction.

decisions.text: 把校正後值當醫療暴露結論
decisions.textEn: Use corrected value as a medical exposure conclusion
decisions.feedback: 量測與健康風險評估是不同問題。
decisions.feedbackEn: Measurement and health-risk assessment are different tasks.

missions.debrief: 校正應可追溯且有適用條件。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Calibration needs traceability and valid conditions. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 降雨到逕流體積
missions.brief: 比較都市鋪面方案的事件逕流，區分雨深和水量。
missions.briefEn: Compare event runoff for urban surfaces and distinguish depth from volume.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 降雨深 30 mm、面積 20000 m²；係數是比較方案的假設值。
evidence.detailEn: Rain depth 30 mm, area 20000 m²; coefficient is an assumed alternative.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 事件總量不提供尖峰流率；土壤濕潤及雨型未解析。
evidence.detailEn: Event volume does not provide peak flow; antecedent moisture and storm shape unresolved.

decisions.text: 把總量與尖峰流量需求分列
decisions.textEn: Separate volume and peak-flow requirements
decisions.feedback: 容量與排水能力需要不同資料支持。
decisions.feedbackEn: Storage and drainage capacity require different evidence.

decisions.text: 將 300 m³ 當 300 m³/s
decisions.textEn: Treat 300 m³ as 300 m³/s
decisions.feedback: 體積不能直接當流量。
decisions.feedbackEn: Volume is not flow rate.

decisions.text: 把係數降低當完成實體改善
decisions.textEn: Treat a lower coefficient as physical improvement
decisions.feedback: 係數需有實際材料與監測依據。
decisions.feedbackEn: The coefficient needs real surface and monitoring evidence.

missions.debrief: 容量與排水能力需要不同資料支持。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Storage and drainage capacity require different evidence. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 濃度與時間積分的差異
missions.brief: 比較相同濃度下的停留時間，保持單位和評估邊界。
missions.briefEn: Compare durations at the same concentration while retaining units and scope.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 濃度固定 30 µg/m³；只有簡化濃度時間積分。
evidence.detailEn: Constant concentration 30 µg/m³; only a simplified concentration-time integral.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 不是吸入劑量或健康風險；呼吸率、污染物與個人差異未含。
evidence.detailEn: Not inhaled dose or health risk; breathing rate, substance and individual factors omitted.

decisions.text: 以正確積分單位回報並附限制
decisions.textEn: Report integral units with limitations
decisions.feedback: 把濃度、時間和健康結論分開。
decisions.feedbackEn: Keep concentration, time and health conclusions distinct.

decisions.text: 宣稱此值是個人吸入劑量
decisions.textEn: Claim this is personal inhaled dose
decisions.feedback: 還缺呼吸量與其他資料。
decisions.feedbackEn: Breathing volume and other data are missing.

decisions.text: 把時間積分再當瞬間濃度
decisions.textEn: Treat the integral as instantaneous concentration
decisions.feedback: 單位已多了一個時間因子。
decisions.feedbackEn: The unit contains an additional time factor.

missions.debrief: 把濃度、時間和健康結論分開。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Keep concentration, time and health conclusions distinct. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

missions.title: 土樣混合的乾重基準
missions.brief: 兩份土樣含水不同，這一關只用已換算的乾重做濃度混合。
missions.briefEn: Two samples differ in moisture; use dry masses already converted for this mixture.

evidence.title: 任務資料
evidence.detail: 樣本 A：100 kg dry、80 mg/kg；B：5 mg/kg dry。僅為實驗室混合算例。
evidence.detailEn: Sample A 100 kg dry at 80 mg/kg; B 5 mg/kg dry. Laboratory mixing exercise only.

evidence.title: 模型邊界
evidence.detail: 稀釋不移除污染物；此關不是場址整治策略或合規處理。
evidence.detailEn: Dilution does not remove contaminants; not a remediation or compliance strategy.

decisions.text: 同時保存總污染質量與混合濃度
decisions.textEn: Keep total contaminant mass and mixture concentration
decisions.feedback: 濃度下降不能被報成污染物已去除。
decisions.feedbackEn: Lower concentration must not be reported as contaminant removal.

decisions.text: 把稀釋濃度當去除量
decisions.textEn: Treat diluted concentration as removal
decisions.feedback: 污染物仍在系統內。
decisions.feedbackEn: Contaminant mass remains in the system.

decisions.text: 把濕重與乾重直接混用
decisions.textEn: Mix wet and dry mass bases
decisions.feedback: 不同含水率使濃度基準不一致。
decisions.feedbackEn: Moisture differences make concentration bases inconsistent.

missions.debrief: 濃度下降不能被報成污染物已去除。 所有範圍皆為此虛構教學任務的條件，不是法規或現場放行標準。
missions.debriefEn: Lower concentration must not be reported as contaminant removal. All ranges are fictional learning-case conditions, not codes or site release criteria.

campaigns.scopeEn: Original fictional engineering learning task. Photographs are representative backgrounds. Numbers and target ranges are not named-facility specifications, code thresholds or field commands. Station models are independent and are not calibrated digital twins.
